jobs.title: Demand Planning and Inventory Optimization Manager
jobs.excerpt: Our client, a dynamic Amazon FBA business with a global presence, is seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Demand Planning and Inventory Optimization Manager to join its Supply Chain Department.
jobs.description:
Our client, a dynamic Amazon FBA business with a global presence, is seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Demand Planning and Inventory Optimization Manager to join its Supply Chain Department. This role will lead efforts in forecasting demand, managing inventory levels, and optimizing stock for their entire catalog of products. As a key part of the Supply Chain team, this individual will ensure that the company maintains optimal stock levels while balancing cost efficiencies and operational requirements.

About the company:

The company is specialised on developing and upscaling Amazon-based brands across the USA, Canada, Europe, and the UK. With deep expertise in eCommerce and Amazon FBA, the company excels in buying, developing, and scaling brands to their fullest potential. The company navigates the complexities of international markets and high-performance marketing, ensuring seamless scalability and growth.

The company's portfolio includes several Amazon brands, primarily in the home and kitchen category, as well as some electronics. Its international team of 17 world-class talents manages all operations today.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Demand Planning: Analyze historical sales data, current product trends, and market insights to accurately forecast demand for all products.
  • Inventory Management: Calculate and manage optimal inventory levels to ensure product availability while minimizing excess stock and associated costs.
  • Order Management: Generate purchase orders for replenishment based on forecasted demand and stock levels, collaborating with suppliers to ensure timely deliveries.
  • Stock Control & Optimization: Monitor and optimize stock levels across the catalog, ensuring products are always available in the required quantities and minimizing overstock.
  • Analytics & Reporting: Provide regular reports on demand forecasts, stock status, and key performance indicators (KPIs). Use advanced analytics to recommend inventory adjustments and supply chain improvements.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with brand managers, supply chain teams, and other stakeholders to align demand forecasts with marketing, promotions, and sales strategies.
  • Amazon Marketplace Management: Oversee inventory management for Amazon, ensuring accurate stock levels, fulfillment coordination, and alignment with marketplace demand trends.

Qualifications:

  • Proven experience in demand planning, inventory management, and supply chain operations, preferably in e-commerce.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret large datasets and generate actionable insights.
  • Experience managing inventory for the Amazon Marketplace, including knowledge of FBA (Fulfilled by Amazon) and related processes.
  • High attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Experience working with international suppliers, especially from China, is a plus.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Proficiency in Google Spreadsheets, data analysis tools, and demand planning software
  • Experience with Inventory Planner would be a plus
  • This role is essential for maintaining efficient and cost-effective inventory management while supporting the companys growth through data-driven insights and precise demand forecasting.

What We Offer:

  • Fully remote and full-time role.
  • Paid time off.
  • Yearly bonuses.
  • Professional growth opportunities, such as managing staff members and growing your skill set.
  • Competitive and timely salary.
  • Opportunity to work remotely in an international company.
  • Dynamic, creative work environments.
  • Flexible schedule.

jobs.title: Senior Systems Software Engineer - Accelerated Spark Applications
jobs.excerpt: NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years.
jobs.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.


NVIDIA is seeking a Senior Systems Software Engineer for the Apache Spark Acceleration group. GPU accelerated data processing has moved from proof of concept to production deployments. Enterprises now recognize the need for accelerated computing to handle large data processing needs. Multi-node GPU deployments reduce cloud computing costs and lower the latency of batch ETL workloads. At NVIDIA, we accelerate Apache Spark with an open source plugin that speeds up Spark applications on GPUs without code changes, and our cuDF Spark library is integrated with AWS EMR, Databricks, Google Dataproc, Oracle Cloud Data Flow, Bytedance Volcengine, Tencent Cloud and Cloudera. This role is on the team that runs that acceleration as a handled Spark service inside NVIDIA. The service accomplishes production data pipelines for NVIDIA’s internal data platform at thousands of jobs an hour on Kubernetes and AWS, under a customer SLA. It packages the cuDF Spark plugin and a CPU/GPU workload router into an API-based service built on Spark Connect, Kyuubi, Helm and Flux. You will work across all three layers: the service, the GPU Spark runtime, and the router.


What you’ll be doing:

  • Design, build and operate hosted Spark service control plane on Kubernetes: the Java REST API, the Spark Connect runner, Kyuubi, and deployment using Helm charts and Flux
  • Own code review for one or more services end to end and keep them releasable on the release train
  • Extend the cuDF Spark runtime and the CPU/GPU workload router in Scala and Java, including interoperability with Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg and Unity Catalog
  • Investigate production failures on clusters running more than a thousand concurrent jobs together with the customer team and upstream library teams, and drive fixes to closure
  • Instrument metrics, dashboards and alerts; take part in the on-call rotation and keep the runbooks current
  • Provide recommendations and feedback to teams regarding decisions surrounding topics such as infrastructure, continuous integration and testing strategy

What we need to see:

  • BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a closely related field (or equivalent experience)
  • 9+ years of experience in software development
  • Strong distributed-systems fundamentals and proficiency in Java or Scala, plus C++ or Python
  • Hands-on experience operating services on Kubernetes, on-premise or cloud
  • Experience owning or reviewing a long-lived server: REST front ends, proxies or request routers, JDBC or Thrift services
  • Experience supporting enterprise or internal production customers, including on-call
  • Experience using AI tools in software development

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Apache Spark internals, Spark Connect, or Kyuubi
  • Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg or Unity Catalog integration work
  • GPU data processing with cuDF, or CUDA experience
  • Significant contributions to data platform projects committed to collaboration and shared development (Apache Spark, Velox, Presto, Apache Arrow, Apache DataFusion)

Widely Is considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 184,000 USD - 287,500 USD.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

jobs.description:
We are hiring an experienced Klaviyo Specialist for our client, a growing retention email marketing agency that has generated over $30 million in revenue for subscription eCommerce brands.

This role is for someone who knows Klaviyo inside out, has experience managing multiple agency accounts, and can independently execute high-performing email campaigns and flows.

A Day in This Role

You start your day inside Klaviyo, reviewing campaigns and automated flows across your client accounts.

One brand needs its subscription cancellation flow updated. Another has an abandoned cart flow that needs testing, while a third has a campaign scheduled to go live.

You check the segmentation, triggers, links, and tracking to make sure everything is working before launch.

Throughout the day, you collaborate with the CSM, Project Manager, Designer, and Copywriter to keep campaigns moving.

You end the day knowing your work has helped multiple eCommerce brands run stronger retention email programs.

Must-Have Requirements

Please apply only if you meet all five requirements:

  1. 2+ years of hands-on Klaviyo experience working with eCommerce brands generating $1M+ in monthly revenue.

  2. Subscription eCommerce experience, including cancellation and downgrade flows, and integrations with Skio, Loop, Recharge, Ordergroove, or similar platforms.

  3. Agency experience managing multiple client accounts simultaneously. Freelance-only or in-house-only experience is not sufficient.

  4. Experience managing 5+ accounts independently while maintaining quality and meeting deadlines.

  5. Strong written English (B2+ minimum) and the ability to communicate clearly in a remote, asynchronous team.

What You'll Do

  • Build, manage, and optimize Klaviyo flows, including Welcome, Abandoned Cart, Post-Purchase, Winback, and subscription retention flows.

  • Build, schedule, and launch email campaigns across multiple client accounts.

  • Perform pre-launch QA, checking segmentation, triggers, links, rendering, and tracking.

  • Monitor deliverability, maintain list hygiene, and run A/B tests to improve performance.

  • Collaborate with the CSM, Project Manager, Designer, and Copywriter to deliver campaigns accurately and on time.

This Role Is Not for You If

  • You have general email marketing experience but limited hands-on Klaviyo expertise.

  • You've only worked as a freelancer or in-house marketer without agency experience.

  • You haven't worked with subscription eCommerce brands or built cancellation and downgrade flows.

  • You need constant supervision or struggle to manage multiple client accounts independently.

  • You frequently miss deadlines, overlook campaign details, or struggle with written communication.

Why Join?

  • Work with established seven-figure subscription eCommerce brands.

  • Enjoy a fully remote role with autonomy over your daily schedule.

  • Join a small, experienced team focused on delivering measurable results.

  • Grow your career with a clear path from Klaviyo Specialist to Client Success Manager.

Ready to Apply?

If you have proven Klaviyo agency experience, understand subscription eCommerce, and can confidently manage multiple accounts without constant supervision, we'd love to hear from you.

Company description

Netbank is a start-up fintech led bank, focused on the under-served. Its model is to:

  • Partner with Fintechs, banks and non-bank lenders, who have existing client networks or are looking to enter the Philippines
  • Allow these partners to sign-up clients, for an origination fee, booked on Netbanks balance sheet. Netbank would provide:
  • Loans to clients, so the partners can grow without raising additional capital
  • Deposit accounts for clients, serviced by the partner (on a white-label basis)
  • Payment services to clients, including ACH payments, access to cards, payment to wallets, etc.
  • Technology services to the partners, allowing them more efficient processing and better client satisfaction

Netbank Virtual is a product area of Netbank, offering banking as a service via APIs to local fintech and international fintech looking to enter the market. It expects to offer services in:

  • Disburse funds: Payments via ACH, payments to wallets, payments to cash.
  • Collect funds: Receive funds from the above channels
  • Open transaction accounts / wallets
  • Open loan accounts.

Netbank will offer segment specific solutions, aiming to roll-out products to a pilot client and then a range of similar clients.

This position is a member of the team responsible for services to lenders.

The FLDG Loans Manager is responsible for product and business development for cash loans, mostly under FLDG.

The steps in product development will be:

  • Definition of product design to understand the data that can be gathered from the platform / payroll provider
  • Understanding of the repayment process to ensure these loans are self-liquidating
  • Assessment of size of loan partner, growth opportunity
  • Identification of additional data that may be available on the end client
  • Definition of data sources that can be used to assess creditworthiness.
  • Creation of legal agreements / specific processes to reduce credit risk
  • Definition of process design (document sharing, etc.)
  • Legal and contractual work with the platform / with the borrower
  • Product definition (term, tenor, etc.)

  • Understand the product that Netbank can provide to end clients.
  • Listen carefully to the situation of these lenders and align our sales strategy to their situation
  • Describe the solution and work with the partners as they develop the solution. Explain the regulation, the options, the financial implications.

  • Commercial negotiation
  • Support clients through implementation. Work closely with the clients to on-board them.

The steps in partner optimisation will be:

  • Identify product enhancements which ensure we meet the full needs of our end clients around lending products.
  • Identify causes of losses and ways to reduce these losses through credit risk mitigations
  • Identify additional products to sell to the end clients, such as additional loans, accounts, insurance, etc.
  • Identify how we can support internal processes of partners, such as by implementing collection accounts, etc.

As with all solutions providers, the position holder will need to:

  • Deeply understand client needs for the proposed services and identify ways that Netbank can provide a product significantly better than the competition

  • Managing a highly professional sales and on-boarding process, which responds at the speed that Fintech demand, keeps partners fully informed through the implementation process.

  • Revenue generated within vehicle lending

  • Enjoy sales process
  • Confidence to proactively contact new clients
  • Empathy to understand needs of organizations
  • Creativity to identify best banking solutions
  • Creativity in banking product design
  • Apply existing best practices while being aware that existing practices in the Philippines may not be optimal.

  • Ability to calculate / estimate expected loss rates and identify the required pricing

  • Identification of ways to predict losses (churn, etc.)
  • Awareness of collections processes and ways to get data to ensure collection
  • Innovation
  • Interest in new technologies / data sources that may allow Netbank to lower credit risk
  • Drive and impatience
  • Self-starter, following opportunities

Role Title: Bluebook Citation Specialist (Law Students & Recent JDs)

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

Opportunity Snapshot

Pay: $50–80/hour

You’ll need: Current or recent law school enrollment, hands-on Bluebook experience, and law journal or law review editing experience

Your tasks: Review citation-checking rubrics and build sample cite-checking tasks

Job Description

micro1 is engaging law students and recent law graduates with law journal experience to support a legal citation project. If you’ve spent time cite-checking for a law review or journal, this is that skill applied to a new context. No prior AI experience is required — your Bluebook fluency and editorial judgment are what matter.

Scope of Work

  1. Review existing Bluebook and pincite grading rubrics, and flag rules that are unclear, incomplete, or would be applied inconsistently by different editors.
  2. Identify edge cases the rubrics don’t currently cover and recommend how they should be handled.
  3. Create sample cite-checking tasks: source material paired with citations containing realistic errors, along with the correct answer and an explanation of the rule involved.
  4. Build tasks across a range of citation types and difficulty levels, from straightforward formatting errors to subtle pincite and source-support problems.
  5. Apply Bluebook rules consistently across all submissions.
  6. Flag ambiguous cases to project coordinators instead of resolving them silently.
  7. Deliver assigned work on schedule and at the required quality level.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Current law student (2L, 3L) or recent JD graduate.
  2. Law review or law journal experience, ideally including a cite-checking or source-collection role.
  3. Strong working knowledge of The Bluebook, including pincites, short forms, signals, and parentheticals.
  4. Able to explain why a citation is wrong, not just that it is — the reasoning matters as much as the correction.
  5. Careful and consistent across long sessions of detailed review work.
  6. Comfortable working independently and meeting deadlines without close supervision.
  7. Experience as a journal editor, articles editor, or executive editor is a plus.

How the selection process works

  1. Apply and complete the screening questions
  2. Complete the AI interview— this is how we showcase your skills to the client
  3. Profile review by the hiring team
  4. Onboarding — our Talent Ops team will get you set up

About the Role

We are seeking an accomplished and commercially driven Chief Executive Officer (CEO) to lead the strategic growth, operational performance, and long-term value creation of a diversified Construction & Real Estate business.

The CEO will have overall responsibility for the organization's strategy, P&L, business development, construction operations, real estate development, investment decisions, people leadership, and stakeholder management.

The ideal candidate will be a proven senior executive with substantial experience in construction, property development, real estate investment, infrastructure, engineering, or related sectors, with a strong track record of scaling businesses, managing large project portfolios, and delivering sustainable profitability.

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategy & Corporate Leadership

Develop and execute the company's short-, medium-, and long-term corporate strategy.

Lead business expansion across construction, property development, real estate investment, and related businesses.

Identify new markets, development opportunities, strategic partnerships, and investment opportunities.

Establish clear organizational objectives, KPIs, budgets, and performance targets.

Provide strategic recommendations and regular business updates to the Board.

2. P&L & Financial Management

Take full ownership of the company's P&L, cash flow, profitability, and financial performance.

Develop annual budgets, forecasts, capital plans, and investment strategies.

Improve margins, operational efficiency, working capital, and return on invested capital.

Oversee project economics, development feasibility, financing structures, and capital allocation.

Maintain strong relationships with banks, investors, institutional partners, and other financial stakeholders.

3. Construction & Project Delivery

Provide executive oversight of the company's construction portfolio and major development projects.

Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, to specification, and in compliance with applicable standards.

Establish strong project governance, cost controls, procurement processes, and risk-management frameworks.

Monitor contractor, consultant, supplier, and project-partner performance.

Ensure robust health, safety, quality, environmental, and regulatory standards across operations.

4. Real Estate Development & Investment

Lead the identification, evaluation, acquisition, development, and commercialization of real estate opportunities.

Oversee land acquisition, feasibility studies, master planning, development approvals, construction, sales/leasing, and asset disposition.

Evaluate development pipelines and investment proposals based on market demand, risk, and expected returns.

Build and maintain relationships with landowners, developers, investors, government authorities, brokers, and strategic partners.

Drive portfolio optimization and maximize the value of the company's real estate assets.

5. Business Development & Commercial Growth

Develop and execute strategies to increase revenue, market share, and profitability.

Build relationships with major corporate clients, government entities, institutional investors, developers, and strategic partners.

Lead negotiations for major contracts, joint ventures, development agreements, and strategic partnerships.

Identify opportunities for diversification and new revenue streams.

Strengthen the company's market reputation and competitive positioning.

Ensure the organization operates in accordance with applicable laws, regulations, contractual obligations, and corporate governance standards.

Establish enterprise-wide risk-management practices covering financial, operational, legal, construction, market, and investment risks.

Maintain strong governance across subsidiaries, projects, joint ventures, and investments.

Ensure transparency, accountability, and effective internal controls.

7. Leadership & Organizational Development

Build, lead, and retain a high-performing executive leadership team.

Develop organizational structures and talent strategies aligned with business growth.

Establish a culture focused on accountability, execution, innovation, safety, and commercial performance.

Coach and develop senior leaders and ensure effective succession planning.

Promote collaboration across construction, development, finance, commercial, legal, sales, and operations functions.

8. Stakeholder & Government Relations

Act as the principal representative of the company with the Board, investors, regulators, government authorities, financial institutions, clients, partners, and community stakeholders.

Develop strong relationships with government and regulatory bodies relevant to construction and real estate development.

Represent the organization at industry events, investment forums, and strategic business engagements.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The CEO will be accountable for:

Revenue and EBITDA/PAT growth

Overall P&L performance

Project delivery against budget and timelines

Gross margins and project profitability

Real estate portfolio growth and asset value creation

Return on invested capital

New business and development pipeline

Cash flow and working-capital performance

Customer and stakeholder satisfaction

Safety and quality performance

Employee engagement and leadership development

Strategic partnerships and market expansion

Candidate Profile

Essential Experience

15+ years of progressive leadership experience, with significant senior management exposure in construction, real estate, property development, infrastructure, engineering, or a closely related sector.

Previous experience as CEO, Managing Director, Deputy CEO, COO, Executive Director, Business Unit President, or equivalent senior leadership position.

Proven experience managing a large-scale P&L and multidisciplinary organization.

Demonstrated success in construction project delivery and/or real estate development.

Strong commercial and financial acumen, including budgeting, investment analysis, cash-flow management, and capital allocation.

Proven track record of business growth, market expansion, and value creation.

Experience managing major contractors, developers, consultants, investors, financial institutions, and government stakeholders.

Strong understanding of construction contracts, development economics, procurement, project risk, and real estate markets.

Preferred Experience

Experience managing a diversified construction and real estate group or holding company.

Exposure to large-scale residential, commercial, industrial, mixed-use, hospitality, infrastructure, or urban-development projects.

Experience with joint ventures, PPPs, institutional investors, private equity, or international development partners.

Experience leading organizational transformation, restructuring, or rapid business expansion.

International or multi-country experience is highly desirable.

Education

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, Real Estate, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a related discipline.

Master's degree/MBA is preferred.

Professional qualifications in engineering, project management, finance, real estate, or related fields will be advantageous.

Core Competencies

Commercial & Financial Acumen

P&L Management

Real Estate Development

Construction & Project Management

Investment & Capital Allocation

Business Development

Negotiation & Contract Management

Risk Management

Corporate Governance

Stakeholder Management

Government Relations

Organizational Transformation

Executive Team Leadership

Decision-Making & Problem Solving

Leadership Characteristics

The successful CEO will be:

Commercially aggressive but financially disciplined

Strategic yet highly execution-oriented

Comfortable managing complex and high-value projects

A strong negotiator and relationship builder

Data-driven and financially sophisticated

Capable of operating effectively with Boards, investors, governments, and major clients

jobs.description:
Role Title: Certified Coding Specialist (CCS)

Role Type: Contractor

Location: United States, Remote

micro1 is engaging Certified Coding Specialists to contribute to a valued project focused on enhancing clinical coding accuracy and data quality. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input.

Scope of Work

  1. Review and analyze inpatient medical records to ensure accurate ICD-10 and CPT coding in alignment with current guidelines and best practices.
  2. Review clinical documentation for accuracy, completeness, and coding integrity.
  3. Evaluate AI-generated clinical notes and summaries against real-world documentation and coding standards.
  4. Code AI-generated diagnostic and procedural information from the record using ICD and CPT/HCPCS classification systems.
  5. Identify and resolve discrepancies in diagnosis and procedure coding, ensuring the integrity of record abstraction and data capture.
  6. Enter AI-generated patient information into computerized inpatient and outpatient medical record databases.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Active certification in one of the following: CCS, CIC, COC, RHIA, or RHIT or other coding certification through AHIMA and AAPC.
  2. ICD-10 coding experience.
  3. Access to up-to-date official ICD-10 and CPT coding books, as well as E&M guidelines.
  4. Currently working in medical coding, clinical documentation improvement, or a closely related documentation role
  5. Availability of at least 10 hours per week

  • Accounts payable: Review vendor invoices for accuracy, verify supporting documentation, assist with invoice coding, maintain payment records, and flag discrepancies for review
  • Accounts receivable: Record customer payments, assist with invoice tracking, monitor outstanding balances, and support follow-up on unresolved account items.
  • Reconciliation: Assist with bank, credit card, vendor, and customer account reconciliations; investigate discrepancies and escalate unusual transactions when necessary
  • Financial reporting: Prepare routine accounting summaries, transaction reports, spreadsheets, and supporting schedules for management reviw
  • Expense documentation: Organize receipts, invoices, and expense records to suppot accurate reporting and consistent recordkeeping
  • Internal coordination: Communicate with authorized team members and vendors regarding invoice questions, missing documentation, payment records, and account discrepancies
  • Process compliance: Follow established accounting procedures, maintain appropriate approval records, and protect confidential financial information
  • Administrative support: Assist with month end close activites, document organization, audit preparation, and other accounting tasks as business needs require

Qualifications

  • Previous experience in accounting, bookkeeping, accounts payable, accounts receivable, or a related financial support role.
  • Working knowledge of basic accounting principles, transaction processing, reconciliations, and financial documentation.
  • Proficiency with spreadsheets and standard business software, including Microsoft Excel or comparable tools.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify inconsistencies in financial records.
  • Excellent organizational, written communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to manage deadlines, maintain accurate records, and handle multiple priorities with appropriate follow through.
  • Commitment to confidentiality, ethical conduct, and responsible handling of financial information.
  • Reliable internet access and a suitable workspace for fully remote work.

Experience supporting construction, painting, contracting, trades, or other project based businesses is beneficial but not required. Familiarity with accounting software and vendor invoice workflows is also an advantage.

Employee Experience and Work Environment

This position offers a fully remote work arrangement, allowing the successful candidate to perform accounting responsibilities from an appropriate home workspace. The role requires dependable communication, independent task management, careful documentation, and collaboration with colleagues who support the company's business operations.

The Accounting Associate will contribute to the financial processes that help keep vendor records organized, customer transactions documented, and accounting information available for informed business decisions. Success in this position means maintaining accuracy, meeting agreed deadlines, raising questions promptly, and approaching routine financial work with professionalism and accountability.

jobs.description:
Role Overview

The Producer Services Readiness Lead serves as the senior Producer Services subject matter expert for translating approved requirements into practical workflows, standard operating procedures, training, service processes, controls, and launch plans. The role leads and coordinates readiness activities for new and changing business-process requirements within Producer Services.

The Lead applies sound operational judgment and escalates decisions involving policy, risk, resources, or cross-functional ownership to the appropriate Producer Services leader. The Lead coordinates readiness activities and assesses whether staff, workflows, materials, system dependencies, and escalation paths have been prepared before new producer-facing requirements go live, escalating unresolved readiness risks as appropriate.

The role provides targeted onboarding and Support readiness during launches and peak periods but does not become the standing owner of routine onboarding, Support production, regulatory interpretation, or technical delivery.

Key Responsibilities

Business Process Readiness & Subject Matter Expertise

  • Serve as the Producer Services subject matter expert for the implementation of new and changing business-process requirements.
  • Translate approved policy, program, regulatory, financial, and operational decisions into clear Producer Services workflows and operating requirements.
  • Develop and recommend how approved requirements should be executed across affected Producer Services teams, working with team leaders to confirm the final operating approach.
  • Map current- and future-state processes, including roles, handoffs, decision rights, controls, exceptions, and escalation paths.
  • Identify missing decisions, process gaps, conflicting requirements, and dependencies that could prevent successful implementation.
  • Recommend practical operating approaches that balance producer clarity, control requirements, service quality, and available capacity for review and approval by Producer Services leadership.
  • Maintain awareness of new and changing Producer Services processes across registration, reporting, validation, adjustments, corrections, payments, delinquency, and regulator referrals to support readiness planning and implementation activities.
  • Process Implementation & Operationalization
  • Assess the operational feasibility and impacts of new or changing requirements affecting Producer Services.
  • Coordinate and support the implementation and operationalization of approved Producer Services processes, partnering with process owners and functional leaders to ensure readiness activities are completed.
  • Draft and maintain operational process documentation, including SOPs, process maps, job aids, checklists, decision trees, intake procedures, queue-routing rules, and escalation protocols.
  • Document process ownership, handoffs, decision rights, and escalation paths across Producer Services and partner functions.
  • Coordinate the transition of approved requirements from process design into day-to-day operations.
  • Assess readiness and identify gaps related to workflows, documentation, controls, staffing, data, knowledge, and escalation paths before launch, escalating unresolved risks to the appropriate leader.
  • Monitor adoption after launch, identify operational gaps, and coordinate approved process updates, training activities, or corrective actions with the appropriate process owners.
  • Transition implemented processes to the appropriate steady-state owner after stabilization.

Training, Launch & Adoption

  • Develop and coordinate operational training for new and changing Producer Services processes.
  • Prepare facilitator materials, staff job aids, process guidance, scenarios, and readiness resources.
  • Facilitate or support training sessions for Producer Services and other affected teams.
  • Support readiness activities designed to ensure affected staff have access to process guidance, resources, training, and escalation paths before launch.
  • Coordinate operational launch plans, including readiness checkpoints, communications inputs, staffing considerations, and contingency procedures.
  • Support post-launch stabilization by monitoring questions, handoff failures, process exceptions, and operational issues
  • Maintain documentation showing completion of required readiness, training, and launch activities.

Product Owner & Solutions Partnership

  • Partner with the Producer Solutions Product Owner to connect business-process readiness with the product and systems roadmap.
  • Provide process requirements, workflows, business rules, exceptions, and operational input needed to support systems development.
  • Review proposed system changes for alignment with approved Producer Services processes and operating needs.
  • Provide subject matter expertise during requirements development, testing preparation, and implementation planning.
  • Participates in UAT and business acceptance as the operational-process subject matter expert and validate that end-to-end workflows and exceptions have been documented and tested.
  • Prepare teams, workflows, knowledge, and training for system releases coordinated through the Product Owner.
  • Identify gaps between approved business processes and proposed technical solutions and raise the associated operational impacts.
  • Support and coordinate operational readiness activities associated with transitioning approved system improvements into Producer Services.
  • Provides operational recommendations and readiness assessments within delegated authority; final product acceptance, prioritization, and release decisions remain with the Product Owner and business sponsor.
  • Maintain clear separation between process readiness and product ownership. The Product Owner manages the systems roadmap, systems requirements, UAT governance, and delivery coordination; the Readiness Lead serves as the operational readiness lead for process implementation, staff readiness, training, launch preparation, and operational adoption activities.

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Coordinate with Compliance to ensure processes reflect approved regulatory requirements while maintaining Compliance ownership of regulatory interpretation and correctness.
  • Coordinate with Finance on producer-facing payment, invoicing, adjustment, and correction processes while maintaining Finance ownership of billing.
  • Coordinate with Producer Support on intake, routing, approved answers, service workflows, and case escalation procedures.
  • Support delinquency-monitoring and regulator-referral processes while maintaining regulator ownership of enforcement decisions.

Continuous Improvement & Process Controls

  • Monitor operating results and recommend updates to processes, controls, training, and readiness standards based on recurring issues and lessons learned.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, reduce manual work, strengthen controls, and improve producer clarity.
  • Maintain traceable documentation of approved decisions, process requirements, controls, ownership, and implementation status.
  • Support audit-ready operations by ensuring procedures, required evidence, and approval points are clearly documented.
  • Provide analysis and recommendations to Producer Services leadership regarding improvement opportunities based on service, risk, producer, and implementation impacts.
  • Other job related duties as assigned.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong business-process design, implementation, and operationalization skills.
  • Ability to become a trusted subject matter expert across complex and changing process requirements.
  • Strong facilitation and training skills with technical and nontechnical audiences.
  • Excellent organizational and follow-through skills across multiple concurrent launches and deadlines.
  • Ability to translate approved requirements into clear workflows, roles, controls, and operating instructions.
  • Strong written communication and documentation skills.
  • Ability to identify missing decisions, unclear ownership, dependencies, and implementation risks.
  • Sound operational judgment and confidence recommending readiness actions and tradeoffs.
  • Comfortable providing hands-on support during launches while maintaining appropriate long-term ownership boundaries.
  • High attention to detail, adaptability, and commitment to reliable implementation.

Qualifications

  • 3-5 years of experience in business operations, process implementation, operational readiness, service delivery, business analysis, change implementation, project delivery, ora relatedenvironment.

  • Familiarity with CRM, case-management, portal, workflow, Jira, reporting, or related operational systems preferred.

LumiMeds is a fast-growing telehealth company making GLP-1 weight-loss treatment (semaglutide & tirzepatide) accessible, affordable, and effective. We've built a real business with real patients and real outcomes — and we're just getting started. We move fast, test relentlessly, and let data settle arguments.
The Role
We're hiring a Head of Growth to own our growth engine end-to-end — online and offline. This is not a channel-manager seat. You'll set the growth strategy, run experiments across every lever (paid, organic, referral, partnerships, experiential, OOH, guerrilla), and personally drive the initiatives that move the business. You bring a playbook of proven tactics, the scrappiness to execute them on a lean budget, and the analytical rigor to know what's actually working.

If you've grown a consumer business from scratch, thrive in ambiguity, and get a thrill out of finding the unlock nobody else saw — this is your seat.

  • Own the full growth strategy across digital and offline channels — you set the roadmap and the number you're accountable to.
  • Run growth end-to-end: ideation → hypothesis → execution → measurement → iterate. You don't hand things off; you drive them to the finish.
  • Build and scale offline growth initiatives — experiential, OOH, guerrilla, events, partnerships, retail, and channels we haven't thought of yet.
  • Scale digital acquisition — paid social/search, lifecycle, referral, affiliate, SEO/content — and squeeze efficiency out of every dollar.
  • Bring proven playbooks — you've done this before and can point to specific tactics that worked, and why.
  • Research relentlessly — find new channels, size opportunities, study competitors, and pressure-test ideas before we spend.
  • Negotiate with vendors and partners — you get more for less and structure deals that de-risk our spend.
  • Live in the data — instrument everything, measure CAC/LTV/payback obsessively, and kill what doesn't work fast.
What You Bring
  • Track record of growing a business — you can show real numbers you were directly responsible for moving.
  • Both offline and digital growth experience — you're equally comfortable running a guerrilla campaign and a paid-acquisition dashboard.
  • A documented playbook of growth tactics you've run and can run again.
  • True growth-hacker DNA — scrappy, resourceful, and biased toward action on a lean budget.
  • Data-driven decision-making — you form hypotheses, run clean tests, and follow the numbers.

  • Strong research and negotiation skills — you find the opportunity and close the deal.
  • Bonus: DTC, subscription, telehealth, wellness, or regulated-vertical experience.
Why LumiMeds
  • Direct access to the founder and a mandate to move fast.
  • A real product with proven demand and outcomes — you're pouring fuel on a fire, not starting one.
  • Full ownership of growth, with the budget and autonomy to prove your playbook.

If this role sounds like a fit, we’d love to hear from you. Please submit your application in English and ensure your resume reflects relevant experience for the role.

Hanwha Renewables, headquartered in Irvine, California, a member of Hanwha Group, a FORTUNE Global 500 firm that is among the eight largest business enterprises in South Korea. POSITION OVERVIEW

Lead and perform interconnection planning analysis and economic studies for utility scale solar PV plants and energy storage projects with a special focus on production cost simulations and utility grid capacity assessment. Principal IPE will be responsible for supervising and performing electrical analysis on the utility high voltage transmission system to identify capacity for potential (utility scale solar & storage) projects and handling necessary transmission & interconnection processes of utilities and ISO’s. Hanwha Q Cells is currently active in multiple ISOs and RTOs and vertically integrated markets across the country, with multiple M&A projects at various stages of development. Provide due diligence engineering review, statement, and technical feasibility. Coordinate and manage internal and third-party studies, consulting and independent transmission planning resources during the pre-acquisition leading technical diligence, development activities, and engineering. Principal IPE provides mentorship to junior transmission planning engineers in the team and provides day-to-day guidance for performing interconnection planning viability studies and economic analysis as needed. This role provides necessary technical training for performing loadflow injection studies using TARA and PSS/E software.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Routinely lead and perform powerflow studies (using PowerGem TARA and Siemens PSS/E software) and economic studies (using PROMOD) to assess electric interconnection viability of renewable projects and support Development and Commercial Teams for due diligence studies and efforts before commencing interconnection applications. Identify optimal interconnection locations in target markets based on multiple cross-functional siting criteria.
  • Perform detailed technical reviews of interconnection study reports (Feasibility, System Impact, and Facilities) to validate assumptions, identify technical errors, inconsistencies, and optimization opportunities. Collaborate with utilities, ISOs, consultants, and internal stakeholders to resolve study issues, reduce network upgrade costs, shorten project schedules, and improve interconnection outcomes by developing technical questions, comments, and alternative mitigation strategies.
  • Lead the negotiation of Generator Interconnection Agreement (GIA), amendments, Facility Construction Agreements (FCAs), and other interconnection-related agreements. Coordinate internal reviews with Legal, Engineering, Development, and Commercial teams, and negotiate directly with utilities, ISOs/RTOs, and transmission providers to achieve timely execution while optimizing project cost, schedule, and commercial outcomes.
  • Ensure all executed Interconnection Agreements (IAs) remain in good standing through Commercial Operation Date (COD) for assigned projects. Monitor compliance with IA milestones, proactively manage milestone obligations, identify potential risks, and drive resolution of issues that could result in a breach of the agreement or impact on the project schedule.
  • Routinely lead and perform due diligence for M&A projects by reviewing interconnection documents from data room and briefing Development and Commercial team on key findings
  • Support engineering team routinely as a seasoned engineer with technical task assignments for projects under engineering and design phase and attend project meetings (internal and external).
  • Review and summarize Curtailment study results for management review and support Finance team on routine assignments with external consultants.
  • Evaluate transmission and interconnection tariffs, costs, timelines, queue dynamics, and market processes across multiple markets. Develop interconnection strategies and provide technical guidance to Development and Commercial teams to support project origination, risk assessment, and investment decisions.
  • Provide communication and build relationships with utilities/ISOs and track interconnection progress to ensure projects are complete in a timely and cost-effective manner.
  • Track changes to interconnection tariffs and key transmission upgrades in target markets in North America
  • Create regular project interconnection status reports and monitor LGIA milestones.
  • Work with Development and Commercial departments to analyze renewable energy projects.
  • Contribute innovative ideas to enhance interconnection and quality in practices utilized by the Hanwha development department.
  • Train junior level IPEs to perform load flow simulations and analyze electric transmission grid capacity for renewable developments and interconnection

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Minimum Bachelor of Science degree in Electrical engineering, Master’s, and/or MBA preferred. PE license is preferred but not required.
  • Ten (10) years of transmission and interconnection planning experience on renewable projects and at least two years of solar photovoltaic and energy storage utility scale projects.
  • Development or transmission planning at a utility, ISO/RTO, or project developer.
  • Ability to use proficiently GE PSLF, Siemens PSS/E, PROMOD and AutoCAD software
  • Demonstrated ability to work autonomously at a dynamic pace, find creative solutions, and communicate with both a technical and non-technical audience.
  • Experience communicating / working with utilities, consulting firms, ISO/RTOs, and regulators
  • Candidate must possess experience in successfully executing projects from inception thru development and into engineering while providing strong technical direction/guidance in power engineering background (especially having interconnection Tariff background.)
  • Some level of experience in performing due diligence for solar and energy storage assets are preferred.

jobs.excerpt: AHEAD builds platforms for digital business.  By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation.
jobs.description:
AHEAD builds platforms for digital business. By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation.

We are seeking a Senior Technical Consultant to lead firewall, network access control, and SASE engagements across diverse enterprise environments. This role spans three core technology pillars: next-generation firewall design and deployment (Cisco Secure Firewall, Palo Alto Networks), Cisco ISE-based network access control and identity services, and SASE/Zero Trust architectures (Zscaler, Palo Alto Prisma Access, Cisco Secure Access, Netskope).

The ideal candidate combines deep hands-on expertise across these platforms with strong consulting skills, owning end-to-end delivery from discovery and design through implementation, testing, and knowledge transfer. This is a client-facing role that requires the ability to lead technical workstreams, produce professional documentation, and communicate complex security strategies to both technical and executive audiences.

Key Responsibilities: Firewall

    • Design and deploy Cisco Secure Firewall Threat Defense (FTD) managed by Firewall Management Center (FMC), including high-availability pairs, threat policies (Snort IPS, malware defense, URL filtering), and both site-to-site and remote access VPN configurations.
    • Configure and manage Palo Alto Networks next-generation firewalls running PAN-OS, including security profiles (Antivirus, Anti-Spyware, Vulnerability Protection, WildFire), App-ID, User-ID, SSL/TLS decryption, and centralized management via Panorama.
    • Lead firewall migration projects including legacy Cisco ASA to FTD conversions, cross-vendor migrations (Check Point, Fortinet, Juniper to Palo Alto or Cisco), and policy translation with rule optimization during cutover.
    • Design network segmentation architectures using firewall zones, virtual routers, VRFs, and policy-based routing to enforce least-privilege east-west and north-south traffic controls.
    • Deploy cloud-native firewall solutions including Palo Alto Cloud NGFW for AWS and Azure, and Cisco Secure Firewall Cloud Native for containerized and cloud workload environments.
    • Implement firewall high availability designs including active/standby failover, active/active clustering, and multi-context deployments for service provider and large enterprise environments.
    • Configure centralized logging, SIEM integration (Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, syslog), and NetFlow/IPFIX for traffic analytics, threat correlation, and compliance reporting.
    • Perform firewall rule base optimization, policy cleanup, and compliance auditing to reduce attack surface and align with regulatory frameworks (PCI-DSS, HIPAA, NIST).
    • Integrate Cisco Secure Firewall with Cisco XDR for cross-platform threat detection, event correlation, and automated incident response across the security portfolio.
    • Automate firewall provisioning, configuration backup, and policy deployment using infrastructure-as-code tools (Terraform, Ansible) and vendor APIs for repeatable, auditable workflows.
    • Deploy Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE) for wired and wireless authentication, MAC Authentication Bypass (MAB), and RADIUS/TACACS+ device administration across campus, branch, and data center environments.

Key Responsibilities: Cisco ISE

    • Design and implement ISE authorization policies including Security Group Tags (SGTs) with TrustSec, downloadable ACLs (dACLs), VLAN assignment, and Adaptive Network Control (ANC) for dynamic threat response.
    • Configure ISE profiling services, posture assessment, and compliance enforcement to provide endpoint visibility and ensure devices meet organizational security baselines before granting access.
    • Integrate ISE with Cisco network infrastructure (Catalyst switches, wireless LAN controllers, Secure Firewall) and third-party network access devices for consistent policy enforcement across heterogeneous environments.
    • Deploy ISE guest portals, BYOD onboarding workflows, and certificate-based authentication (EAP-TLS) with internal or external certificate authorities for secure device enrollment.
    • Implement pxGrid integrations to share identity and session context between ISE, Cisco Secure Firewall, Splunk, and third-party security platforms for unified policy enforcement and threat intelligence.
    • Design ISE distributed deployments spanning Policy Administration Nodes (PAN), Policy Service Nodes (PSN), and Monitoring and Troubleshooting Nodes (MnT) for scale, redundancy, and geographic distribution.
    • Perform ISE upgrades, migrations (legacy ACS to ISE), and advanced troubleshooting using RADIUS live logs, policy trace, TCP dump, and debug utilities to resolve authentication and authorization issues.

Key Responsibilities: SASE/Zero Trust:

    • Design and implement SASE and Zero Trust architectures covering remote user, branch office, cloud workload, and data center connectivity use cases with a unified security policy framework.
    • Configure and deploy Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) including Secure Web Gateway, SSL inspection, URL filtering, cloud firewall, and sandbox policies, and Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) including ZTNA application segments, App Connectors, and browser-based access.
    • Deploy Palo Alto Prisma Access including GlobalProtect remote user connectivity, explicit proxy for branch offices, and service connections to on-premises infrastructure managed through Strata Cloud Manager or Panorama.
    • Implement Cisco Secure Access (SSE) including Zero Trust Network Access, Secure Web Gateway, Cloud Access Security Broker, and resource connector deployment for private application access.
    • Configure Netskope Security Cloud including Next Gen SWG, CASB with API-enabled and inline protections, and Netskope Private Access (NPA) with traffic steering, real-time protection policies, and DLP controls.
    • Leverage Guardicore micro-segmentation for east-west traffic control, application ring-fencing, and workload visibility to complement SASE north-south protections in hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
    • Deploy identity-based access controls integrating with Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, SAML 2.0, and SCIM provisioning to enforce user and device trust across all SASE platforms.
    • Develop and maintain Zero Trust maturity roadmaps for clients, mapping current-state gaps to phased adoption plans across identity, device, network, application, and data pillars.

Architecture, Design and Documentation:

    • Lead client-facing discovery sessions, design workshops, and architecture reviews to define firewall, NAC, and SASE strategies aligned with business objectives and compliance requirements. Own the creation of High-Level Design (HLD) and Low-Level Design (LLD) documents, network diagrams, implementation runbooks, and as-built documentation for firewall, ISE, and SASE deployments.
    • Develop migration and cutover plans with rollback procedures, change management workflows, and CAB review packages
    • Conduct knowledge transfer sessions and train client operations teams on day-2 firewall management, ISE policy administration, SASE platform operations, and incident response procedures.
    • Manage project workstreams, track milestones and deliverables, and escalate risks proactively to project and account leadership
    • Serve as the technical escalation point for junior engineers during engagements, conducting reviews of policy configurations and providing mentorship
    • Contribute to internal practice development including reusable templates, deployment runbooks, and automation playbooks for firewall, ISE, and SASE engagements.

Required Qualifications:

    • 7+ years of network security, infrastructure security, or security engineering experience, with at least 3 years in a consulting, professional services, or client-facing delivery role.
    • Demonstrated hands-on experience designing and deploying Cisco Secure Firewall (FTD/FMC) and Palo Alto Networks NGFW (PAN-OS/Panorama) in enterprise production environments.
    • Production experience deploying Cisco ISE for authentication, TACACS+ device administration, and network access policy enforcement across wired, wireless, and VPN environments.
    • Production experience with at least one SASE platform (Zscaler ZIA/ZPA, Palo Alto Prisma Access, Cisco Secure Access, or Netskope) including SWG, CASB, and ZTNA configuration.
    • Strong understanding of routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP), VPN technologies (IPsec, SSL/TLS), network segmentation, and Zero Trust architecture principles.
    • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS VPC, Azure VNet, GCP VPC) including security groups, network firewalls, and hybrid connectivity architectures.
    • Experience with identity and access management platforms (Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, SAML 2.0, SCIM) and their integration with firewall, NAC, and SASE solutions.
    • Experience integrating security platforms with SIEM (Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel), syslog infrastructure, and automation tools (Terraform, Ansible) for centralized visibility and repeatable deployments.

Preferred Qualifications:

    • CCIE Security or CCNP Security certification.
    • Palo Alto PCNSE or PCNSC certification; Zscaler ZCCA/ZCCP; Cisco Secure Access or Netskope certifications.
    • CISSP, CompTIA Security+, or equivalent industry security certification.
    • Firewall migration experience including ASA to FTD conversions and cross-vendor platform migrations with rule translation and optimization.

jobs.title: Partner Manager
jobs.excerpt: At Algolia, we’re proud to be a pioneer and market leader in AI Search, empowering 18,000+ businesses to deliver blazing-fast, predictive search and browse experiences at internet scale.
jobs.description:
At Algolia, we’re proud to be a pioneer and market leader in AI Search, empowering 18,000+ businesses to deliver blazing-fast, predictive search and browse experiences at internet scale. Every week, we power over 30 billion search requests — four times more than Microsoft Bing, Yahoo, Baidu, Yandex, and DuckDuckGo combined.

In 2021, we raised $150 million in Series D funding, quadrupling our valuation to $2.25 billion. This strong foundation enables us to keep investing in our market-leading platform and serving incredible customers like Under Armour, PetSmart, Stripe, Gymshark, and Walgreens.

As the Partner Manager for DACH, you will execute Algolia's partner strategy across Germany, Austria and Switzerland, with Germany as the primary focus market. You'll work with consulting partners, systems integrators, technology partners and cloud partners to embed Algolia into the multi-technology — increasingly agentic — solutions they build and sell.

This is not a solutions engineering role — you won't be architecting or implementing client solutions. But it is a solutions-focused role: you need real technical fluency, and the ability to inspire partners and customers on the art of the possible with Algolia. In practice, that means identifying and shaping three kinds of agentic solutions: those that combine Algolia with one or more of our technology partners; those built by our consulting partners and brought to market by them; and those built jointly with technology partners around a shared value proposition that delivers real value to customers and end users. Pipeline development, opportunity progression and customer wins all matter — but they all start with getting the innovation right, with Algolia at the center of it.

Reporting to the Head of Global Partnerships, and working in close collaboration with the General Manager of DACH, you will develop and execute the regional partner strategy — deciding which consulting, systems integration, technology and cloud partners to prioritize, and building the technical and commercial motions that turn those relationships into pipeline and revenue.

Algolia's partner motion in DACH is mature — we've been building relationships in the region for seven years. This role is an opportunity to build on that foundation: taking well-established partnerships to the next level, while also designing and standing up a partner-led growth strategy for the region.

YOUR ROLE WILL CONSIST OF:

  • Developing and executing Algolia's partner strategy across DACH, with Germany as the primary focus market alongside Austria and Switzerland
  • Building on seven years of established partner relationships in the region, while designing and executing a new partner-led growth strategy for DACH
  • Building and managing a portfolio of consulting partners, systems integrators, technology partners and cloud partners (e.g., AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft) across the region
  • Identifying, recruiting and onboarding new partners into the Algolia Partner Program, with particular attention to partners building agentic and AI-driven solutions
  • Shaping and championing agentic solutions that combine Algolia with one or more of our technology partners
  • Working with consulting partners to help them build their own agentic solutions on Algolia and bring those solutions to market
  • Developing joint value propositions with technology partners for agentic solutions that deliver real value to customers and end users
  • Acting as a solutions-focused innovator who can inspire partners and customers on the art of the possible with Algolia
  • Developing a working technical understanding of partner architectures and solutions deep enough to guide partners on where and how Algolia fits — without owning implementation
  • Enabling partners on Algolia's product and technical capabilities so they can position, sell and deliver successfully
  • Owning deal registration, pursuit prioritization and account mapping across the partner portfolio
  • Coordinating go-to-market strategy with partners, including joint marketing, co-selling and technical enablement content
  • Coordinating across partners, internal sales and solutions engineering teams on strategic client pursuits
  • Collaborating closely with the DACH General Manager and regional sales leadership to align partner strategy with revenue goals
  • Collaborating with Algolia Sales, Marketing, Engineering, Product and Enablement teams to ensure partner and end client success
  • Owning pipeline creation and data accuracy for the DACH partner portfolio, with reporting to the Head of Global Partnerships — recognizing that strong pipeline, opportunity progression and customer wins all start with the right solution innovation involving Algolia

YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF YOU HAVE:

  • 7-10+ years of experience in a senior Alliance, Channel or Partner role, ideally with technology, cloud or systems integration partners, in a recurring revenue business model
  • Strong technical fluency — comfortable discussing APIs, search/AI architecture, cloud infrastructure and how multiple technologies combine into a single solution, without being a hands-on engineer
  • Familiarity with the emerging landscape of agentic AI and the accelerator programs being built by systems integrators and technology partners
  • Experience working with cloud partners (AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure) and/or major systems integrators active in the German market (e.g., Accenture, Cognizant, Publicis Groupe, Valtech, Diconium)
  • Business-side understanding of SaaS software, search/AI, headless commerce and API-first architectures
  • A track record of developing and executing regional partner strategy, ideally with strength in the German market and familiarity with Austria and Switzerland
  • Fluency in German (spoken and written) is required, given the primary focus on the German market; fluency in English is also required
  • Salesforce.com experience creating and managing opportunities through the sales cycle, with high attention to data accuracy and quality
  • Excellent communicator, writer and storyteller, with a strong ability to influence both technical and business stakeholders
  • A history of developing and nurturing long-term industry and partner relationships
  • A history of becoming a trusted advisor to partners, clients and internal stakeholders, including senior leadership
  • A solutions-oriented mindset — genuinely creative and innovative, with the ability to inspire partners and customers on the art of the possible with Algolia
  • Comfort operating with a high degree of autonomy across a multi-country region
  • A track record of driving joint co-selling and co-marketing activities
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams, both internally and externally

Algolia does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, military status, veteran status, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law.

The annual total cash compensation range (base salary and commission) for this role reflects market pay data within this location. The exact compensation offered for this role may vary depending on specific location and job-related knowledge, technical skills, and experience; and is only one part of our Total Rewards philosophy to compensate and recognize employees for their work.

On-Target Earnings Pay Range
€139.500—€174.500 EUR

FLEXIBLE WORKPLACE STRATEGY:

Algolia’s flexible workplace model is designed to empower all Algolians to fulfill our mission to power search and discovery with ease. We place an emphasis on an individual’s impact, contribution, and output, over their physical location. Algolia is a high-trust environment and many of our team members have the autonomy to choose where they want to work and when.

We have a global presence with offices in Paris, NYC, London, Sydney and Bucharest, however we also offer many of our team members the option to work remotely either as fully remote or hybrid-remote employees. Positions listed as "Remote" are only available for remote work within the specified country. Positions listed within a specific city are only available in that location - depending on the role it may be available with either a hybrid-remote or in-office schedule.

WE’RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO CAN LIVE OUR VALUES:

  • GRIT - Problem-solving and perseverance capability in an ever-changing and growing environment.
  • TRUST - Willingness to trust our co-workers and to take ownership.
  • CANDOR - Ability to receive and give constructive feedback.
  • CARE - Genuine care about other team members, our clients and the decisions we make in the company.
  • HUMILITY - Aptitude for learning from others, putting ego aside.

We’re looking for talented, passionate people to help build the world’s best search and discovery technology. We value autonomy, diversity, and collaboration. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone is respected and supported—regardless of race, age, ancestry, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, color, veteran status, disability, or socioeconomic background.

IMPORTANT NOTICE FOR CANDIDATES - Recruitment Fraud Notice

We’ve recently seen an increase in recruitment scams targeting job seekers. To help protect yourself, please keep the following in mind:

  • Our open positions may appear on third-party job boards, but the best way to apply safely is directly through our careers page.
  • All genuine communication from Algolia will come from an @algolia.com email address. If you receive an email from someone claiming to work at Algolia who does not have an @algolia.com email address, please do not respond or share any personal information.
  • We’ll never ask for payments, purchases, or financial details during the hiring process.

READY TO APPLY?

If you share our values and our enthusiasm for building the world’s best search & discovery technology, we’d love to review your application!

Updated/Reviewed 12.04.25

Foster Dog Content Collection

Job Industry: Charity / Social Services / Non- Profit Organization

Position Name: Foster Dog Content Collection for Dog Rescue - Volunteer (Unpaid)

Job Location: Spokane, Washington, United States

Job Type: Part Time

Office Setting: Fully Remote

Remote: Yes

Compensation: Volunteer

Hours Per Week: 5 (flexible)

Role Mission

The Foster Dog Content Collector is responsible for gathering up to date information and media on foster dogs for purposes of accurate records and advertisement. They are the link between our foster families, who are taking care of our rescued dogs and the teams who advertise them. We do not have a kennel or building, and rely 100% on online platforms to advertise our dogs; requiring high quality and up to date content/media to attract potential adopters. Role is remote and five hours per week on your schedule.

What Winning Looks Like

Key Results Area #1 - Raw Content

  • Stays current on intakes and dogs in program

    • Special attention to long term residents

  • Point of contact between Foster Family and Dog Ad Pack

  • Proactively gathers content on all available dogs weekly via

    • Baserow forms

    • Social Media

    • Blink

Key Results Area #2 - Media Organization

  • Protects Baserow as source of authority

  • Uploads photos, videos and copy to Google Drive

  • Manages Master Dog Ads folders in Google Drive and keeps up to date

  • Archives adopted dog content

Needed Skills

Systematic. Reaches out to each foster family on a routine and scheduled basis

Organized. Keeps all media files organized within file and folder system

Has a desktop computer or tablet (phone will be too difficult to navigate spreadsheets)

Pleasantly persistent to those fosters who need extra motivation to complete forms

Unique Company Culture and Mission

Our Mission

At Path of Hope Rescue we save pregnant dogs and puppies from high kill shelters in the Southern United States.

Our Spokane, Washington based Rescue strives to decrease the euthanasia rate of high risk dogs in the southern United States by transporting pregnant dogs and puppies to the Pacific Northwest to find adoptive homes. We do not have a kennel or building location and are 100% foster based. We currently have two paid employees and rely heavily on volunteers and fosters as we work to build out our paid staff roles.

Our Vision.
Eliminating euthanasia of dogs in the South by decreasing the amount of dogs breeding unchecked and becoming the number one dog destination in Spokane by capitalizing on Spokanes love of Rescue Dogs.

Core Values:

Transparency - sharing the good with the bad

Community - dog loving people who treat each other well

Integrity - doing what you say will do

Golden Rule - treating others how you would want to be treated

Our Company Culture

We are freedom loving American Patriots who love dogs, freedom and God.

No NGO status here, we dont take a single penny from the government. We are 100% funded by small donors and our adoption program, with a few small private grants here and there. We built this organization from the ground up in 2018 with $87.

We are built tough and believe that hard work pays off. Were about rolling up our sleeves and taking responsibility for our own actions. We dont do drama. There are no victims here and the system isnt out to get you, the only thing standing in your way is you and your attitude. We reward merit, not DEI or pronouns. We dont bend to the cultural rot out there.

At the core of who we are, we love dogs. At PHR you will find people who recognize your dog before they recognize you. Where its normal for your dog to have his own Instagram and people who expect to be invited to your dogs birthday party. We are focused on building a strong, positive community, one dog and one person at a time.

We know dogs are family and should be treated that way. And we are driven by a shared passion to make sure every dog who isnt being loved, finds their way to a family. We care for each other and have created a community of people who love making a difference in this world.

Experience developing global medical information materials, e.g., scientific response documents (SRDs), frequently asked questions (FAQs), custom response documents (CRDs), etc.

About us:

Branch is on a mission to empower workers with financial freedom. We do this by helping companies accelerate payments and providing working Americans with accessible, free financial services. We’re committed to building and delivering more inclusive, transparent, and frictionless financial products.

Our goal of empowerment extends to our own employees, too. Have a great idea? Share it today and it might just get implemented tomorrow. As a member of our team, your voice and creativity matter—and they can directly impact our products, company, and culture.

We not only focus on attracting great talent from across the country, but also on building teams that help that talent thrive. That means valuing a diversity of opinions and working styles, while creating a shared belief in innovation, initiative, and winning together.

Come join our team as we develop new ways to improve the lives of working Americans.

About the role:

We are looking for a highly motivated and experienced Enterprise Account Executive to join our Marketplaces sales team. Branch is a leader in the marketplace payments space, with some of the largest labor and delivery marketplaces in the world — including Uber and Instacart — among our largest customers. In this role, you will be responsible for driving new business acquisition and revenue growth by selling our innovative FinTech solutions to enterprise-level clients. The ideal candidate has a proven track record of managing complex sales cycles, building strong relationships with C-level executives, and a deep understanding of the financial services industry.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Own and manage a named book of enterprise and upper‐mid‐market labor and seller marketplace clients to build strategic relationships at C-suite, VP, and director levels.
  • Lead full sales cycles, from inbound and outbound prospecting through contract negotiation and closing.
  • Partner closely with our embedded payments platform partner's sales organization to jointly identify, pursue, and manage shared accounts — driving co-sell and cross-sell opportunities and enabling their sellers to effectively position Branch within their deals.
  • Develop and execute comprehensive account plans to win new business and expand with existing clients.
  • Work cross‐functionally across Product, Finance, and Engineering to design and deliver custom solutions as part of a technical selling process.
  • Drive and refine the marketplace strategy: help define and scale repeatable engagement models, sales motions, and positioning for Branch’s platform offerings.
  • Use metrics and financial analysis to quantify value propositions and ROI for prospective clients.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to shape product roadmap based on client feedback, competitive landscape, and market demand.
  • Hit or exceed revenue targets, sales quotas, and other KPIs relevant to platform and enterprise deals.

Qualifications (required):

  • 5–8 years of experience in enterprise sales, preferably selling platforms, embedded finance, payments, or infrastructure solutions.
  • Have closed sizable ($500k+ ARR), complex deals (multi-stakeholder, multi-quarter cycles, including technical and non‐technical buyers).
  • Are comfortable engaging senior executives (CTOs, CFOs, COOs) as well as technical leaders (engineers, security / compliance).
  • Have strong product acumen and are capable of understanding and communicating both technical and financial value.
  • Are highly analytical — you know how to build business cases, model ROI, and use data to drive decisions.
  • Are self-motivated, resourceful, and can thrive in a fast‐moving environment that requires both strategic thinking and hands-on execution.
  • Are excellent communicators, both written and verbal.

Qualifications (preferred):

  • Previous experience in fintech, embedded finance, or payments infrastructure.
  • Experience selling into or working with HR technology and vertical SaaS platforms.
  • Familiarity with risk, regulatory, and compliance considerations in financial services.

Massive Rocket is a rapidly scaling Braze and Snowflake agency on a mission to transform how digital marketing, product, and engineering teams connect. In just five years, we’ve grown at speed and are now gearing up for our next big milestone: hitting $100M in revenue.
