The people who thrive here don’t just focus on their own remit — they understand the goals of the teams around them and actively contribute to the success of their colleagues, customers, and partners. We’re building a culture of ownership, collaboration, and growth, and we’re looking for people who want to make a real impact.

Who Are We Looking to Add to Our Team?

As a CRM Strategist at Massive Rocket, you’ll work hand‑in‑hand with our Principal CRM Strategist to shape and deliver CRM strategies that move the needle for our clients. You’ll help build strategic plans, translate them into clear, actionable initiatives, and ensure they’re handed over smoothly to the execution team so they can drive KPIs, performance, and measurable ROI.
You’ll play a key role in turning complex frameworks into simple, compelling narratives — the kind that teams can execute confidently and clients can rally behind. You’ll join client sessions throughout the Delivery Sales Lifecycle, helping uncover core challenges and contributing to data‑driven marketing strategies that make a real impact.
You’ll also support the creation of pitches that tell powerful stories through strategy, data, and insight. And you’ll run strategy sessions grounded in lifecycle thinking, best practices, and proven principles to help clients unlock long‑term success.

What Will You Do?

  • Turn complex frameworks into simple, compelling narratives that teams can execute confidently
  • Join client sessions throughout the Delivery Sales Lifecycle to uncover challenges and shape data‑driven strategies
  • Support the creation of pitches that tell powerful stories through strategy, data, and insight

  • Translate strategic recommendations into clear, actionable plans for execution teams
  • Contribute to measurable client success by aligning strategy with KPIs and ROI goals

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • 6+ years of hands‑on CRM experience, including at least 2 years in a dedicated CRM Strategy role within an agency, consultancy, or client‑side team
  • Strong working knowledge of leading CRM platforms such as Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, or HubSpot

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Rocket‑Fuelled Growth – Big challenges, fast learning, and the chance to level up quicker than anywhere else
  • A Culture That Actually Gives a Damn – Supportive, positive, and built around people who want to see you win

  • Real Career Momentum – Clear progression, real ownership, and space to grow into your next chapter

A Few Things to Know Before We Get Started

Bring Your Own Device – We operate a BYOD policy, so you’ll use your own kit for work
Right to Work – You’ll need a valid work visa; we’re not able to offer sponsorship at the moment
ID Checks – We may ask for proof of identity (passport, ID card, or a recent utility bill)

For Contractors – Proof of incorporation and up‑to‑date insurance is required

A Quick Note on Applications

We receive a high volume of applications, and while we’d love to reply to everyone personally, it’s not always possible. If you haven’t heard from us within two weeks, it sadly means you haven’t been successful this time. But don’t let that stop you—we’re growing fast, and new opportunities open up all the time.

Deine Erfahrung & Skills

About the Job:

LaunchDarkly is seeking a skilled Full-Stack Engineer to join our Experimentation team! You’ll collaborate closely with a cross-functional team of backend, frontend, and full-stack engineers, along with product managers, data scientists, and designers, to help build an experimentation platform that balances power and accessibility. In this role, you’ll contribute to the design, development, and maintenance of scalable, performant services using Go and RESTful APIs, and user experiences built with React and TypeScript. You’ll have opportunities to take ownership of projects, grow your technical expertise, and help improve the quality and reliability of our systems. We’re focused on building a best-in-class experimentation platform that enables customers to run impactful, data-driven experiments with ease and confidence, and we’re actively growing the team to deliver on this vision.

We are committed to delivering a leading experimentation platform that empowers our customers to run tests and data-driven experiments seamlessly and at scale. We have a robust product roadmap, and we are actively expanding our teams to execute on it.

Responsibilities:

  • Contribute to the design, development, and maintenance of scalable and performant solutions for experimentation and data-driven products, with attention to usability and maintainability.
  • Collaborate with senior engineers on architectural decisions that impact system scalability and performance.
  • Lead limited scope features from definition to deployment
  • Help identify and troubleshoot performance issues and participate in efforts to optimize service reliability.
  • Work closely with product managers, engineers, data scientists, and designers to implement new features and iterate on existing functionality.
  • Participate in code reviews to support code quality and share constructive feedback with teammates.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code that enhances the reusability and readability of team systems.
  • Contribute to the team’s efforts to improve observability, monitoring, and operational excellence.
  • Help investigate and resolve production issues, occasionally partnering with customer support or other teams as needed.
  • Collaborate across functions to align on priorities, surface blockers, and improve team workflows.
  • Learn from and support more senior engineers, and contribute to a culture of growth, inclusion, and continuous improvement.
  • Stay current with industry trends related to software development, experimentation, and backend technologies.
  • Demonstrate curiosity, creative thinking, and a proactive mindset in problem-solving.

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience building full stack web applications. Familiarity with Typescript, React, Node, and Go is preferred but not required.
  • Solid grasp of software engineering principles, design patterns, and coding best practices.
  • Exposure to building or maintaining scalable, production-grade systems.
  • Familiarity with observability practices and tools (e.g., logging, metrics, monitoring).
  • Experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) is a plus.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills with a team-oriented mindset.
  • Comfortable working in Agile development environments.
  • Experience with CI/CD practices and tools.
  • Passion for writing high-quality code and continuously improving engineering practices.
  • A self-motivated approach and willingness to take initiative.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
  • Prior experience working with or contributing to distributed teams is a plus.

About LaunchDarkly:

Modern software delivery was supposed to be the foundation for a thriving digital business but reality has proven otherwise. The LaunchDarkly platform helps developers innovate on new features faster while protecting them with a safety valve to instantly rewind when things go wrong. Developers can target product experiences to any customer segment and maximize the business impact of every feature. Команда Київстар.Тех в пошуку нового колеги або коліжанки на роль Business/System Analyst.

Про нас

Kyivstar.Tech — українська гібридна ІТ-компанія, резидент Дія.City. Ми є дочірньою компанією Київстар, одного з найбільших українських операторів зв’язку.

Наша місія — змінювати життя в Україні та світі, створюючи технологічні рішення і продукти, що реалізують потенціал компаній і потреби користувачів.

Понад 600 спеціалістів KS.Tech щодня працюють у різних сферах: мобільні та вебрішення, а також проєктування, розробка, підтримка та технічне обслуговування високопродуктивних систем і сервісів.

Ми віримо в інновації, що дійсно приносять якісні зміни, та постійно кидаємо виклик традиційним підходам і рішенням. Кожен із нас є адептом підприємницької культури, яка дозволяє ніколи не зупинятися, розвиватися і створювати нове.

Що ти будеш робити

  • Брати участь в розробці архітектурних рішень по впровадженню Маркетингових ініціатив (МА) і Продуктів у якості експерта/аналітика в білінговій системі
  • Надавати високорівневу оцінку складності змін для впровадження Продуктів
  • Аналізувати вимоги з замовниками, будувати та описувати схеми (class diagram, statechart diagram, sequence diagram, deployment diagram, component diagram та ін.) використовуючи формат запису BPMNv2, UML або інші підходи, пропонувати варіанти рішень та функціонал
  • Погоджувати зміни з замовниками та командою, котра відповідає за розробку Продуктів
  • Готувати технічну документацію (ТЗ) в Confluence. Відповідати за наповнення та підписання ТЗ що до технічної реалізації Продукту в системі BSS
  • Розробляти та деталізувати вимоги до функціоналу нового продукту для постачальника системи
  • Брати участь у внесенні змін до конфігурації системи
  • Оформлювати замовлення на доробки по системі Контролювати своєчасне і якісне впровадження вимог до функціоналу продукту відповідно до замовлень
  • Брати участь у процесі тестування впроваджених змін на системі та перевіряти їх відповідність вимогам замовника.
  • Аналізувати причини виникнення дефекту функціоналу Продукту
  • Деталізувати вимоги для виправлення дефекту або невідповідність реалізації бізнес вимогам
  • Погоджувати зміни з замовниками
  • Забезпечувати усунення дефектів підрядником

Яка кваліфікація та досвід необхідні

  • Не менше 2 років досвіду роботи в якості аналітика
  • Навички формування вимог до інформаційних систем відповідно потреб бізнесу, досвід впровадження в інформаційних системах нового функціоналу
  • Досвід ведення комунікації з підрядником
  • Впевнений користувач JIRA, Confluence
  • Знання офісних програм MsOffice. Бажано MS Project
  • Навички роботи з BPMN, UML

Ми пропонуємо

  • Офіс або ремоут — вирішувати тобі.
  • Ремоут онбординг
  • Перформанс бонуси для всіх (річні чи квартальні — залежить від ролі)
  • Навчаємо працівників: є безліч внутрішніх ресурсів і програм від партнерів, власна бібліотека
  • Страхування здоров’я і життя для працівників
  • Wellbeing-програма та корпоративний психолог
  • Компенсація витрат на мобільний зв’язок Київстар

With strong Canadian payroll expertise, this role serves as a trusted resource to clients implementing and using ERP and HR/payroll solutions in Canada, helping them establish
accurate, compliant, and efficient payroll processes.

The ideal candidate combines hands-on Canadian payroll experience with HR/payroll systems implementation and strong communication, analytical, and client service skills. They understand Canadian federal and provincial requirements and can translate those requirements into system configuration, business processes, and practical client guidance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner directly with clients to understand Canadian payroll and HR business processes, requirements, and objectives.
  • Support clients implementing and processing Canadian payroll within ERP and HR/payroll systems, providing guidance on system use, payroll regulations, and standard workflows.
  • Apply knowledge of Canadian payroll requirements and provincial nuances to help clients establish compliant payroll processes and system configurations.
  • Troubleshoot payroll and system issues, determine root causes, and escalate technical concerns as needed.
  • Provide proactive support during critical payroll cycles, including payroll deadlines, year-end reporting, and regulatory changes.
  • Conduct client trainings or refreshers on payroll tools, processes, Canadian payroll requirements, and system updates.
  • Collaborate internally with implementation teams to ensure smooth handoff from implementation to ongoing client support.
  • Stay current on Canadian payroll legislation, regulatory requirements, and technology platform enhancements to better serve client needs.
  • Maintain detailed and accurate client documentation, call notes, configurations, and case updates.

Minimum Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience working with Canadian payroll, with a strong understanding of Canadian payroll processes, requirements, and compliance.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of Canadian federal and provincial payroll requirements and the ability to apply those requirements within payroll or ERP systems.
  • Experience working with payroll and/or HR systems in an implementation, consulting, systems, or client-facing capacity.
  • Experience supporting or implementing payroll for Canadian organizations; experience working across multiple provinces is strongly preferred.
  • Familiarity with payroll platforms such as Paymate, ADP Canada, or similar; experience with Canadian payroll systems such as Rippling, Payworks, and Dayforce is a strong plus.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects or client implementations simultaneously while delivering high-quality results.
  • Comfortable working directly with clients through video, phone, email, and other remote collaboration tools.
  • Exceptional communication, analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Willingness and ability to learn new technology platforms and obtain Intacct and Sage HCM certifications.

Preferred Attributes

  • Experience with Canadian payroll within an ERP implementation or consulting environment.

Always Choose Exceptional | Lead with Integrity | Embody Respect and Care Deeply | Embrace Change and Innovation

ed with the company's growth objectives.

jobs.title: Field GTM Manager, Events and Community
jobs.excerpt: Quick highlights• Your goal: Turn the best ecommerce events and communities into 10–15 qualified demos each month.
jobs.description:
Quick highlights

  • Your goal: Turn the best ecommerce events and communities into 10–15 qualified demos each month.
  • Your field: Attend or host 3–4 focused events each month across North America.
  • Your audience: Ecommerce founders, operators, Heads of CX and agency leaders.
  • Your ownership: Choose the room, build the guest list, host the experience and turn conversations into pipeline.
  • Location: North America. Remote, with frequent travel across the US and Canada.
  • Reports to: Head of Partnerships. You will also work directly with Richpanel's CEO and sales team.
  • Company: Profitable, Sequoia-backed and growing 110% YoY at 8-figure ARR.
  • Compensation: $130,000–$155,000 base, 20% target bonus, meaningful stock options and benefits.

About Richpanel

Richpanel is the AI-native helpdesk.

Brands hire an AI support team that resolves repeat customer questions from start to finish. Their people stay in control of the moments that need judgment.

Richpanel replaces the old helpdesk and the next few support hires. The AI handles order tracking, returns, subscription changes and the repeat work that buries CX teams. Human agents handle the exceptions in the same workspace.

We are profitable, backed by Sequoia and growing 110% YoY at 8-figure ARR. We already serve 3,000+ paying brands.

We have built this with a small team. Your work will be visible in our pipeline and company growth every month.

About the role

The best deals rarely begin at a booth.

They begin at a private dinner, a founder retreat or a small room where the right operators speak honestly about what is not working.

Your job is to put Richpanel in those rooms and turn the right conversations into qualified demos.

You will find the events and communities where our buyers already gather. You will study attendee lists, invite target accounts, work with agency and technology partners, and host experiences people want to attend.

You will also own the commercial result. This is not a brand-awareness or event-logistics role. Your scorecard is qualified demos, pipeline and closed ARR.

What you will own

  • Attend or host 3–4 focused events each month.
  • Generate 10–15 qualified demos each month from the field.
  • Build the annual calendar of dinners, roundtables, retreats and community events.
  • Review attendee lists before we spend. Know which target accounts will be in the room.
  • Pre-book conversations with high-value prospects before each event.
  • Work with agencies, BPOs, technology partners and operator communities on joint events.
  • Own the guest experience from invitation through follow-up.
  • Host dinners, moderate discussions and make thoughtful introductions.
  • Follow up quickly and turn interest into held demos with the right stakeholders.
  • Keep event-sourced pipeline accurate in our CRM.
  • Measure cost per qualified demo, pipeline and closed ARR by event.
  • Build a repeatable playbook that tells us which rooms to return to and which ones to skip.

What counts as a qualified demo

A qualified demo is not a badge scan or a friendly chat.

It means:

  • The company fits Richpanel's target customer profile.
  • The buyer has a real customer-support problem worth solving.
  • A decision-maker or strong internal champion joins the meeting.
  • The buyer has agreed to evaluate Richpanel, not simply receive information.
  • The demo is held and accepted by the sales team.

Requirements

You may be a fit if

  • You have 3+ years in field GTM, events, community, business development, hospitality, brand marketing or a related customer-facing role.
  • You come from an arts, humanities, communications, hospitality, theatre, design or event-production background and know how to create an experience people remember.
  • You are a natural host. You notice who is standing alone, make introductions and help a room come alive.
  • You are also commercial. You have owned a pipeline, meetings or revenue target before.
  • You can show events that produced qualified sales conversations, not just attendance or social reach.
  • You write warm, personal invitations that busy founders want to answer.
  • You can speak with a founder, a Head of CX and an agency owner without sounding scripted.
  • You are organized enough to manage travel, vendors, guest lists, budgets and follow-up without dropping details.
  • You are comfortable travelling several times each month.
  • You take ownership. If an event is not producing meetings, you change the plan.

Strong signals

  • You have worked at an ecommerce brand, agency, BPO, Shopify app or customer-experience company.
  • You already know ecommerce founders, operators, agency leaders or community hosts.
  • You have run private dinners, executive roundtables, retreats or small conferences.
  • You have sold or generated pipeline for B2B SaaS.
  • You have moderated a panel, hosted a podcast, performed on stage or built a community.
  • You can show the exact path from an event to a held demo and closed deal.

This role is not for you if

  • You measure success through registrations, impressions, booth scans or LinkedIn posts.
  • You enjoy planning events but do not want a sales target.

• You wait for people to walk up to you.

  • You prefer large vendor conferences over small, focused rooms.
  • You need a detailed playbook before taking action.
  • You dislike frequent travel or fast follow-up.

What success looks like

In your first 30 days

  • Learn Richpanel's product, customers and target buyer.
  • Build a map of the communities, events and partners that reach our best prospects.
  • Create a six-month field calendar with a clear reason for every event.
  • Attend customer demos and learn how buyers describe their problems.
  • Build the first target-account and guest lists.

In your first 60 days

  • Attend or host 3–4 focused events in a month.
  • Generate your first 8–10 qualified demos.
  • Run at least one Richpanel-led dinner or roundtable.
  • Show clean event attribution and fast follow-up in the CRM.
  • Identify the events and communities we should stop funding.

In your first 90 days

  • Consistently generate 10–15 qualified demos each month.
  • Maintain a repeatable rhythm of 3–4 strong events per month.
  • Create measurable pipeline from field programs.
  • Build relationships with the partners and community leaders who can fill future rooms.
  • Own a field playbook that another teammate could follow.

Benefits

Why join Richpanel

  • Your work reaches revenue: You will see the demos, pipeline and customers created by the rooms you build.
  • Real ownership: You will own the field calendar, event choices, guest strategy and budget recommendations.
  • A product worth showing: Richpanel replaces both the old helpdesk and the next few support hires.
  • A strong starting point: Referrals, partners, podcasts and events already create most of our best opportunities.
  • Direct access: You will work closely with the CEO, partnerships and sales.
  • A small team: Good ideas move quickly. There are few layers between a decision and the result.
  • Long-term upside: You receive stock options in a profitable, 8-figure ARR company growing 110% YoY.

Compensation

  • Base salary: $130,000–$155,000 USD, based on experience and location.
  • Target performance bonus: 20% of base salary.
  • Target cash compensation: $156,000–$186,000 USD.
  • Equity: Meaningful stock options with 4-year vesting.
  • Benefits: Paid time off, learning support, company offsites and the tools you need to work remotely.

Your bonus rewards held qualified demos and sourced pipeline. Closed ARR adds upside, but you are not penalized for sales work outside your control.

How we work

  • Customer obsession: Put the buyer's interests first. Never push someone into a meeting that is not useful.
  • Curiosity: Learn how ecommerce operators work and why they buy.
  • Drive: Own the number. Find a way through when the first plan fails.
  • Taste: Create thoughtful experiences, not noisy events.
  • Integrity: Report the real result, even when an event misses.

Interview process

We aim to finish the process within two weeks.

1. Past-results conversation: Walk us through an event or field program you owned. Bring the targets, spend, meetings, pipeline and lessons.

2. Field plan: Build a 30-day plan for reaching ecommerce founders and Heads of CX through 3–4 events.

3. Hosting exercise: Lead a short roundtable discussion and show how you turn it into natural follow-up.

4. Final conversation: Meet the CEO and the people you will work with across partnerships and sales.

How to apply

Send us:

  • The best event or community experience you have created.

• The commercial result it produced.

  • Three ecommerce communities or events you believe Richpanel should enter.
  • A short note on why this role fits the way you work.

If you have a portfolio, event recap, video, podcast, campaign or writing sample, include it. We care more about proof and judgment than a perfect resume.

About Richpanel

Richpanel is the AI-native helpdesk.

Brands hire an AI support team that resolves repeat customer questions from start to finish. Their people stay in control of the moments that need judgment.

Richpanel replaces the old helpdesk and the next few support hires. The AI handles order tracking, returns, subscription changes and the repeat work that buries CX teams. Human agents handle the exceptions in the same workspace.

About the role

The best partner managers do not collect logos.

They know which 20 relationships matter. They understand the partner's business, earn trust and create a clear reason to recommend the product.

Your job is to make Richpanel the helpdesk that Shopify agencies, BPOs and CX consultants recommend first.

You will own the full motion. Find the right partners, open the relationship, learn their clients, teach them how Richpanel creates value and work the first deals together.

You will go deep on the product. A development agency, BPO and retention consultant each need a different reason to recommend Richpanel. You will build those talk tracks from customer demos, product knowledge and partner feedback.

You will also own the number. Your primary target is partner-sourced closed ARR. Meetings, events and enablement matter only when they produce revenue.

What you will own

  • Build a named map of the top Shopify agencies, BPOs and CX consultants in North America.
  • Bring existing relationships and open senior conversations quickly.
  • Choose the 20–30 partners that deserve high-touch investment.
  • Recruit, enable and activate those partners against a shared revenue plan.

  • Build warm introductions through customers, other partners and the Shopify ecosystem.
  • Run joint account mapping, co-selling, dinners, roundtables and focused community events.
  • Help partners qualify opportunities before they reach sales.
  • Stay involved in large deals until the customer closes and launches successfully.
  • Create partner tiers, cadences, enablement and clear rules for high-touch support.
  • Automate onboarding, payouts, deal registration and long-tail communication.
  • Track partner momentum. Re-engage partners before the relationship goes cold.
  • Keep attribution and partner-sourced pipeline accurate in the CRM.
  • Report qualified demos, win rate, closed ARR and partner concentration every month.

What a strong partner looks like

A strong partner does more than sign an agreement.

They:

  • Advise Shopify brands that fit Richpanel's target customer profile.
  • Influence helpdesk, AI, BPO or CX operating decisions.
  • Understand the client's support workflow and unit economics.
  • Can explain why Richpanel fits the client's problem.
  • Bring decision-makers into a qualified sales conversation.
  • Stay involved through evaluation, migration and launch.
  • Produce repeat referrals, not one introduction.

Requirements

You may be a fit if

  • You have 5+ years in partnerships, channel sales, agency growth or ecommerce SaaS.
  • You have owned a closed revenue target and can show the result.
  • You know senior leaders at Shopify agencies, BPOs or CX consultancies.
  • You can name the first 20 partners you would evaluate for Richpanel.
  • You understand how agencies make money and what earns their recommendation.
  • You learn products deeply enough to teach and sell them.
  • You can turn one product into distinct stories for different partner types.
  • You are comfortable joining discovery, demos and commercial calls.
  • You can host a dinner, work a conference and follow up before the flight home.
  • You are analytical. You know which partners create revenue and which create noise.
  • You can build the systems behind the relationships.
  • You move quickly without waiting for a complete playbook.

Strong signals

  • You have led a brand, agency book, ecommerce function or commercial P&L.
  • You have worked at a Shopify app, ecommerce agency, BPO or customer experience company.
  • You have generated meaningful ARR through agency or consultant referrals.
  • Your partners can sell without asking you to join every call.
  • You have built partner tiers, health scores, enablement and referral workflows.
  • You have created joint events that led to qualified opportunities.
  • Customers and partners describe you as commercially sharp and easy to trust.
  • Former managers can verify the numbers you claim.

This role is not for you if

  • You measure success through signed agreements, calls or partner logos.
  • Your network exists only as LinkedIn connections.
  • You prefer broad partner recruitment over deep focus.
  • You need marketing to create every message and asset for you.
  • You avoid product demos or commercial conversations.
  • You wait for partners to send referrals on their own.
  • You report influenced pipeline when the role owns closed ARR.
  • You dislike frequent travel, events or fast follow-up.

What success looks like

In your first 30 days

  • Learn Richpanel's product, target customer and competitive position.
  • Join customer demos and listen to how buyers describe their problems.
  • Audit the current partner book, pipeline, tiers and attribution.
  • Build a named list of the first 30 high-potential partners.
  • Define the partner-specific story for agencies, BPOs and CX consultants.

In your first 60 days

  • Open senior conversations with the highest-value partners in your network.
  • Build joint plans with the first 5–8 focus partners.
  • Run tailored enablement for each partner type.
  • Complete the first account-mapping and co-selling sessions.
  • Create a clear weekly view of partner momentum and next actions.

In your first 90 days

  • Generate 10+ qualified partner demos in a month.
  • Close the first partner-sourced ARR against your target.
  • Activate 8–10 focus partners with live opportunities.
  • Run one focused partner or merchant event that creates qualified pipeline.
  • Show which partners deserve more investment and which should move to automation.

In your first 6 months

  • Build 20–30 active, high-value partner relationships.
  • Reach 20+ qualified partner demos each month.
  • Maintain a 50%+ win rate on qualified partner referrals.
  • Put the partner channel on a clear path to 30–40% of new ARR.
  • Build a playbook another partner manager can follow.

Benefits

Why join Richpanel

  • The channel already works: You are scaling proven partner demand, not testing a theory.
  • The number matters: Your work appears directly in demos, pipeline and closed ARR.
  • Real ownership: You choose the partners, motion, cadences and investments.
  • Direct access: You work closely with the CEO, partnerships, sales and product.
  • A product worth learning: Richpanel replaces both the old helpdesk and the next few support hires.
  • A small team: Good ideas move quickly. There are few layers between a decision and the result.
  • Long-term upside: You receive stock options in a profitable, 8-figure ARR company growing 110% YoY.

Compensation

  • Base salary: $145,000–$165,000 USD, based on experience and location.

• Target variable: $50,000–$55,000 USD.

  • Target cash compensation: $195,000–$220,000 USD.
  • Equity: Meaningful stock options with 4-year vesting.
  • Benefits: Paid time off, learning support, company offsites and the tools you need to work remotely.

Variable compensation is based primarily on partner-sourced closed ARR. Qualified pipeline and partner win rate support the scorecard, but activity does not replace revenue.

How we work

  • Customer obsession: Recommend Richpanel only when it is right for the customer.

Interview process

How to apply

Operating in a technically complex, compliance-heavy environment where clients are navigating FICA, POPIA, and evolving KYC/AML obligations, the Senior Partnership Manager must combine deep industry knowledge, strong executive presence, and a clear understanding of how biometric identity verification creates value in the banking and financial services sector. jobs.excerpt: It all starts with the mission: NVISO is here to protect European society from potentially devastating cyber attacks!
jobs.description:
It all starts with the mission: NVISO is here to protect European society from potentially devastating cyber attacks! This means we offer cyber security services to private and governmental organizations to help them better prepare for, prevent, detect and respond to cyber security incidents.

All of this is built on four fundamental values that define who we are: We are Proud, We Break Barriers, We Care and No BS!

Tasks

As a Microsoft Purview Sr. Consultant, you will help our customers protect, govern and ensure compliance on the use of their data. Working alongside senior Purview experts, you will translate business, legal and regulatory requirements into concrete Microsoft Purview configurations across Microsoft 365 and Azure. You will spend most of your time hands-on: configuring sensitivity labels, deploying Data Loss Prevention policies, setting up retention rules and tuning classifications, always with a strong focus on user experience and operational stability.

This role is a natural next step for security consultants with 3 – 4 years of IT security experience who want to specialize in Microsoft data security and compliance. You will grow through customer engagements, coaching from more senior colleagues and continuous learning, with a clear path towards a Purview Expert role.

You will contribute to Microsoft Purview projects across the full delivery lifecycle. Your day-to-day tasks will typically include:

  • Classification & Labelling: Configure and deploy sensitivity labels, sensitive information types and auto-labelling policies in Microsoft Purview, based on designs prepared with other consultants. Support pilot rollouts and iterate based on user feedback.
  • Data Loss Prevention (DLP): Implement DLP policies across Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams and endpoints. Tune rules to balance protection with usability, analyse alerts and reduce false positives.
  • Data Retention & Records Management: Build retention labels and policies that map to the customer’s legal, regulatory and contractual obligations. Assist in disposition reviews and lifecycle management scenarios.
  • Insider Risk & Compliance Monitoring: Assist in configuring Insider Risk Management, Communication Compliance and audit / eDiscovery use cases, and help operational teams interpret the resulting signals.
  • Integration with the Microsoft Security Stack: Configure the interactions between Purview and Defender for Cloud Apps, Defender for Endpoint and Microsoft Entra, contributing to an end-to-end Defender XDR data protection story.
  • Documentation & Handover: Produce clear design documents, configuration baselines, runbooks and knowledge transfer material so that customer teams can operate the solution after go-live.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with customer stakeholders (IT, Security, Legal, DPO, Compliance) as well as internal NVISO teams to gather requirements, validate designs and demo solutions.
  • Support & Continuous Improvement: Provide second-line support on Purview deployments, be familiar8 with the Microsoft Purview roadmap and related technologies and continuously improve the delivery approach and reusable material.

Requirements

  • You hold citizenship in one of the 32 NATO member states.
  • 3 – 4 years of professional experience in IT security, including exposure to Microsoft 365. Azure or cloud security in general is considered a plus.
  • Purviewhands-on experience with at least one year working with Microsoft Purview capabilities: sensitivity labels, DLP, retention, eDiscovery, Insider Risk and/or Data Governance; in a customer or enterprise environment.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Data Science or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Technical skills

  • Solid working knowledge of the Microsoft 365 platform (Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Teams) and a good understanding of the Microsoft Entra identity model.
  • Familiarity with the Microsoft Purview portal and its core solutions: Information Protection, Data Loss Prevention, Data Lifecycle Management and Records Management.
  • Understanding ofhow Purview integrates with Defender for Cloud Apps, Defender for Endpoint and the broader Defender XDR ecosystem.
  • Basic scripting skills in PowerShell (Exchange Online, Security & Compliance) to automate deployment, reporting and troubleshooting tasks.
  • Regulatory & Domain Knowledge
  • Working knowledge of data protection regulations such as GDPR, and awareness of frameworks like NIS2, ISO/IEC 27001 and DORA and how they translate into data protection controls.
  • Ability to translate legal and business requirements into concrete data classification, DLP and retention rules.

Soft skills

  • Strong communicationskills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and to write clear documentation.
  • Excellent English communication skills, both verbal and written.
  • A consulting mindset: curious, structured, customer-focused and comfortable working on several engagements in parallel.

Benefits

What do we offer

At NVISO, we care. We are committed to offering you a highly competitive remuneration package including financial and non-financial components:

  • A training budget of 10.000€ and 10 days every 2 years.
  • Working and learning from the best people in the European cyber security industry. We have multiple SANS Instructors working at NVISO, our staff has presented at popular hacking conferences (BlackHat, BruCON, OWASP, etc) and all of our technical staff can acquire deep technical security certifications (GSE, GXPN, GREM, GCFA, OSCP, etc).
  • An entrepreneurial and agile company, where you will be stimulated and supported in driving new initiatives (either through internal innovation or by improving our service offering), without losing sight of having fun!
  • Our commitment to coach and counsel you and help you grow; each employee receives a personal coach within the team, whose role is to ensure your well-being and helps you grow in your career!
  • Flexible working model and home office possibilities (+working abroad options).
  • Monthly Allowances;
  • Statutory leave plus 5 additional leave days by NVISO.

IF YOU’RE INTERESTED, PLEASE SEND US YOUR APPLICATION!

WE’RE LOOKING FORWARD TO MEETING YOU!

Please be aware that the creation and submission of application documents (e.g. CV, cover letter, case studies, etc.) using AI-powered tools is only permitted to a limited extent.

jobs.title: Global Technical Manager - Business Assurance, Certification
jobs.excerpt: Minimum eligibility criteria: This is a senior global certification leadership role.
jobs.description:
Minimum eligibility criteria:
This is a senior global certification leadership role. Appointment requires demonstrable, current and substantial experience in management system certification at global or multi-region level, including leadership of geographically dispersed, culturally diverse technical teams and accountability for accreditation strategy, technical decision-making and network-wide implementation.

The role reports to the Global Head of Certification (QHSE), Product & Quality Management for Business Assurance.

Please note that this is a fully remote role, and we only welcome applications from candidates who have a valid work permit in their country of residence.

Role purpose:

The Global Technical Manager provides senior technical and accreditation leadership for the Business Assurance Certification business. The role sets, maintains and enforces the technical framework, accreditation strategy, certification policies and governance controls that determine consistent, compliant and commercially effective service delivery across the SGS affiliate network.

The post-holder is expected to operate with the credibility, judgement and seniority required to influence senior business leaders, represent SGS with Accreditation Bodies and make final technical decisions where certification, accreditation, impartiality, integrity or business risk issues arise.

Primary accountabilities:

  • Set the global technical and accreditation strategy for Business Assurance Certification in consultation with the Global Head of Certification and relevant business leadership.
  • Lead, develop and manage global technical and accreditation functions, including direct and indirect leadership of product, technical and accreditation specialists located across multiple countries and regions.
  • Define, approve and enforce global certification policies, technical requirements, accreditation controls and operating standards across the affiliate network.
  • Provide authoritative technical direction to the certification business, including final decision-making where disputes, interpretation issues or material compliance risks arise.
  • Manage strategic relationships with global and local Accreditation Bodies, ensuring confidence in SGS integrity, competence, impartiality, governance and global operating model.
  • Ensure technical and accreditation requirements are implemented in a way that protects compliance, supports consistent service delivery and enables commercially viable operations.
  • Represent the Business Assurance Division externally, and act as delegate for the Global Head of Certification where required.
  • Lead investigations and corrective action governance for material technical, accreditation or integrity failures within affiliates, ensuring effective restoration of compliant independent operation.
  • Drive simplification, digitalisation and continuous improvement of technical processes, systems and delivery models, including future audit delivery approaches and technical review efficiencies.

Specific responsibilities:

  • Provide senior-level contribution to the strategic direction of the Business Assurance Certification business.
  • Act as lead advisor to business management on certification, accreditation, impartiality, technical governance, integrity and business risk matters.
  • Maintain expert knowledge of core accreditation and certification requirements, including ISO/IEC 17021-1, ISO/IEC 17065 where applicable, IAF, EA and other relevant regional or product-specific requirements.
  • Interpret external accreditation requirements and convert them into clear, practical and enforceable internal policies, procedures, tools and controls.
  • Oversee global accreditation activities and support affiliates in maintaining, extending or defending local accreditations.
  • Directly or indirectly support key Accreditation Body relationships and activities, including UKAS, ANAB, SAS and other local or product-specific Accreditation Bodies as applicable.
  • Resolve technical, accreditation, operational and commercial conflicts across the network, balancing compliance, impartiality and business impact.
  • Work with operations, sales, IT, product groups and regional teams to define core systems and ensure adoption of global best practice.
  • Identify improvement opportunities in procedures, systems, governance controls, competence frameworks and technical support processes.
  • Support development of new certification products and services by ensuring technical feasibility, accreditation alignment and operational readiness.
  • Maintain responsibility for technical direction and leadership of specific certification products or schemes as required.

Required profile - essential:

  • Graduate-level qualification or equivalent professional experience in a relevant technical, scientific, engineering, management system, commercial or governance discipline.
  • Minimum 10 years of relevant certification and/or accreditation experience, including significant management system certification experience in an accredited third-party certification environment.
  • Substantial global or multi-region certification leadership experience. Experience limited to a single country, single affiliate, consultancy-only environment or narrow technical discipline is not sufficient for this role.
  • Proven experience leading geographically dispersed and culturally diverse technical teams, including direct or matrix management of senior specialists across multiple countries or regions.
  • Demonstrable track record of setting or enforcing technical policy, accreditation strategy, certification governance controls or network-wide requirements at regional or global level.
  • Strong technical command of management system certification and accreditation requirements, including impartiality, competence, audit delivery, certification decision-making and Accreditation Body expectations.
  • Credibility to engage with senior business leaders, Accreditation Bodies and technical experts, and to make well-reasoned decisions under pressure where there is commercial, accreditation or integrity risk.
  • Commercial judgement sufficient to ensure compliant service delivery remains efficient, scalable and aligned with business objectives.
  • Fluent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate complex technical requirements clearly to senior leaders and operational teams.

Required skills and behaviours:

  • Senior technical leadership and sound professional judgement.
  • Strategic outlook with the ability to translate technical and accreditation requirements into practical business solutions.
  • High-impact influencing skills across a matrix organisation, including the ability to challenge senior stakeholders constructively.
  • Strong people leadership, coaching and performance management capability for senior technical professionals.
  • Ability to manage conflict, competing priorities and ambiguity without compromising certification integrity or accreditation compliance.
  • Change management capability, including leading adoption of new systems, procedures and working practices across a global network.
  • Innovation mindset and ability to challenge established practice where simplification, digitalisation or risk reduction is possible.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including executive-level briefing, external representation and clear policy drafting.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and willingness to work with digital certification, workflow and reporting tools.
  • Flexibility to travel internationally as required by Accreditation Body, leadership, governance or network support activities.

Desirable experience:

  • Senior role within SGS, another global Certification Body or an Accreditation Body.
  • Lead auditor, technical reviewer, certification decision-maker, trainer or scheme manager experience in accredited third-party management system certification.
  • Experience implementing significant change to certification systems, competence frameworks, technical review processes, audit delivery models or accreditation governance.
  • Experience leading or supporting digital transformation, automation, remote audit delivery or AI-enabled process improvement within certification or conformity assessment.
  • Additional languages relevant to the SGS network or Accreditation Body engagement.

Why SGS?

  • Global and very stable company, world leader in the TIC (Testing, Inspection and Certification) industry.
  • Flexible schedule and hybrid/remote model.
  • SGS university and Campus for continuos learning options.
  • Multinational environment where you will work with colleagues from multiple continents.
  • Benefits platform.

Join Us: At SGS we believe in innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. We offer a supportive and inclusive work environment that encourages professional growth and personal development.

We are SGS – the world's leading testing, inspection and certification company. We are recognized as the global benchmark for sustainability, quality and integrity. Our 99,600 employees operate a network of 2,600 offices and laboratories, working together to enable a better, safer and more interconnected world.

At SGS, we have an open corporate and international culture. We offer a dynamic work environment in a leading global company. Our high professional standards and our sustainability approach guarantee you a future-oriented work environment. We invest in our employees for the long term and are committed to supporting your development within the company. Our business principles include: Integrity, Health, Safety & Environment, Quality & Professionalism, Respect, Sustainability, and Leadership.

jobs.title: Head of International Alliances
jobs.excerpt: Head of International AlliancesThe CompanyTurbineOne builds AI-powered software for frontline operators working in defense, national security, and tactical environments.
jobs.description:
Head of International Alliances

The Company

TurbineOne builds AI-powered software for frontline operators working in defense, national security, and tactical environments. Our Frontline Perception System (FPS) helps teams process and act on critical information in low-connectivity, real-world conditions.

We’re a fast-moving DefenseTech startup building products that matter in mission-critical environments.

Team: Growth
Location: Europe / Remote
Reports to: Chief Growth Officer

The Role

As Head of International Alliances, you will lead TurbineOne's strategy for identifying, evaluating, building, onboarding, enabling, managing, and scaling strategic partnerships that accelerate growth across Europe and MENA. You'll be responsible for expanding our ecosystem across defense primes, technology companies, systems integrators, OEMs, and venture-backed DefenseTech innovators. This is a leadership role that directly supports revenue generation by improving market access, strengthening customer propositions, enabling joint pursuits, and helping TurbineOne's sales organization create, advance, and win opportunities.

To excel in this role, you should thrive on analyzing markets, decoding competitive dynamics, identifying mutually beneficial alliances, and turning those relationships into measurable commercial outcomes. You will work side-by-side with Sales and collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Legal, Government Relations, and Executive Leadership. Prior experience as a direct, quota-carrying salesperson is required so that you understand firsthand what sales teams need from a partner, how complex defense opportunities progress, and how partnerships should contribute to pipeline and revenue without competing with Sales for customer ownership.

Primary Responsibilities

Partnership Program

  • Launch & Scale: Own the end-to-end development and execution of TurbineOne's international partnership program, with primary responsibility for Europe and MENA.

  • Target High-Value Alliances: Identify and secure technology, channel, integration, distribution, manufacturing, and strategic partners that improve customer access, market reach, technical differentiation, or probability of win.

  • Develop the European and MENA Ecosystem: Forge deep, long-term relationships with European defense primes, systems integrators, OEMs, emerging DefenseTech companies, and relevant government and NATO innovation organizations.

  • Team with Sales: Build partnerships around specific commercial objectives, target accounts, programs, and pursuits that help TurbineOne sales teams create qualified pipeline, gain customer access, and improve win probability.

  • Build for the Future: Establish scalable partnership processes, systems, governance, playbooks, and operating models that can support future regional or sector-focused partner managers.

Partnership Diligence

  • Lead and coordinate commercial and strategic diligence for prospective European and MENA partnerships.

  • Evaluate partner capabilities, reputation, technical fit, financial stability, genuine customer access, competitive positioning, incentives, and execution risk.

  • Coordinate cross-functional technical, operational, legal, contracts, security, compliance, financial, and business reviews prior to partnership approval.

  • Develop Go/No-Go recommendations and executive decision briefings that clearly articulate the expected strategic and commercial value of each partnership.

Commercial Execution

  • Structure and negotiate partnership frameworks including:

    • NDAs

    • Teaming Agreements

    • Memorandums of Understanding

    • Reseller Agreements

    • Distribution Agreements

    • Strategic Alliance Agreements

  • Work with contracts, legal, and outside counsel (as appropriate) to document, review, and finalize agreements.

  • Build repeatable partnership playbooks, onboarding processes, governance models, sales-facing rules of engagement, and success metrics tied to pipeline, customer access, and partner performance.

Market Expansion

  • Expand TurbineOne's reach across priority European and MENA defense markets through strategic partnerships that complement the direct sales motion.

  • Identify priority countries, defense programs, customer segments, and opportunities where a partner can materially accelerate access, contracting, integration, or adoption.

  • Develop partner enablement strategies that empower partners to accurately position, support, and grow TurbineOne while preserving clear customer and opportunity ownership with the sales organization.

  • Establish and progress joint go-to-market planning, co-selling, demonstrations, capture efforts, proposals, and marketing initiatives tied to specific customers, programs, and measurable commercial outcomes.

In a Typical Week You Will

  • Evaluate and Initiate Strategic Alliances: Meet with a prospective European or MENA prime, integrator, or OEM to assess whether the relationship can materially improve TurbineOne’s access, positioning, or probability of success on priority opportunities.

  • Execute Due Diligence: Validate market access, customer networks, reputation, competitive conflicts, incentives, and operational execution capabilities before recommending investment in a partner.

  • Build Executive Recommendations: Synthesize diligence into structured Go/No-Go recommendations that define strategic rationale, commercial objectives, risks, and expected contribution to TurbineOne’s growth.

  • Negotiate Key Agreements: Review, structure, and negotiate NDAs, teaming agreements, reseller agreements, and other partnership frameworks that protect IP, customer relationships, and TurbineOne’s long-term commercial interests.

  • Align with Engineering: Partner cross-functionally with Engineering to evaluate integration feasibility with partner platforms.

  • Build and Execute Joint Go-to-Market Plans: Work with Sales to develop partner-supported account, pursuit, co-selling, demonstration, and capture plans that accelerate qualified pipeline and improve win probability.

  • Manage Ongoing Partner Relationships: Lead periodic business reviews with active partners to assess joint pipeline, account activity, enablement, performance, risks, and future milestones.

  • Support Sales and Proposal Efforts: Work with Sales, Capture, and Proposal teams to coordinate partner participation in customer engagements and craft compelling multi-company proposals.

  • Communicate with Executive Leadership: Review the prospective and active partnership portfolio, including partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, performance, risks, and strategic opportunities across Europe.

  • Establish Best Practices: Create and curate partner competencies, playbooks, onboarding materials, enablement assets, and rules of engagement that make the partnership function easy for Sales to use.

Desired Experience

  • 10+ years in Strategic Partnerships, Business Development, Alliance Management, Sales, or related commercial leadership roles, with meaningful responsibility for international markets.

  • Significant experience within the defense, national security, aerospace, or DefenseTech ecosystem; direct DefenseTech experience is strongly preferred over general enterprise technology experience.

  • Prior experience as a direct, quota-carrying salesperson with personal responsibility for pipeline development, opportunity management, forecasting, and revenue attainment.

  • Demonstrated understanding of how complex defense technology sales progress from initial customer engagement through evaluation, capture, procurement, negotiation, and award.

  • Demonstrated success identifying, activating, building, and managing strategic partnerships that contribute to measurable pipeline, revenue, customer access, or program wins.

  • Meaningful experience working across European defense markets (MENA a plus), including familiarity with defense primes, systems integrators, OEMs, national procurement environments, and industry teaming structures.

  • Strong understanding of international business development, distribution models, channel partnerships, joint go-to-market motions, and how partners should support—not replace—the direct sales organization.

  • Experience structuring and reviewing U.S. and international commercial agreements such as NDAs, teaming agreements, reseller agreements, distribution agreements, and strategic alliance agreements.

  • Working knowledge of ITAR, export controls, intellectual property considerations, government contracting compliance, and other requirements relevant to international defense business.

Expectations

  • You're a builder who takes the initiative to create scalable partnership programs from the ground up in markets where TurbineOne may not yet have an established presence.

  • You think strategically but execute tactically, and you evaluate partnerships by their ability to create measurable commercial value rather than activity alone.

  • You have personally carried a quota and understand what Sales needs from a partner, while remaining disciplined about role clarity and customer ownership.

  • You naturally connect people, organizations, and ideas into mutually beneficial partnerships—and know how to distinguish genuine market access from superficial relationships.

  • You collaborate across Sales, technical, legal, and business teams to solve complex problems and support customer outcomes.

  • You are comfortable with ambiguity, extensive European and MENA travel, startup speed, and continuously improving processes as TurbineOne scales internationally.

  • Above all, you're motivated by helping deliver transformative AI capabilities into the hands of those operating on the front lines.

jobs.description:
Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.
We are looking for a skilled individual to join our rapidly growing team at Bluelight. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where everyone's opinions and efforts are valued and appreciated. You will have the opportunity to contribute to challenging and meaningful projects, developing high-quality applications that stand out in the market. We value continuous learning, personal growth, and hard work, offering a collaborative environment that promotes professional development. If you are passionate about software development and eager to be part of a growing software consultancy, we invite you to apply and join us on this exciting journey.

What You'll Do

  • Execute high-volume outbound prospecting daily (80–150+ activities/day) via cold calls, cold email, LinkedIn, and SMS
  • Use HubSpot to manage daily outreach including call tasks, email cadences, and follow-ups
  • Build and manage targeted prospect lists using Apollo and Clay, aligned with Bluelight's ideal customer profile
  • Run structured multi-touch outbound sequences in Instantly to engage prospects and drive responses
  • Leverage ZoomInfo to research accounts, identify key decision-makers, and enrich prospect data
  • Write and send high-converting outbound emails and LinkedIn messages with strong personalization and clear calls-to-action
  • Initiate outbound conversations with confidence, clearly communicating Bluelight's value proposition within the first few seconds
  • Qualify prospects based on defined criteria (budget, authority, need, timeline) and identify real sales opportunities
  • Handle objections effectively and position Bluelight as a solution to prospects' software and technology needs
  • Book qualified discovery calls for Account Executives and ensure strong show rates through proper follow-up
  • Accurately log all activities, notes, and pipeline updates in HubSpot
  • Continuously improve messaging and outreach strategies based on results
  • Meet or exceed KPIs including daily activity targets, conversations, meetings booked, and pipeline contribution

What We're Looking For

  • Required: Hands-on experience with Apollo, Clay, Instantly, and ZoomInfo (candidates without direct working experience in all four of these tools will not be considered)
  • Proven experience in B2B sales or inside sales roles, preferably within technology or software industries
  • Strong negotiation skills with the ability to influence decision-makers confidently
  • Familiarity with CRM software such as Salesforce or similar platforms
  • Experience in telemarketing or outbound calling campaigns is highly desirable
  • Excellent communication skills in English, both verbal and written, with a customer service-oriented approach
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a team environment

Nice to Have

  • Experience using AI tools to streamline workflows and improve outreach performance

What Success Looks Like

  • Hitting daily activity and meeting targets
  • Generating high-quality, qualified meetings
  • Building a consistent and predictable pipeline
  • Clearly communicating Bluelight's value

Company Benefits

  • Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.
  • Generous paid-time-off policy
  • Flexible working hours
  • Work remotely
  • Continuing education, training, conferences
  • Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications
Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.
You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!
If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply.

jobs.title: Senior Support Engineer
jobs.excerpt: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps.
jobs.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Support Engineer at GitLab, you'll sit at the intersection of Support and Engineering, helping customers solve complex, real-world challenges while running GitLab in diverse and demanding environments. You'll join the Engineering department and work directly with customers as they encounter edge cases. You'll dig into Linux systems, logs, and our Ruby on Rails codebase to troubleshoot performance issues, reproduce bugs, and contribute merge requests that fix problems at the source.

You'll also improve our documentation, refine support processes in our issue tracker, and collaborate closely with Product, Development, Infrastructure, Customer Success, and Sales so customer feedback directly shapes our roadmap. In your first year, you'll build deep expertise across a range of GitLab implementations, strengthen our ability to keep customers productive on both self-managed GitLab and GitLab.com software as a service, and help create tools and content that make support more efficient and effective for the entire team.

Some examples of our projects:

  • A tool to automatically check a GitLab Omnibus install for known issues
  • A solution to capture the state of a customer’s server for easier troubleshooting
  • A tool which turns log files into interactive tables to easily sort and filter columns
  • A ChatOps feature that makes it easier to identify user accounts on GitLab.com

What you’ll do

  • Act as an escalation point for difficult customer interactions and lead the resolution of complex issues through Zendesk tickets, merge requests, email, and video calls.
  • Mentor and guide teammates on complex troubleshooting and customer communication through pairing sessions and cross-team collaboration.
  • Advocate for and drive improvements to support practices, product quality, and reusable documentation and support content that directly influence team objectives.
  • Collaborate with Product, Development, Infrastructure, Customer Success, and Sales teams to shape product goals, roadmaps, and priorities while driving fixes and new features.
  • Participate in regular weekday and weekend on-call rotations during daytime hours, providing emergency support for self-managed GitLab and software as a service customers and coordinating incident communications with the GitLab.com Production team.
  • Participate in hiring by reviewing applications and assessments and joining interviews to help grow the Support team.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience owning complex, customer-facing technical cases from initial contact through triage, reproduction, bug reporting, resolution, and clear customer communication, including difficult or escalated interactions.
  • Strong experience with Linux systems administration, scripting, Git, and continuous integration and continuous delivery in production or customer environments, with the ability to investigate issues at both the infrastructure and application levels.
  • Ability to mentor teammates on complex troubleshooting and customer communication through pairing sessions, case reviews, and cross-team collaboration.
  • Experience collaborating with Product, Engineering, and Sales teams to turn customer feedback into product fixes, feature improvements, and roadmap priorities.
  • Familiarity with DevOps practices and technologies such as Kubernetes and serverless computing, and an understanding of how different GitLab implementations operate and affect customers.
  • Demonstrated ability to learn, collaborate across teams, and apply transferable skills from related technical support or engineering roles.

About the team

We're a globally distributed group of Support Engineers across the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa, and Asia-Pacific. We work asynchronously and stay connected through pairing sessions, one-on-one meetings, coffee chats, and Slack. We structure our shifts to support our personal lives while meeting customer needs. Thanks to GitLab’s transparency value, you can see what we are working on and how we operate on our Support Team page.

jobs.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As an AI Transformation Owner at GitLab, you'll shape your function's AI strategy and build the solutions that deliver it. You are the person responsible for identifying where AI can fundamentally change how your org operates, partnering with your Executive Sponsor to align on the biggest challenges, and driving measurable outcomes against them.

Think of this as a product management role where the product is your org's way of working. You'll manage the full lifecycle: understanding how work flows today, deciding where AI should reshape it, prioritizing what gets built and in what order, and ensuring what ships actually gets adopted. You'll also prototype solutions, configure agents, and prove what's possible before pulling in engineering support to scale it.

You will work closely with an AI Engineer who sits within the Enterprise AI team. Together you form a partnership: you bring the business context, process intelligence, and strategic prioritization. They bring the technical depth, production-grade delivery, and architecture decisions. You'll build working solutions at the no-code and low-code layer, and partner with the AI Engineer on the right approach, tooling, and structure.

What you'll do

Strategy & Prioritization

  • Own your function's AI strategy, aligned with your Executive Sponsor and business priorities. Understand which metrics matter to the org, identify what will move the needle, define how you'll measure impact, and track progress over time.
  • Map how work flows across your function end-to-end, including the handoffs upstream and downstream to other orgs. Identify where the real constraints are, not just the ones your team can see. Focus on the 100x problems: where could leveraging AI in a workflow let your org execute it orders of magnitude faster, or at 100x more volume than before?
  • Manage intake of AI requests, ideas, and pain points from across the function, including via your Champion network. Ensure every team member has a clear route to surface what they need, rather than building independently.
  • Prioritize strategically against business outcomes and executive guidance. Hold the line on priorities - we cannot change direction every two weeks - and ensure the AI Engineer's time is spent on the highest-impact work.

Adoption & Change Management

  • Reimagine, not just automate. Challenge your org to think beyond injecting AI into existing workflows. Work with Enterprise AI to spot opportunities to fundamentally rethink how work gets done.
  • Drive adoption and change management together with the AI Engineer. The best AI solution is worthless if nobody uses it. Create the channels, rituals, and feedback loops that make AI visible in your function: shared spaces for teams to show what they've built, regular office hours, onboarding for new hires, and celebration of wins. Own the rollout and iteration needed to make AI initiatives stick.
  • Coordinate with Enterprise AI to ensure your function benefits from patterns, tools, and learnings emerging across other parts of the business.
  • Build and bridge the Champion network in your function. Champions are the peer community that extends your reach beyond what you and the AI Engineer can deliver directly. From early in the role, identify and recruit Champions across sub-teams (5-10% time, formally agreed with their manager), run a regular Champion sync, host demos to the wider function, and act as their bridge to Enterprise AI. Champions are not your reports: you coordinate them, you don't manage them. Without this network, your reach is capped.

Hands-On Building & Agent Operations

  • Build AI agents using no-code and low-code platforms (e.g. Glean, Workato, similar tools). Go from idea to working prototype without waiting for engineering.
  • Author and iterate on skills files that define how AI agents behave. Refine instructions based on real usage and share reusable skills across the function.
  • Configure MCP servers and tools, giving agents access to the business systems they need. Partner with the AI Engineer on what to connect and how to do it securely.
  • Own your function's fleet of agents. Some agents will be used directly by people in your org. Those that aren't, you own. Either way, you're accountable for their performance: tracking KPIs, running evaluations after model or data changes, and iterating based on what you learn.
  • Expect to rebuild. AI tools and models evolve fast. The agent you built last month may need to be replaced, not patched. You should be comfortable sunsetting your own work when a better approach emerges, and helping your org stay current rather than attached to what exists today.

What you'll bring

Business & Strategic

  • Deep knowledge of your function's operations. You understand how work moves through your org, where it gets stuck, and why. You can trace a process end-to-end and explain how it connects to the teams around it.
  • Strategic prioritization skills. You've managed competing demands before and can make hard calls about what matters most. You think in terms of business outcomes, not activity.
  • A product management mindset. You naturally think about intake, backlog, iteration, and adoption. You're comfortable defining success metrics and holding yourself accountable to them.
  • Strong communication and influence. You'll be the person saying "not yet" to some teams and "think bigger" to others. You need the credibility and interpersonal skills to make both of those conversations land.
  • Cross-functional instincts. You default to understanding how your org's processes affect and are affected by the teams around you - not just optimising in isolation.
  • Experience building peer networks or communities of practice. You've recruited and sustained volunteer contributors before, whether as a guild lead, champion program owner, or community organizer. You know how to motivate people whose time you don't directly own.

Hands-On & Technical

  • Comfortable building with AI tools. You don't need to write production code, but you should be able to build a working agent, configure a skill, connect an MCP server, and troubleshoot when something isn't working. Think: power user, not software engineer.
  • Ready to learn fast. Experience with or willingness to quickly pick up no-code/low-code AI platforms, prompt engineering, and agent configuration. You'll be trained on GitLab's specific tooling, but you should arrive ready to get your hands dirty.
  • Strong conceptual understanding of AI capabilities - summarization, classification, generation, automation, agentic workflows - and a commitment to staying current. The landscape shifts constantly. The tools you use today may be obsolete in weeks. You stay on top of new developments so that your org's AI strategy reflects what's actually possible, not what was possible six months ago.
  • Ability to map data flows - structured and unstructured. Understand where agents need context, and figure out where humans should interface with automated workflows and at what steps.

About the team

You will partner closely with Enterprise AI within the Enterprise Technology & AI organization, while remaining embedded in your own function. Enterprise AI provides the technical delivery capability, platforms, and patterns. You provide the business context, prioritization, building at the no-code layer, and adoption muscle. Together, you form the core of your function's AI transformation.

Here at Power Digital, we are hyper-focused on helping brands drive revenue growth and brand recognition, ultimately driving irrefutable value for our clients.

At the heart of Power Digital is our proprietary technology, nova, which analyzes businesses through first-party data, simplifying investment planning for marketing and diligence in M&A––putting marketers in a strategic seat at the table––and providing value in unparalleled ways.

Managing billions in media, our dynamic team––of consultative marketers, creatives, analysts and technologists––challenge traditional ways of planning and measurement through meticulous testing and data science across each milestone of the customer journey.

As the Director of Paid Advertising, you are the leader of your pod, a hybrid of senior individual contributor, people manager, and product leader for your channel of expertise (Creative, Paid Media, Organic Search, or Social) within the division. Reporting to the Managing Director, you own two things above all else: the people on your pod, and the quality of the work that pod produces.

This is a player-coach role, not a purely operational one. You are arguably the best generalist on your pod, not necessarily the single best specialist at any one skill, but the person who has demonstrated enough judgment, craft, and consistency that the team's trust in you is real and earned, not assumed by title. You lead from the front, capable of sitting in a client meeting and explaining the strategy directly, and capable of getting your hands dirty on coverage and doing the work at an exemplary standard. You ask nothing of your team that you wouldn't do yourself, and couldn't do at least as well.

You protect your pod from unreasonable client pressure while holding the team to a high, non-negotiable bar of excellence. You are on the roadmap to Managing Director, using this role to build the people leadership, product judgment, and cross-functional fluency that role demands, while staying closer to the craft than an MD typically can.

Role Requirements
