jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst
jobs.excerpt: ICF is a mission-driven company filled with people who care deeply about improving the lives of others and making the world a better place.
jobs.description:
ICF is a mission-driven company filled with people who care deeply about improving the lives of others and making the world a better place. Our core values include Embracing Difference; we seek candidates who are passionate about building a culture that encourages, embraces, and hires dimensions of difference.


Our Health Engineering Systems (HES) team works side by side with customers to articulate a vision for success and then make it happen. We know success doesn't happen by accident. It takes the right team of people working together on the right solutions for the customer.


We are seeking an experienced Senior Salesforce Business Analyst to support Product Owners and delivery teams in defining, refining, and managing Salesforce requirements throughout the software development lifecycle. This individual will serve as the liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring Salesforce solutions are aligned with business objectives and delivered with clearly defined requirements and acceptance criteria.


The ideal candidate will have extensive experience supporting Salesforce implementations, managing Agile delivery processes, and owning user stories from initial requirements gathering through development, testing, UAT, and production deployment.

You will be working on a mission-critical software program whose goal is to consolidate, modernize, and enhance a suite of applications supporting Medicaid operations.


Our core work hours are 10am to 4pm Eastern Time with the option to start earlier or work later depending on your time zone.


Responsibilities

  • Partner closely with Product Owners, business stakeholders, architects, and Salesforce delivery teams to gather, analyze, document, and refine business requirements.
  • Lead requirements elicitation sessions, stakeholder interviews, workshops, and discovery activities to identify business needs and desired outcomes.
  • Translate business requirements into detailed user stories, process flows, functional specifications, and acceptance criteria.
  • Own user stories throughout the entire Agile lifecycle, ensuring requirements remain clear, prioritized, and development-ready.
  • Manage story refinement activities, ensuring development teams have sufficient detail to estimate and implement solutions.
  • Support Product Owners with backlog management, prioritization, release planning, and roadmap execution.
  • Collaborate with Salesforce developers, administrators, architects, and QA teams to ensure solutions meet business requirements.
  • Validate requirements through system demonstrations, testing activities, and user acceptance testing (UAT).
  • Facilitate Agile ceremonies including backlog refinement, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and stakeholder demonstrations.
  • Track requirements, dependencies, risks, assumptions, and decisions throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Create and maintain business process documentation, user guides, workflow diagrams, and requirements artifacts.
  • Support release management activities and ensure successful deployment of Salesforce enhancements and new functionality.
  • Analyze current business processes and recommend Salesforce best practice solutions to improve efficiency and user experience.
  • Assist with change management, stakeholder communications, and user adoption activities.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree.
  • Minimum of five (5) years of experience as a Business Analyst supporting enterprise software development projects.
  • Minimum of three (3) years of experience supporting Salesforce implementations or Salesforce-based business solutions.
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance.
  • Candidate must reside in the United States, be authorized to work in the United States, and work must be performed in the United States.
  • Must have lived in the United States three full years out of the last five years.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree.
  • Salesforce Administrator Certification.
  • Salesforce Business Analyst Certification.
  • Experience gathering and documenting functional and non-functional requirements.
  • Experience writing detailed user stories, acceptance criteria, business process flows, and functional specifications.
  • Experience supporting Agile and SAFe delivery methodologies.
  • Experience working directly with Product Owners and managing product backlogs.
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce platform capabilities, including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, or custom Salesforce applications.
  • Experience supporting User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and defect management processes.
  • Experience supporting Medicaid, healthcare, or government modernization programs.
  • Experience working within Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) environments.
  • Knowledge of Salesforce platform configuration, security model, workflows, reporting, dashboards, flows, and case management.
  • Experience partnering with Salesforce developers and solution architects on large-scale implementations.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce DevOps and release management processes.
  • Experience supporting Human-Centered Design (HCD) initiatives.

Professional Skills

  • Strong elicitation and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to translate complex business needs into actionable Salesforce user stories and requirements.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong facilitation and workshop leadership skills.
  • Experience managing competing priorities across multiple stakeholder groups.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational abilities.
  • Ability to identify risks, dependencies, and impacts across business and technical teams.
  • Experience using Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or similar Agile work management tools.
  • Strong understanding of Agile metrics and continuous improvement practices.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with business users, technical teams, architects, and executive leadership.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive requirements from concept through deployment and adoption.

Key Success Measures

  • Accurately captures and documents business requirements.
  • Delivers well-defined, development-ready user stories with clear acceptance criteria.
  • Owns stories throughout the lifecycle from intake through production deployment.
  • Effectively supports Product Owner backlog management and prioritization activities.
  • Improves stakeholder engagement and satisfaction.
  • Ensures Salesforce solutions align with business objectives and user needs.
  • Supports on-time, high-quality delivery of Salesforce enhancements and releases.

Department/Business Unit:Tax Support

Job Summary

We are seeking a knowledgeable and experienced Primary Tax Support Advisor to join our dynamic team. As a Primary Tax Support Advisor, you will be responsible for providing prompt, professional, and courteous support to the field. You are expected to have excellent communication skills and the ability to work independently and within a team setting. Everyone will undergo technical tax training during employment. This position has room to become a permanent position as well as the ability to move to our Advanced or Senior Tax Advisor positions.

Responsibilities/Duties

  • Delivering tax support services for individual and business tax returns through various communication channels, including inbound and outbound calls and the Liberty Tax ticketing system.
  • Conduct comprehensive research on tax laws, regulations, and rulings to stay updated on the latest developments and provide accurate information and guidance.
  • Tax preparation & tax return reviews based on need.
  • Adhere to the policies as documented in the Internal Process Manual.
  • Thoroughly and accurately documenting customer issues, along with the relevant information and resolutions, to maintain comprehensive records.
  • Promptly communicating high-impact issues to supervisors, ensuring appropriate attention and swift action.
  • Need to be able to work nights and weekends as scheduled.
  • Ability to de-escalate and work patiently in all interactions, both internally & externally.
  • Participation in various department projects and team meetings.

Qualifications

  • Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with clients and colleagues.
  • A proactive and self-motivated approach, demonstrating the ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Education and Experience

  • 1+ Years Experience in taxation and/or accounting or tax preparation

Physical Requirements

The position involves working primarily at a desk, requiring extended periods of time sitting and performing tasks on a computer or workstation. The use of a communication device, such as a headset, may be necessary for up to eight hours during the workday to engage in effective communication with clients and colleagues. Cameras are required for team meetings.

Work Environment

This position will require the employee to work at one of our corporate offices in Hurst, TX or Virginia Beach, VA or remote. As an employer, we are looking for employees that convey our R.E.A.L mission and values. We encourage team bonding & interacting with colleagues. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is not exposed to weather conditions.

Position Description

Base pay is influenced by several factors including a candidate’s qualifications, relevant experience, and anticipated contributions to meet the needs of the business, along with internal pay equity and external market driven rates. The salary range displayed has not been adjusted for geographical location. This range has been created in good faith based on information known to Capital Blue Cross at the time of posting and may be modified in the future. Capital Blue Cross offers a comprehensive benefits packaging including Medical, Dental & Vision coverage, a Retirement Plan, generous time off including Paid Time Off, Holidays, and Volunteer time off, an Incentive Plan, Tuition Reimbursement, and more.

At Capital Blue Cross, we promise to go the extra mile for our team and our community. This promise is at the heart of our culture, and it’s why our employees consistently vote us one of the “Best Places to Work in PA.”

The Health Navigator collaborates with members, family, healthcare providers, community resources and other members of the healthcare team to coordinate services and address barriers including access to health care, health literacy, transportation, wellness, gaps in care etc. The Health Navigator will guide members to achieve optimal and vibrant health by providing tools, information, and assistance to help understand their healthcare options, take control of their healthcare needs, bridge the current gap between social-economic and medical and behavioral needs, and navigate the otherwise often confusing steps along the path to efficient and effective care.

Responsibilities and Qualifications

  • Identifying, facilitating, and securing access to needed healthcare, social services benefits and community resources. Assist members with navigating the steps along the path to efficient and effective care. Coordinate appointments with and transportation to physicians and non-physician providers to ensure timely and efficient delivery of diagnostic and treatment services when needed.
  • Actively monitors incoming calls, conducts outgoing calls, and responds to voice mail requests in a timely manner. This could include, but is not limited to, closing gaps in care, HRAs, upcoming education/health events, and provider follow-up.

About Pennwood Cyber Charter School

Pennwood Cyber Charter School is a tuition-free, K-12 public cyber charter school serving students across Pennsylvania. Pennwood offers flexible virtual learning supported by a proven curriculum, individualized student support, and innovative educational opportunities that promote academic achievement, engagement, and long-term student success.

Pennwood operates a 195-day instructional calendar that includes a three-week Connections Term (CTerm). CTerm expands opportunities for intervention, enrichment, relationship-building, career exploration, and personalized learning.

Pennwood is committed to a collaborative, relationship-centered virtual school culture in which students, families, and staff feel connected, supported, and empowered to succeed.

Pennwood staff members are eligible for a competitive benefits package that includes health coverage and retirement contributions through a 403(b) plan with a 5% employer match in place of PSERS.

Position Summary

Pennwood Cyber Charter School seeks Pennsylvania-certified educators who are responsible for delivering high-quality virtual instruction to students in assigned grades and subject areas. Working from home offices in Pennsylvania, our teachers manage instructional programming using the Learning Management System, telephone, internet, curriculum tools, and synchronous and asynchronous teaching practices.

Teachers communicate regularly with students and Learning Coaches, monitor progress, provide timely feedback, maintain accurate records, and adapt instruction to strengthen understanding and engagement. Our teachers collaborate with colleagues, school leaders, counseling and engagement teams, and other staff to help students successfully complete their educational programs and support the continued success of Pennwood’s cyber learning program.

Key Responsibilities

Instruction and Student Learning

  • Contribute to a culture of achievement by delivering asynchronous and synchronous instruction in whole-group, small-group, and individual settings.
  • Complete grading, lesson preparation, and student and family communications within established timelines.
  • Maintain a general knowledge of the K-12 curriculum and detailed knowledge of assigned courses, grades, and subject areas.
  • Review curriculum and use alternate instructional approaches to increase student understanding and engagement.
  • Support students and Learning Coaches with learning strategies, daily assignments, projects, and course expectations.
  • Support implementation of Individualized Education Programs, accommodations, and modifications for students enrolled in assigned courses.

Student Progress, Records, and Communication

  • Communicate regularly with students and Learning Coaches through the Learning Management System, telephone, and other approved tools.
  • Maintain accurate and current student records and data, including cumulative files, attendance, student and family information, and communication records.
  • Monitor student progress and collaborate with the Engagement and Counseling Departments to support timely communication, adequate progress, and achievement of established goals.
  • Consult with teachers, school staff, and leaders to develop enrichment activities and appropriate program modifications that strengthen student understanding and engagement.

Collaboration and Professional Practice

  • Collaborate regularly through professional learning communities and other team structures to develop and update Personal Learning Plans, score assessments, review student work, provide feedback, and refine instructional strategies.
  • Participate in professional learning and apply new knowledge to instructional practice.
  • Contribute to a collaborative, student-centered school culture and work effectively across grades, subjects, and departments.
  • Demonstrate professionalism, accountability, organization, punctuality, flexibility, and ownership of assigned responsibilities.

School Community and Organizational Support

  • Develop and implement virtual approaches that build and maintain a strong school community within assigned courses.
  • Collaborate with teachers and school staff to coordinate student social activities, field trips, and community events.
  • Manage or attend field trips and community activities and connect those experiences to student learning when appropriate.
  • Participate in the organization and administration of state assessments and other school events, as assigned.
  • Participate in student recruitment sessions and other outreach or marketing activities requiring teacher representation.
  • Work occasional evening hours and travel, including possible overnight travel, as needed to support students, families, testing, and school events.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Professional Capabilities

  • Student and Family Centered: Builds productive relationships with students, families, and colleagues and uses those relationships to improve experiences and outcomes.
  • Communication: Communicates clearly and professionally in written, verbal, virtual, and public-facing settings.
  • Collaboration and Flexibility: Builds trust, solves problems constructively, and works effectively across teams in a fast-paced environment.
  • Accountability and Ownership: Completes responsibilities accurately and on time, takes responsibility for outcomes, and proactively identifies opportunities for improvement.

Required Qualifications

  • Active Pennsylvania instructional certification appropriate for the assigned grade level and subject area.
  • Pennsylvania residency.
  • Strong oral and written communication skills.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Demonstrated student-centered approach, flexibility, agility, and ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively as a member of a team.
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a remote, technology-driven environment.
  • Ability to travel for state testing, school events, and outreach activities, including possible overnight travel.
  • Ability to work occasional evening hours, as needed to support students and families.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, Google Workspace, learning management systems, and related technology.

Opportunity Snapshot

Your tasks: Review citation-checking rubrics and build sample cite-checking tasks

Job Description

micro1 is engaging law students and recent law graduates with law journal experience to support a legal citation project. If you’ve spent time cite-checking for a law review or journal, this is that skill applied to a new context. No prior AI experience is required — your Bluebook fluency and editorial judgment are what matter.

Scope of Work

  1. Review existing Bluebook and pincite grading rubrics, and flag rules that are unclear, incomplete, or would be applied inconsistently by different editors.
  2. Identify edge cases the rubrics don’t currently cover and recommend how they should be handled.
  3. Create sample cite-checking tasks: source material paired with citations containing realistic errors, along with the correct answer and an explanation of the rule involved.
  4. Build tasks across a range of citation types and difficulty levels, from straightforward formatting errors to subtle pincite and source-support problems.
  5. Apply Bluebook rules consistently across all submissions.
  6. Flag ambiguous cases to project coordinators instead of resolving them silently.
  7. Deliver assigned work on schedule and at the required quality level.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Current law student (2L, 3L) or recent JD graduate.
  2. Law review or law journal experience, ideally including a cite-checking or source-collection role.
  3. Strong working knowledge of The Bluebook, including pincites, short forms, signals, and parentheticals.
  4. Able to explain why a citation is wrong, not just that it is — the reasoning matters as much as the correction.
  5. Careful and consistent across long sessions of detailed review work.
  6. Comfortable working independently and meeting deadlines without close supervision.
  7. Experience as a journal editor, articles editor, or executive editor is a plus.

How the selection process works

  1. Apply and complete the screening questions
  2. Complete the AI interview— this is how we showcase your skills to the client
  3. Profile review by the hiring team

Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end-to-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today’s volatility and disruption. With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.

Location

This is a remote position. You can work from home and be located anywhere in UK & Europe region.

About the team

The AI team is responsible for advancing machine learning solutions in the supply and demand space across industries such as Retail, Consumer Packaged Goods, and Life Sciences. Our work spans forecasting, optimization, replenishment, recommendation, explainability, and emerging AI techniques that help customers solve complex, real-world planning challenges.

What makes this team unique is that we operate at the intersection of applied research, product innovation, and customer impact. We explore new methods, develop novel approaches, and turn them into practical capabilities that can shape the future of the Kinaxis platform. This is a team for people who want to work on meaningful problems, push the boundaries of applied AI in real business settings, and see their ideas influence products used by customers around the world.

This is an existing job vacancy

What you will do

  • You bring deep expertise in agentic AI, enterprise platform architecture, supply chain systems, data modeling, and knowledge graph or semantic technologies, and you are energized by translating complex enterprise domains into reusable, machine-understandable platform capabilities.

What we are looking for

  • Masters or PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence or a related field. Relevant experience in enterprise software architecture, applied AI, data modeling, knowledge graph or semantic systems, or supply chain technology.
  • Deep practical understanding of enterprise supply chain systems or adjacent operational systems, including what data exists in those systems, how it is modeled, how to connect to it, and how it can be used to solve real business problems.

  • Strong data modeling, semantic modeling, ontology, knowledge graph, or knowledge representation experience, with the ability to apply these skills pragmatically to supply chain and enterprise platform problems.
  • Experience defining reusable architecture patterns, data model governance, semantic or ontology standards, versioning, lifecycle management, and alignment across enterprise domains.
  • Ability to define long-term evolution strategies for agentic enterprise platforms, balancing speed of delivery with durable, scalable, and extensible design.
  • Experience applying emerging techniques in agentic AI, knowledge representation, semantic systems, or enterprise data platforms, with a track record of translating new concepts into practical, product-oriented solutions.
  • Architect large-scale graph, semantic, and data platforms that integrate structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data across planning, warehouse, inventory, and other enterprise systems.
  • Hands-on experience with knowledge graph, data, and integration platforms and pipelines, including design, ingestion, transformation, entity resolution, schema or ontology alignment, validation, update patterns, and performance at scale.
  • Drives the technical evaluation of emerging graph, semantic, agentic AI, and enterprise data technologies with clear, defensible trade-off analysis.
  • Hands-on agentic AI and agentic engineering experience is required, including building software artifacts, applications, plans, evaluators, or workflows using agentic development approaches and GitHub-native engineering practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify, evaluate, and apply emerging research and technologies in agentic AI, knowledge representation, semantic systems, and enterprise platforms, translating them into scalable architecture patterns and product capabilities that enable reuse, composability, and extensibility across products.
  • Strong technical judgment and the ability to evaluate emerging semantic, graph, agentic AI, enterprise integration, and platform technologies.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence technical direction across product, engineering, platform, and customer-facing domains through expertise, credibility, and collaboration.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to bring clarity and alignment to complex concepts across AI, supply chain systems, enterprise data, platform architecture, and product strategy.

Our client, a fast-growing eCommerce company in the Patient Care space, with a strong presence in the Home Medical Equipment (HME) and Durable Medical Equipment (DME) niche, is seeking a highly driven, analytical, and detail-oriented professional to fill an immediate full-time remote Amazon Brand Manager opening.

As the Amazon Brand Manager, you will take full ownership of Amazon Canada, Amazon UK, and Walmart US, while expanding the company's presence across additional Amazon marketplaces, including Mexico, Brazil, and other markets, as well as key dropship retail partners. You will have full P&L accountability across all managed marketplaces and be responsible for driving revenue growth in alignment with company targets.

Your responsibilities will include ensuring accurate pricing and image mapping across listings, implementing evergreen listing strategies to improve conversion, maintaining account health, and monitoring competitors across all managed marketplaces. You will work closely with the in-house PPC manager, supply chain, and creative teams to support marketplace performance and expansion.

This role requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, organization, and a clear sense of ownership. You will be expected to take accountability for outcomes, prioritize effectively, and identify innovative approaches to marketplace challenges.

About the Company

The company is a purpose-driven provider of Patient Care products dedicated to improving the lives of patients and caregivers. With thousands of positive reviews and a globally distributed team, the company focuses on creating practical, well-designed solutions that address real-world caregiving needs.

Customer obsession is at the core of the company's culture, guiding decision-making and product development. The mission is to enhance well-being through thoughtful design and continuous feedback loops, while the vision is to empower patients and caregivers through innovative and accessible products. The company fosters a supportive, high-performance environment that values ownership, growth, and meaningful contribution.

Key Responsibilities

Own International Marketplace Operations

  • Take full operational ownership of Amazon Canada, Amazon UK, and Walmart US within the first 90 days, ensuring zero disruption to ongoing sales.
  • Manage marketplace operations and ensure accurate pricing and image mapping across all managed channels.
  • Maintain strong account health and address issues that could disrupt marketplace operations or ongoing sales.
  • Ensure listings and marketplace operations are maintained consistently across all managed channels.

Drive Marketplace Revenue and P&L Performance

  • Own full P&L performance across all managed primary and secondary marketplaces, aligning results with company targets.
  • Monitor marketplace performance and use data to identify opportunities for revenue growth and improved financial results.
  • Evaluate performance across managed channels and identify opportunities to improve results.
  • Support data-driven decision-making to ensure marketplace growth remains aligned with company objectives.

Optimize Listings and Improve Conversion

  • Implement evergreen listing strategies to improve conversion across Amazon Canada, Amazon UK, and Walmart US within the first six months.
  • Ensure accurate product listings, pricing, and image mapping across managed marketplaces.
  • Identify opportunities to improve listing performance and conversion.
  • Work closely with the creative team to support listing optimization and ensure accurate product imagery.
  • Collaborate with the in-house PPC manager to support marketplace performance and identify opportunities for improvement.

Expand Secondary Marketplaces and Dropship Partnerships

  • Grow the company's presence across additional Amazon marketplaces, including Mexico, Brazil, and other relevant markets.
  • Contribute to the growth of secondary marketplaces and key dropship retail partners throughout the first year.
  • Support the development and expansion of retail partnerships, including HD Supply, Vitality Medical, Medical Shop, Sleepplay, and other relevant partners.
  • Ensure accurate pricing and image mapping across retail partner channels.
  • Identify opportunities to expand marketplace and retail partner presence in alignment with company growth targets.

Maintain Competitive Intelligence and Account Health

  • Maintain an ongoing competitive intelligence process across all managed marketplaces.
  • Monitor competitive activity and market developments to identify opportunities and potential risks.
  • Maintain vigilant account health across managed channels and address issues that could affect ongoing sales.
  • Use marketplace insights to inform decisions and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

Build Cross-Functional Relationships

  • Establish effective working relationships with the in-house PPC manager, supply chain, and creative teams within the first six months.
  • Coordinate marketplace activities with relevant teams to support listing performance and channel growth.
  • Communicate marketplace performance, opportunities, and issues clearly to relevant stakeholders.
  • Work collaboratively across functions to support the company's international expansion and marketplace objectives.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with Amazon Seller Central.
  • Experience with Walmart Marketplace is a plus.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to process data and draw meaningful conclusions.
  • Ability to take ownership of marketplace operations and financial performance.
  • Strong attention to detail, particularly regarding listing accuracy, pricing, and image mapping.
  • Strong organizational and planning skills, with the ability to prioritize work efficiently.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to identify opportunities, solve problems proactively, and develop innovative approaches to challenges.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with PPC, supply chain, and creative teams.

Core Competencies & Values

  • Attention to Detail: Does not let important details slip through the cracks or derail a project.
  • Consistency: Demonstrates tenacity and willingness to go the distance to get something done.
  • Ownership: Takes full accountability for outcomes, works proactively without needing to be told what to do, brings new ideas, thinks about the bigger picture, and operates with honesty and integrity.

Key Competencies

  • Analytical Skills: Able to structure and process qualitative or quantitative data and draw insightful conclusions from it.
  • Organization & Planning: Plans, organizes, schedules, and budgets efficiently and productively, focusing on key priorities.
  • Efficiency: Able to produce significant output with minimal wasted effort.
  • Communication: Speaks and writes clearly and articulately without being overly verbose or talkative, maintaining this standard in all forms of written communication, including email.
  • High Standards: Expects personal performance and work quality to be nothing short of the best.
  • Creativity / Innovation: Generates new and innovative approaches to problems.

What We Offer

  • Full-time remote position in a rapidly growing international company.
  • Direct ownership of international and alternative marketplace performance.
  • Full P&L accountability across managed marketplaces.
  • The opportunity to contribute to international expansion and the growth of additional sales channels.
  • A performance-driven and feedback-oriented culture.
  • Competitive compensation based on experience.
  • Annual fully sponsored company trips.
  • Paid Time Off: Local public holidays plus two weeks of paid vacation annually.
  • Long-term growth opportunities aligned with company expansion.

This is an excellent opportunity for an Amazon Brand Manager who combines analytical thinking, attention to detail, and ownership with a strong focus on marketplace performance. If you are motivated by growing international sales channels, improving listing conversion, and making data-driven decisions that support financial results, this role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful contribution to a growing eCommerce business.

jobs.description:
About Pennwood Cyber Charter School

Pennwood Cyber Charter School is a tuition-free, K-12 public cyber charter school serving students across Pennsylvania. Pennwood offers flexible virtual learning supported by a proven curriculum, individualized student support, and innovative educational opportunities that promote academic achievement, engagement, and long-term student success.

Pennwood operates a 195-day instructional calendar that includes a three-week Connections Term (CTerm). CTerm expands opportunities for intervention, enrichment, relationship-building, career exploration, and personalized learning.

Pennwood is committed to a collaborative, relationship-centered virtual school culture in which students, families, and staff feel connected, supported, and empowered to succeed.

Pennwood staff members are eligible for a competitive benefits package that includes health coverage and retirement contributions through a 403(b) plan with a 5% employer match in place of PSERS.

Position Summary

Pennwood Cyber Charter School seeks Pennsylvania-certified educators who are responsible for delivering high-quality virtual instruction to students in assigned grades and subject areas. Working from home offices in Pennsylvania, our teachers manage instructional programming using the Learning Management System, telephone, internet, curriculum tools, and synchronous and asynchronous teaching practices.

Teachers communicate regularly with students and Learning Coaches, monitor progress, provide timely feedback, maintain accurate records, and adapt instruction to strengthen understanding and engagement. Our teachers collaborate with colleagues, school leaders, counseling and engagement teams, and other staff to help students successfully complete their educational programs and support the continued success of Pennwood’s cyber learning program.

Key Responsibilities

Instruction and Student Learning

  • Contribute to a culture of achievement by delivering asynchronous and synchronous instruction in whole-group, small-group, and individual settings.
  • Complete grading, lesson preparation, and student and family communications within established timelines.
  • Maintain a general knowledge of the K-12 curriculum and detailed knowledge of assigned courses, grades, and subject areas.
  • Review curriculum and use alternate instructional approaches to increase student understanding and engagement.
  • Support students and Learning Coaches with learning strategies, daily assignments, projects, and course expectations.
  • Support implementation of Individualized Education Programs, accommodations, and modifications for students enrolled in assigned courses.

Student Progress, Records, and Communication

  • Communicate regularly with students and Learning Coaches through the Learning Management System, telephone, and other approved tools.
  • Maintain accurate and current student records and data, including cumulative files, attendance, student and family information, and communication records.
  • Monitor student progress and collaborate with the Engagement and Counseling Departments to support timely communication, adequate progress, and achievement of established goals.
  • Consult with teachers, school staff, and leaders to develop enrichment activities and appropriate program modifications that strengthen student understanding and engagement.

Collaboration and Professional Practice

  • Collaborate regularly through professional learning communities and other team structures to develop and update Personal Learning Plans, score assessments, review student work, provide feedback, and refine instructional strategies.
  • Participate in professional learning and apply new knowledge to instructional practice.
  • Contribute to a collaborative, student-centered school culture and work effectively across grades, subjects, and departments.
  • Demonstrate professionalism, accountability, organization, punctuality, flexibility, and ownership of assigned responsibilities.

School Community and Organizational Support

  • Develop and implement virtual approaches that build and maintain a strong school community within assigned courses.
  • Collaborate with teachers and school staff to coordinate student social activities, field trips, and community events.
  • Manage or attend field trips and community activities and connect those experiences to student learning when appropriate.
  • Participate in the organization and administration of state assessments and other school events, as assigned.
  • Participate in student recruitment sessions and other outreach or marketing activities requiring teacher representation.
  • Work occasional evening hours and travel, including possible overnight travel, as needed to support students, families, testing, and school events.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Professional Capabilities

  • Student and Family Centered: Builds productive relationships with students, families, and colleagues and uses those relationships to improve experiences and outcomes.
  • Communication: Communicates clearly and professionally in written, verbal, virtual, and public-facing settings.
  • Collaboration and Flexibility: Builds trust, solves problems constructively, and works effectively across teams in a fast-paced environment.
  • Accountability and Ownership: Completes responsibilities accurately and on time, takes responsibility for outcomes, and proactively identifies opportunities for improvement.

Required Qualifications

  • Active Pennsylvania instructional certification appropriate for the assigned grade level and subject area.
  • Pennsylvania residency.
  • Strong oral and written communication skills.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Demonstrated student-centered approach, flexibility, agility, and ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively as a member of a team.
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a remote, technology-driven environment.
  • Ability to travel for state testing, school events, and outreach activities, including possible overnight travel.
  • Ability to work occasional evening hours, as needed to support students and families.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, Google Workspace, learning management systems, and related technology.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Additional Pennsylvania instructional certifications or endorsements, including English learner or multiple subject-area credentials.
  • Experience teaching in a virtual, online, or blended learning environment.

Two-step authentication setup is required to access school systems upon hire.

jobs.description:
BETER is a leading provider of fast-betting content, data, and technology solutions for the sports and esports industries.

We deliver high-quality live streams, real-time data, and betting solutions to operators worldwide, helping them enhance their offerings and create engaging experiences for their customers.

Our international team brings together professionals from technology, sports, esports, trading, and analytics, working together to develop innovative products for the global betting industry.

About the role:

We are looking for a Quantitative Product Analyst to join our Esports Product team at BETER.

In this role, you will transform complex betting, product, and operational data into actionable insights that drive product performance and business growth. You will analyse key metrics, identify trends and opportunities, evaluate new initiatives, and help teams make data-driven decisions.

You will report to the Head of Esports Product, eLeagues, and work closely with Product, Trading, Quantitative Analytics, Operations, BI, and Commercial teams.

What you'll do:

  • Analyse product performance: Monitor and evaluate key metrics, including turnover, GGR, margins, betting activity, and customer behaviour across products, clients, markets, and regions.
  • Identify opportunities: Detect trends, anomalies, performance gaps, and areas for product optimisation.
  • Apply statistical analysis: Test hypotheses, validate findings, and distinguish meaningful trends from normal fluctuations.
  • Investigate performance challenges: Analyse client underperformance and unusual betting patterns to identify root causes and recommend improvements.
  • Build forecasts and models: Develop scenarios, forecasts, and commercial impact assessments to support business decisions.
  • Evaluate new initiatives: Support business cases for new products, markets, and esports formats, define success metrics, and assess pilot results.
  • Analyse market trends: Use competitor and market intelligence to identify potential risks, opportunities, and competitive advantages.
  • Drive data-informed decisions: Present complex findings in a clear, practical way and provide actionable recommendations to Product, Trading, and Commercial stakeholders.

What we're looking for:

  • Strong analytical skills and a solid understanding of statistical methods and data analysis.
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets.
  • Hands-on experience with SQL and BI tools (such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker).
  • Ability to interpret complex datasets, identify patterns, and translate findings into business recommendations.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, commercial awareness, and attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain analytical findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with Python or R for statistical analysis and data modelling.
  • Previous experience in sports betting, esports, iGaming, or a related industry.
  • Understanding of betting metrics, product performance, and commercial analytics.

What we offer:

  • 20 paid vacation days per year to rest and recharge.
  • 10 paid sick days annually, with simplified sick leave arrangements.
  • Paid public holidays according to your country of employment.
  • Flexible working arrangements, including remote or hybrid options depending on the role and location.
  • Flexible working hours, with core collaboration hours from 11:00 to 17:00 (UTC+3).
  • A supportive international team and opportunities to collaborate with experienced professionals across different markets.
  • Professional growth opportunities in a dynamic and fast-growing esports and sports betting industry.
  • The benefits package may vary depending on the country of employment and type of contract.

Why join us?

This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of data, esports, and product strategy, contributing directly to product development and commercial performance.

Your insights will help shape product decisions, identify growth opportunities, and support the evolution of BETER's esports products.

Summary

The Senior Lead Asset Manager provides strategic and operational oversight of Greenbrier’s owned and managed railcar assets. The role leads the Asset Management team, oversees shop performance, manages customer escalations, and supports fleet reliability, service levels, and customer requirements.

The position leads and develops Asset Managers and Senior Asset Managers and provides strategic planning and execution oversight across the fleet. The role evaluates estimates and invoices for accuracy, cost control, and alignment with customer requirements; coordinates with internal Leasing and Fleet Management groups; and serves as a liaison among leadership, customers, vendors, and repair shops. The position applies technical expertise and operational judgment to support decisions, reinforces compliance with established Asset Management procedures, and directs continuous improvement of standard operating procedures, workflows, and operating standards.

The role is responsible for team effectiveness, timely resolution of escalations, maintenance budget adherence, shop performance, repair-cycle efficiency, accurate operational reporting, and consistent application of Asset Management standards. The Senior Lead Asset Manager works closely with the Asset Management Program Planner and provides backup support for program setup, Scope of Work and bid coordination, and program kickoff activities during absences or periods of high program volume.

Team Leadership, People Development, Workload Management

  • Represent the Asset Management function in leadership meetings, cross-functional workgroups, customer briefings, and industry forums.

Shop Performance Management & Cost Control

  • Lead high-level analysis of shop performance, identifying cost trends, performance anomalies, and maintenance optimization opportunities.
  • Approve and audit complex repair estimates and invoicing from repair shops and mobile service providers, ensuring adherence to AAR/FRA regulations, Greenbrier standards, and cost-effectiveness targets.
  • Oversee the coordination of bad order and program cars through repair cycles, streamlining workflows via Greenbrier's asset management systems.
  • Direct and authorize scrapping processes for end-of-life assets, ensuring alignment with strategic disposition plans and regulatory guidelines.

Strategic Planning & Execution Oversight

  • Provide strategic oversight of Greenbrier's railcar fleet, ensuring performance optimization, lifecycle planning, and regulatory compliance.
  • Leverage advanced fleet analytics to assess overall program health, diagnose cost drivers, and develop strategic corrective actions to improve availability, reliability, and cost reduction.

  • Monitor regulatory changes and industry best practices, implementing required updates across the Asset Management team to ensure continuous compliance.

Experience using Power BI, Salesforce, Enspire, workflow automation, or AI-enabled productivity tools is strongly preferred. Familiarity with rail asset management systems and processes preferred.

jobs.title: Production Risk Engineer - Architects & Engineers (West)
jobs.excerpt: Counterpart is an insurtech platform reimagining management and professional liability for the modern workplace.
jobs.description:
Counterpart is an insurtech platform reimagining management and professional liability for the modern workplace. We believe that when businesses lead with clarity and confidence, they become more resilient, more innovative, and better prepared for what’s ahead. That’s why we built the first Agentic Insurance™ system — where advanced AI and deep insurance expertise come together to proactively assess, mitigate, and manage risk. Backed by A rated carriers and trusted by brokers nationwide, our platform helps small businesses grow with confidence. Join us in shaping a smarter future, helping businesses Do More With Less Risk®.

As a member of the risk engineering team, you will be responsible for the production of premium through proper risk analysis and effective distribution of our product. In collaboration with the engineering, design, data, and operations team, you will leverage your industry knowledge and broker relationships to develop management liability and professional liability insurance products that brokers are eager to promote to their clients.

AS A PRODUCTION FOCUSED RISK ENGINEER YOU WILL:

  • Achieve and exceed underwriting performance and revenue goals, using AI assisted risk scoring, automation, and triage to prioritize submissions and underwrite in accordance with our stated procedures.
  • Price accounts with competitive terms quickly and thoughtfully, applying AI driven rating and pricing recommendations to accelerate turnaround while adhering to guidelines.
  • Provide quick, competitive quote communication, using AI drafting and response tools to align messaging with our distribution and market strategies.
  • Collaborate with the underwriting team of Risk Engineers on understanding the unique exposures of complex accounts.
  • Serve as a trusted partner to wholesale brokers by offering thoughtful underwriting guidance and responsive communication; use AI tools to log and summarize broker engagement activity in internal systems.
  • Provide market feedback and recommend improvements to our terms, rates, and guidelines improving our policy forms and coverages
  • Bind new business accounts through the consistent engagement with brokers and effective management of the submission and quote lifecycle.
  • Represent Counterpart at broker meetings, and industry conferences, and networking events.
  • Surface market feedback and competitive observations to inform the product roadmap and underwriting strategies.

PEOPLE WHO THRIVE HERE:

  • Entrepreneurial, willing to experiment, embrace new technology, try new things
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and rapidly changing priorities. Change is normal and happens quickly at startups. You have experience experimenting, learning, and pivoting with your learnings.
  • Take ownership of your projects, your deadlines, your functions, your calendar, your own destiny. People who thrive at a startup like ours have a bias toward action and documentation.
  • Communicate directly and with clarity. Working cross-functionally is an essential part of any role at Counterpart. You’ll succeed by conjoining expectations with others and holding all accountable.

THE HARD PARTS:

  • We're early, and that's not always comfortable. Counterpart is still a young company, which means some processes, tools, and norms are still being built in real time. You may encounter situations where the answer doesn't exist yet — and you'll be expected to help create it rather than wait for someone else to.
  • The feedback culture is real. We mean it when we say speak boldly and honestly. That goes both ways — you'll be expected to give direct feedback and to receive it without defensiveness. If you've spent your career in environments where difficult conversations get softened or avoided, that adjustment can take time.
  • Distributed work requires more intentionality. There's no office to drop by, no hallway conversation to clear up a misunderstanding. Staying connected, communicating proactively, and building relationships across a remote team takes real effort; it doesn't happen automatically here.
  • We move fast and expect you to keep up. Counterpart operates with a bias toward action. Decisions get made quickly, priorities can shift, and we don't wait for perfect information. If you're used to slower, more deliberate organizational rhythms, the pace here can be a genuine adjustment.
  • You're expected to own your outcomes. There's a high degree of autonomy here, which is a feature, but it also means there's no one looking over your shoulder to catch things before they become problems. The people who thrive take that ownership seriously and hold themselves accountable without being asked.

WE LOOK FOR TEAMMATES WHO HAVE:

  • 3-7 years of underwriting experience in the respective product.
  • A network of brokers, carriers, underwriters, or clients in the professional liability insurance space.
  • Expertise in various aspects of specialty liability products (e.g. rating procedures, policy forms, applications and coverage endorsements).
  • Ability to successfully engage with brokers to establish long-term, profitable partnerships with brokerages.
  • Confidence presenting to key internal and external stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated success with high performing sales and account management practices.
  • A proven track record of success, achieving and exceeding monthly, quarterly and annual targets.
  • Enthusiasm for continuous challenges in a high velocity environment.
  • Flexibility for travel, when necessary (once per month as a minimum)
  • College Degree with relevant work experience of 4+ years.

WHO YOU WILL WORK WITH:

  • Mike Muglia, Professional Liability Lead: Mike previously served as Director of Professional Liability at RB Jones, a leading Lloyd’s Coverholder and MGU, and National Underwriting Director at Burns & Wilcox, a prominent international wholesale broker & MGA. Over the course of his career, he has led underwriting teams across a range of specialties, including Architects & Engineers, Contractors Professional, Management Liability, Tech/Cyber/Media Liability, Allied Healthcare and Social Services, Miscellaneous E&O, General Liability, Contractors Pollution, and Fire Suppression Contractors.
  • Tanner Hackett, CEO: Having founded two other major startups, including Button and Lazada, Tanner now spends his time focused on mental health through his philanthropy,, in addition to reading, surfing, yoga, and enjoying the outdoors.
  • Satwik Mysore, Risk Engineer Territory Lead: After graduating with an actuarial science degree, Satwik has spent most of his career at Travelers, where he built one of the largest and most profitable management liability books by forming strong broker relationships.
  • Brad Bahler, Risk Engineer Territory Lead: Brad has over a decade of experience in management liability underwriting. He managed one of the largest books of small business management liability risks at Travelers, where he was known for his deep understanding of coverage, outstanding submission response times, and boundless enthusiasm for the space.
  • Jake O’Donnell, Risk Engineer Territory Lead: Jake started his insurance career at Chubb, where he was able to develop and grow a profitable book of private-for-profit and non-profit management liability business. Jake is known for his exceptional service to industry brokers and his extensive knowledge of management liability. Jake also is a CPCU designation recipient.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Stock Options: Every employee is able to participate in the value that they create at Counterpart through our employee stock option plan.
  • Health, Dental, and Vision Coverage: We care about your health and that of your loved ones. We cover up to 100% of your monthly contributions for health, dental, and vision insurance and up to 80% coverage for family members.
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan: We value your financial health and offer a 401(k) option to help you save for retirement.
  • Parental Leave: Birthing parents may take up to 12 weeks of parental leave at 100% of their regular pay following the birth of the employee’s child, and can choose to take an additional 4 unpaid weeks. Non-birthing parents will receive 8 weeks of parental leave at 100% of their regular pay.
  • Unlimited Vacation: We offer flexible time off, allowing you to take time when you need it.
  • Work from Anywhere: Counterpart is a fully distributed company, meaning there is no office. We allow employees to work from wherever they do their best work, and invite the team to meet in person a couple times per year.
  • Home Office Allowance: As a new employee, you will receive a $300 allowance to set up your home office with the necessary equipment and accessories.
  • Wellness stipend: $100 per month to spend toward an item or service that supports your wellness (i.e. massage or gym membership, meditation app subscription, etc.)
  • Book stipend: To support your intellectual development, we offer a book stipend that allows you to purchase books, e-books, or educational materials relevant to your role or professional interests.
  • Professional Development Reimbursement: We provide up to $500 annually for you to invest in relevant courses, workshops, conferences, or certifications that will enhance your skills and expertise.
  • No working birthdays: Take your birthday off, giving you the opportunity to relax, enjoy your special day, and spend time with loved ones.
  • Charitable Contribution Matching: For every charitable donation you make, we will match it dollar for dollar, up to a maximum of $150 per year. This allows you to amplify your charitable efforts and support causes close to your heart.

COUNTERPART'S VALUES

  • Conjoin Expectations - it is the cornerstone of autonomy. Ensure you are aware of what is expected of you and clearly articulate what you expect of others.
  • Speak Boldly & Honestly - the only failure is not learning from mistakes. Don’t cheat yourself and your colleagues of the feedback needed when expectations aren’t being met.
  • Be Entrepreneurial - control your own destiny. Embrace action over perfection while navigating any obstacles that stand in the way of your ultimate goal.
  • Practice Omotenashi (“selfless hospitality”) - trust will follow. Consider every interaction with internal and external partners an opportunity to develop trust by going above and beyond what is expected.
  • Hold Nothing As Sacred - create routines but modify them routinely.Take the time to reflect on where the business is today, where it needs to go, and what you have to change in order to get there.
  • Prioritize Wellness - some things should never be sacrificed. We create an environment that stretches everyone to grow and improve, which is fulfilling, but is only one part of a meaningful life.

Our estimated pay range for this role is $120,000 to $170,000. Base salary is determined by a variety of factors, including but not limited to, market data, location, internal equitability, and experience.

We are committed to being a welcoming and inclusive workplace for everyone, and we are intentional about making sure people feel respected, supported and connected at work—regardless of who you are or where you come from. We value and celebrate our differences and we believe being open about who we are allows us to do the best work of our lives.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate against qualified applicants or employees on the basis of race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, sexual preference, sexual identity, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, marital status, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, military status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law, rule, or regulation.

Vetster is seeking an experienced Staff Veterinarian to provide high-quality virtual veterinary care through the Vetster platform. This is a primarily clinical, fully remote role. The Staff Veterinarian will maintain a consistent virtual appointment caseload, including Vetster marketplace appointments and consultations involving animals cared for through retail and strategic partnerships. In addition to scheduled appointments, the role includes continuity-of-care responsibilities, collaboration with Vetster’s RVT team, and clinical input across other internal teams.

What You’ll Do

Provide Virtual Veterinary Care to Clients

  • Provide virtual assessments, treatment recommendations, and prescriptions within applicable regulatory requirements through the Vetster platform.
  • Identify cases requiring emergency or specialty care and recommend escalation.

Continuity of Care

  • Serve as an Assigned Continuing Veterinarian when the originating Marketplace Veterinarian is unavailable, in accordance with applicable VCPR requirements.
  • Review medical records and support continuity-of-care needs, including:
    • Prescription renewals and fulfillment inquiries
    • Follow-up questions related to established treatment plans
  • Collaborate with the RVT team on escalated cases and cases requiring further review.

Clinical Expertise

jobs.excerpt: Logos is a movement supporting the development of the decentralised web.
jobs.description:
Logos is a movement supporting the development of the decentralised web. Logos technologies lay the foundations for a freer internet upon which communities can evolve into network states. Each protocol in the Logos stack seeks to empower its users while upholding civil liberties and fundamental freedoms.

** No need to apply or submit any information via this application (reference only). If you're interested in this role, please click here to learn more and apply.

About Logos

Logos is a movement to rebuild civil society using decentralised technologies. Logos is a sovereign, decentralised technology stack that allows for the creation of new types of corruption-resistant social institutions. It is designed to champion personal liberties and collective abundance through upgrading human governance.

As an open source movement, we need coders, creatives, and anyone passionate to help us build, own, and govern it.

Circles initiative

Logos Circles are self-organised groups that take action to solve issues that matter locally. They are a form of parallel governance: instead of reforming broken or rigged institutions, they build better ones that live on or are sustained by the network. Circles respond to local needs, build trust on the ground through solving problems, and experiment with real-world applications of Logos tech and values.

Upcoming circles near you.

We are looking for Activist Builder Volunteers who are passionate about the use of Blockchain and privacy-preserving technology to provide alternate forms of governance that support local communities.

You will commit to

  • At least 2 hours per week for a minimum of 6 months, though one year is preferable.
  • Co-Steward meet-ups, introduce Logos, and help guide the group on anything technical; development needs, leveraging existing OS resources etc.
  • Help onboard Circle members to Logos, e.g. running a Logos node, or connecting builders with relevant Logos team members to support integrations
  • Create space for others to contribute, grow, and take ownership over time.
  • Project manage the delivery of any technical elements related to winnable issues
  • Spread the Logos love
  • Coordinate with core contributors from Logos

We will commit to

  • Provide training on the Logos stack and how it works
  • Provide training and support on how circles are organised
  • Have a dedicated “buddy” from our internal contributors who will be your POC
  • Provide support during the circles
  • Help in finding a location for the circle's meetings
  • Provide a limited stipend to support essential Circle needs

Requirements

  • Fluency in English
  • Background in software development / engineering and/or Computer Science
  • Be aligned with the Logos mission
  • Have enough free time to dedicate to the circles
  • Have a deep level of technological knowledge so you can help apply the Logos stack to winnable issues
  • Be passionate about social issues and have desire to be part of the change

Application process

    • Intrusion detection / cyber threat hunting
    • Malware analysis

  • Minimum of 4 years of experience in cybersecurity operations, incident response, incident recovery, or another security discipline

jobs.excerpt: A Dito é uma empresa de tecnologia que nasceu em 2008 em meio à atmosfera de inovação do San Pedro Valley, em Belo Horizonte.
jobs.description:
A Dito é uma empresa de tecnologia que nasceu em 2008 em meio à atmosfera de inovação do San Pedro Valley, em Belo Horizonte. O objetivo da nossa plataforma é otimizar o relacionamento entre as empresas e seus clientes, com soluções personalizadas, aproximando os consumidores de suas reais necessidades de maneira inteligente, segmentada por meio de diversos canais.

Desde 2017, somos honrados como uma Excelente Empresa para Trabalhar, de acordo com o Great Place to Work®, e esse reconhecimento é, sem dúvidas, devido ao que mais valorizamos por aqui: as PESSOAS!

Quer fazer parte dessa trajetória? Vem ser FERA! Mas afinal, o que é ser FERA?

Ser FERA significa:

  • Absorver e propagar a cultura e os valores da Dito: pega e Faz, com foco e planejamento; age com Ética e transparência; se preocupa com o Resultado do cliente; trabalha com Alegria e sede por Aprender.

  • Agir sob a orientação de metas e dados, sempre com foco na excelência dos resultados dos nossos clientes e no bem-estar das pessoas que tornam isso possível.

  • Interagir, colaborar, usar e aprender, independentemente dos cargos ou das áreas. No mercado, estreitamos desvios e conectamos pessoas. Dentro da empresa não poderia ser diferente. Na Dito, as pessoas torcem umas pelas outras.

  • Compreender, respeitar e admirar as diferenças, transformar as oportunidades de enxergar o mundo a partir de perspectivas diferentes daquelas que já conhecemos.

  • Trabalhar com leveza e equilíbrio, valorizando o próprio bem-estar e, claro, o das outras pessoas.

Por que estamos criando um banco de talentos para Pessoas com Deficiência (PcD)?

A Dito é uma empresa comprometida com a promoção da diversidade, equidade e inclusão. Nosso time só é tão FERA pois incorporamos as diferenças e buscamos construir um ambiente de acolhimento, pluralidade e respeito às singularidades para que todas as pessoas se sintam livres para serem elas mesmas.

Sabemos que esse é apenas o início de nossa jornada, e estamos engajados no propósito de aumentar a representatividade de pessoas com deficiência no time de FERAs. Por isso, este banco é exclusivo para pessoas pertencentes a essa comunidade.

Valorizamos pessoas que tenham o pega e Faz com Foco e planejamento na veia, que prezem pela Ética e transparência, tenham foco nos Resultados dos clientes, trabalhem com Alegria e sede por Aprender. Então, se você se encaixa e acredita que estes valores fazem a diferença, nós estamos buscando justamente por você!

Quem pode se inscrever?

Sabemos que ainda estamos muito distantes de ter uma sociedade igualitária e com oportunidades iguais para todos e que pessoas com deficiência enfrentam uma forte desigualdade no mercado de trabalho e por esta razão criamos este espaço.

Por isso, se você se identifica como uma pessoa com deficiência, candidate-se e #VemSerFERA!

Nossos benefícios:

  • Dito Flex - VR e VA flexíveis pagos no cartão Caju (você escolhe como usar seu saldo de acordo com suas necessidades e preferência);
  • Plano médico e odontológico Amil com abrangência nacional, sem coparticipação e com inclusão de dependentes (filhos e cônjuges);

  • Auxílio escritório, para ajudar a custear parte dos gastos gerados pelo trabalho remoto;

  • Wellhub (antigo Gympass) com planos variados, inclusive um grátis;
  • Parceria com o Sesc, com descontos em serviços de educação, saúde, cultura, esporte, turismo, lazer e assistência;
  • Licenças maternidade e paternidade estendidas, válidas também para casos de adoção e guarda judicial. Durante esse período, a pessoa continua recebendo o VA/VR.

Outras vantagens que tornam a Dito um lugar especial ❤️:

  • Carga horária de 40 horas semanais com horários flexíveis de verdade;
  • Total liberdade de estilo, nada de dress code por aqui;
  • Diversos incentivos ao aprendizado (em participação em cursos, eventos, talks e meetups, compra de livros, biblioteca interna, entre outros);
  • Lanches, games e fliperama à vontade no escritório para relaxar durante os intervalos;
  • Convênios e descontos em vários restaurantes, academias, instituições de ensino, escolas de idiomas, entre outros;
  • Confraternizações constantes e eventos de integração entre equipes para proporcionar novas associações e amizades;
  • Falando em equipes, nossos times de futebol (feminino e masculino), batem um bolão;
  • Para quem não vive sem música, temos uma banda de FERAs!
  • Comitês internos de diversidade que realizam eventos direcionados, debates, aprendizados e iniciativas de conscientização e inclusão de grupos minorizados.

A Dito é uma empresa que respeita e apoia a diversidade e a inclusão. Portanto, não fazemos diferenciação de gênero, orientação sexual, raça, religião ou deficiência. Nosso time só é tão FERA pois incorporamos as diferenças.

Se você gostou do que leu, encontrou uma oportunidade com o seu perfil e quer fazer parte de uma Excelente Empresas para Trabalhar, de acordo com o Great Place to Work®, inscreva-se agora mesmo para ter uma chance de se juntar a nós! Caso você dê match com alguma das nossas oportunidades, entraremos em contato =).

Boa sorte!

jobs.description:
Full-time | Remote (US-based preferred)

Reports to: CEO

Competitive base + performance incentives

The Role

We’re hiring an Enterprise and PE Growth Lead to open doors and build trusted relationships with PE firms, their portfolio companies, and enterprise organizations. In this role, you will be responsible for driving new business growth and fostering strong relationships with potential clients. This role is ideal for proactive sales professionals who thrive at the intersection of technology and business.

This is not a high-volume outbound sales role. It’s a high-touch, strategic position focused on relationship development, thoughtful outreach, and navigating complex buying environments.

Your mission: create access where we don’t currently have it and turn that access into long-term partnerships.

About Goji Labs

Goji Labs is a strategy-first digital product agency that partners with enterprises, nonprofits, and growth-stage companies to design, build, and scale high-impact software. For over 10 years, we’ve helped organizations modernize legacy systems, launch new platforms, and execute complex digital initiatives.

We’re now looking for a senior, relationship-driven leader to help us unlock new partnerships with private equity-backed and enterprise organizations.

What You’ll Do

  • Drive new business by prospecting, pitching, and closing digital product deals with large organizations

  • Diligently research prospects, develop account strategies, and execute outreach campaigns tailored to company and industry needs

  • Build relationships with PE operating partners, portfolio leaders, and enterprise decision-makers

  • Identify and prioritize a focused list of target PE firms and enterprise accounts

  • Secure warm introductions and lead personalized, strategic outreach

  • Partner with Goji leadership on discovery, solution framing, and proposals

  • Navigate procurement, security reviews, legal, and onboarding

  • Shepherd complex deals through long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles

  • Stay engaged post-sale to protect and expand key relationships

What You Won’t Do

  • Run mass outbound or automated email campaigns

  • Manage paid ads or marketing execution

  • Close transactional, low-value deals

  • Operate without leadership alignment or support

Who You Are

  • 7+ years in strategic accounts, enterprise sales, or business development

  • Experience selling complex services (not SaaS) to PE-backed and Enterprise companies

  • Direct experience working with PE firms, PE-backed companies, or enterprise orgs

  • Comfortable with long sales cycles and multi-stakeholder buying processes

  • Strong executive presence and relationship-building skills

  • Clear, concise communicator who’s comfortable discussing tradeoffs and pricing

Bonus points if you have:

  • Existing relationships with PE firms or operating partners

  • Background in consulting, portfolio ops, or digital transformation

  • Familiarity with software development, UX, and product strategy

Why Join Goji Labs

  • Direct access to the founder and senior leadership

  • High-impact role with real influence on company growth

  • Collaborative, strategy-first culture

  • Opportunity to build long-term partnerships, not chase quotas

How to Apply

When submitting your application, you’ll be asked to complete a short candidate questionnaire. Most questions are multiple-choice or short answers about your experience with PE firms and enterprise accounts.

Optional Video (Highly Recommended)

We’d love to hear from you directly! Please record a short 1–3 minute Loom video as part of your application to submit with your application. In the video, please share how you would approach opening doors with PE-backed orgs or Enterprise accounts that haven’t met Goji Labs yet.

Think of it as a way to show your experience, your approach to building relationships, and how you tackle long, complex deals. It’s optional, but highly recommended to stand out as a candidate.

Interested?

Apply here and complete our candidate questionnaire on your experience selling into PE-backed or enterprise organizations.
