Solution Architect (.NET/C#) - Cloud Enablement

The Solution Architect plays a critical role in shaping and evolving cloud-enabled application architecture to deliver
secure, scalable, resilient, and business-aligned solutions. This hands-on role combines technical roadmapping,
solution design, independent research, application development, and close collaboration with engineering teams

and stakeholders.

The ideal candidate combines strong .NET and Azure expertise with practical architecture thinking, modern DevOps
and infrastructure-as-code experience, and the ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly. This
person can move between strategic architecture and hands-on delivery, turn ambiguous challenges into wellsupported
recommendations, and help define executable work for others.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership and Delivery

  • Define technical roadmaps and architecture strategies for cloud migration, application modernization, and
    scalable digital solutions.
  • Design secure, scalable, resilient, and highly available systems that align technical decisions with business
    objectives.
  • Balance long-term architecture direction with hands-on development, prototyping, technical validation, and
    delivery support.
  • Research architecture options, evaluate tradeoffs and risks, and present clear recommendations to
    engineering teams and stakeholders.
  • Produce architecture diagrams, decision records, technical plans, and system representations that make
    complex designs easy to understand.
  • Translate architecture into executable work by helping define epics, features, stories, dependencies, and
    technical sequencing.
  • Design security-first solutions that protect customer and enterprise data, support compliance, and reduce
    operational risk.
  • Collaborate with architects, engineering leaders, product partners, and business stakeholders to align
    solutions with enterprise standards and delivery priorities.

Database and Performance Optimization

  • Design data and integration architectures that support scalability, reliability, maintainability, and future
    growth.
  • Write and review advanced SQL, data models, indexing strategies, and query plans to improve application
    and database performance.
  • Identify and address performance bottlenecks across applications, services, integrations, and databases.
  • Design APIs, third-party and vendor integrations, and synchronous or asynchronous communication
    patterns.
  • Define service boundaries, integration contracts, versioning approaches, error-handling strategies, and data
    integrity controls.
  • Support distributed and event-driven solutions using technologies such as Azure Service Bus, Kafka, or
    RabbitMQ.

Cloud and DevOps

  • Design and support solutions in Microsoft Azure using secure, scalable, and repeatable cloud patterns.
  • Help migrate applications and services from on-premises environments to Azure.
  • Define and improve application onboarding patterns that enable engineering teams to move workloads into
    the cloud consistently.
  • Use infrastructure-as-code and deployment tooling, including Bicep, Helm, GitHub Enterprise, and GitHub
    Actions workflows.
  • Apply Agile and DevOps practices to improve delivery quality, deployment reliability, collaboration, and
    continuous improvement.
  • Promote observability, resilience, fault isolation, secure configuration, and operational readiness across
    cloud solutions.
  • Partner with engineers to troubleshoot architecture, environment, integration, deployment, and operational
    issues.

Full-Stack Development

  • Design and build backend services using C#, .NET, .NET Core, Web APIs, web applications, and servicebased
    architectures.
  • Remain close enough to the code to validate designs, support implementation, and contribute hands-on
    when needed.
  • Build and support modern front-end applications using JavaScript, TypeScript, and frameworks such as
    Vue.js, React, or Angular.
  • Design and evaluate secure authentication and authorization solutions for external users and customerfacing
    applications through an Identity Provider (IdP), using OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT, and
    platforms such as Microsoft Entra ID, Duende IdentityServer v8, or OpenIddict.
  • Support customer identity and access management modernization by evaluating and adopting Microsoft
  • Entra External ID, including secure migration paths from Azure AD B2C or other legacy identity platforms.
  • Promote clean, maintainable, testable code and sound engineering practices across the software
    development lifecycle.
  • Support modernization of legacy applications and the evolution of monolithic systems toward appropriate
    modular, service-based, distributed, or event-driven designs.

Mentorship and Team Development

  • Mentor engineers through pairing, design reviews, code reviews, knowledge-sharing sessions, and technical
    discussions.
  • Bring ideas forward, encourage constructive brainstorming, and help teams evaluate multiple solution
    options.
  • Communicate proactively and clearly in a distributed, cross-functional environment.
  • Influence stakeholders and align technical decisions with business objectives, customer needs, delivery
    constraints, and risk considerations.
  • Research unfamiliar technical areas independently and share findings in a clear, actionable way.
  • Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, curiosity, collaboration, quality, and continuous improvement.

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent required. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field
    preferred.
  • 8 to 10 years of software development experience, including technical leadership or architecture
    responsibilities.
  • 2 or more years of experience creating technical roadmaps and presenting architectural solutions.
  • Strong hands-on experience designing and developing solutions with C#, .NET, .NET Core, Web APIs, and
    the broader Microsoft technology stack.
  • Strong Microsoft Azure experience, including cloud migration, cloud-native solution design, and application
    modernization.
  • Hands-on experience with infrastructure as code and delivery automation, including Bicep, Helm, GitHub
  • Enterprise, and GitHub Actions or comparable tooling.
  • Hands-on experience designing and implementing external-user authentication and authorization through an
  • Identity Provider, using OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, and JWT.
  • Practical experience with at least one relevant identity platform, such as Microsoft Entra ID, Duende
  • IdentityServer v8, OpenIddict, Azure AD B2C, or Microsoft Entra External ID.
  • Experience with distributed systems, asynchronous communication, and event-driven architecture.
  • Strong understanding of API design, third-party integrations, SQL development, data modeling, indexing,
    and performance optimization.
  • Experience with JavaScript or TypeScript and at least one modern front-end framework such as Vue.js,
    React, or Angular.
  • Experience working in Agile and DevOps environments with a focus on quality, automation, collaboration,
    and continuous delivery.
  • Demonstrated ability to research unfamiliar technical areas independently, evaluate alternatives, and
    present clear recommendations.
  • Strong verbal and written English communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical
    concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Proven leadership and collaboration skills, including mentoring engineers, influencing stakeholders, and
    guiding work without relying solely on formal authority.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience implementing Microsoft Entra External ID for customer-facing applications or migrating customer
    identity workloads from Azure AD B2C.
  • Experience modernizing identity providers or migrating authentication platforms to cloud environments.
  • Experience with Kubernetes-based environments and Helm-managed deployments.
  • Experience with Azure Service Bus, Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar messaging platforms.
  • Experience supporting customer-facing applications or solutions operating in security-sensitive or regulated
    environments.
  • Experience decomposing legacy or monolithic applications into modular, service-based, or event-driven
    architectures.
  • Azure architecture or development certifications.
  • Exposure to additional cloud platforms such as AWS or Google Cloud.

Behavioral and Leadership Expectations

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to clearly explain complex architectural concepts to technical
    and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to structure and articulate reasoning in a logical, easy-to-follow manner.
  • Collaborative and approachable team player who contributes positively to team culture.
  • Proactive problem solver with curiosity and determination in tackling complex or ambiguous challenges.
  • Customer-focused and security-conscious mindset with strong attention to quality, maintainability, testability,
    and operational risk.
  • Ability to influence stakeholders and drive alignment in complex technical environments.
  • Hands-on leadership style that stays connected to implementation and engineering reality.

Microsoft Office;

CRM;

Sólidos conhecimentos do mercado de análises químicas e/ou ambientais;

Conhecimentos da rotina de análises químicas ambientais

  • PsyMeet: plataforma de terapia online para apoio à saúde emocional.

  • Convênio Educacional: parcerias com instituições renomadas de graduação, pós-graduação e escolas de idiomas com condições especiais para colaboradores.
  • Kit de Boas-Vindas: recepção especial no primeiro dia, com itens pensados para tornar sua chegada mais acolhedora.
  • Entre outros.

A Eurofins Scientific é uma empresa internacional de ciências da vida, fornecendo uma gama exclusiva de serviços de testes analíticos para clientes em vários setores, para tornar a vida e o ambiente mais seguros, saudáveis ​​e sustentáveis. Desde os alimentos que você come, até a água que você bebe, e os medicamentos nos quais você confia, a Eurofins trabalha com as maiores empresas do mundo para garantir que os produtos fornecidos sejam seguros, seus ingredientes autênticos e a rotulagem exata. A Eurofins acredita que é líder global em testes de produtos alimentícios, ambientais, farmacêuticos e cosméticos e em serviços de agrociência CRO. É também um dos líderes mundiais independentes de mercado em determinados serviços de testes e laboratório para genômica, farmacologia de descoberta, forense, CDMO, ciências avançadas de materiais e no apoio a estudos clínicos.
Em apenas 30 anos, a Eurofins cresceu de um laboratório em Nantes, França, para mais de 50.000 funcionários em uma rede de mais de 900 empresas independentes em mais de 50 países e operando mais de 800 laboratórios. A Eurofins oferece um portfólio de mais de 200.000 métodos analíticos para avaliar a segurança, identidade, composição, autenticidade, origem, rastreabilidade e pureza de substâncias e produtos biológicos, além de fornecer serviços inovadores de testes de diagnóstico clínico, como um dos principais players emergentes globais em teste de diagnóstico clínico especializado.

Em 2020, a Eurofins gerou receita total de EUR 5,4 bilhões e está entre as ações com melhor desempenho na Europa nos últimos 20 anos.

jobs.excerpt: About AutoRABITAutoRABIT helps organizations, particularly those in highly regulated industries, modernize and secure how they develop, release, and manage change across Salesforce environments.
jobs.description:
About AutoRABIT

AutoRABIT helps organizations, particularly those in highly regulated industries, modernize and secure how they develop, release, and manage change across Salesforce environments. Our platform helps teams improve release velocity, strengthen security and governance, reduce manual processes, and build more reliable software delivery practices.

The Role

As a Senior Customer Success Manager, you will own a portfolio of strategic, enterprise, and technically complex customers. This is a highly technical Customer Success role working with Salesforce, DevOps, Engineering, Platform, Security, and executive stakeholders to understand each customer's development lifecycle, deployment processes, technical environment, and business objectives.
Senior CSMs are expected to operate as trusted technical and strategic advisors. You should be comfortable discussing Salesforce DevOps, CI/CD, source control, release management, testing, security, governance, and software delivery practices, while connecting those topics to measurable customer outcomes. You are not expected to replace a Solutions Engineer or Salesforce Architect, but you should have enough technical depth to independently lead discovery, identify risks and opportunities, challenge customers when appropriate, and engage specialized resources when needed.
This role includes regular customer-facing travel, typically 1-2 trips per month for 2-3 days at a time, to build relationships, deepen understanding of customer environments, and drive strategic initiatives in person.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own a portfolio of strategic and technically complex customers, with accountability for adoption, customer health, value realization, renewal readiness, and growth.
  • Build trusted relationships with Salesforce administrators, developers, architects, DevOps leaders, platform owners, engineering leaders, and executive sponsors.
  • Develop a strong understanding of each customer's Salesforce development lifecycle, including source control, environments, testing, release management, deployments, and governance.
  • Assess customer DevOps practices and identify technical barriers, process gaps, adoption challenges, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Lead technical and strategic discovery to understand how customers operate, where friction exists, and what outcomes they are trying to achieve.
  • Apply knowledge of Salesforce DevOps and software delivery best practices to help customers improve adoption and realize measurable value.
  • Create success plans with clear business and technical objectives, milestones, adoption goals, and success measures.
  • Proactively identify customer risk, diagnose root causes, and lead recovery plans across technical and business stakeholders.
  • Coordinate resources across Solutions Engineering, Support, Professional Services, Product, Engineering, Sales, Renewals, and leadership to resolve complex customer challenges.
  • Guide customers through major technical milestones, including implementations, upgrades, new capabilities, process changes, and evolving Salesforce environments.
  • Identify opportunities to expand AutoRABIT's value based on customer use cases, technical maturity, and business objectives.
  • Bring customer insights, technical patterns, and product feedback back to Product and Engineering.

Knowledge & Skills

  • Strong understanding of modern DevOps principles, CI/CD practices, and the software development lifecycle.
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce development and deployment concepts, including metadata, environments, testing, dependencies, release management, and common deployment challenges.
  • Strong working knowledge of Git and source control concepts, including branches, commits, merges, pull requests, and repositories.
  • Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, release automation, APIs, testing, security, and governance.
  • Ability to understand technical architectures and customer workflows, identify areas of risk or friction, and recommend appropriate next steps.
  • Ability to independently conduct technical discovery and move beyond surface-level requirements to uncover root causes.
  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business outcomes for executive and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with engineering performance concepts and metrics, including DORA metrics.
  • Strong executive presence, communication, presentation, and problem-solving skills.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of relevant professional experience across Customer Success, Technical Account Management, Solutions Engineering, Salesforce consulting, Professional Services, DevOps, or other customer-facing enterprise technology roles.
  • 3+ years supporting technically complex enterprise customers in developer tools, DevOps, Salesforce, cloud platforms, or similar enterprise software.
  • Demonstrated experience working with senior technical stakeholders across Engineering, DevOps, Salesforce, IT, or CTO organizations.
  • Meaningful experience with Salesforce development, Salesforce DevOps, CI/CD, release management, or comparable software delivery processes.
  • Experience managing complex enterprise accounts, customer risk, technical initiatives, and cross-functional account teams.
  • Experience supporting Fortune 500 or similarly complex organizations preferred.
  • Experience within Financial Services, Healthcare, Government, or other regulated industries preferred.

What Success Looks Like

Successful Senior CSMs understand not only whether customers are using AutoRABIT, but how they build and deliver software on Salesforce, where technical and operational friction exists, and how AutoRABIT can help improve those processes. They can independently engage with technical practitioners and leaders, ask informed questions, identify risks and opportunities, and connect improvements in DevOps practices to measurable business and engineering outcomes.

Additional Information

This role is fully remote and is open to candidates based in the United States with U.S. work eligibility. We are specifically looking for candidates in Texas, Wisconsin, Illinois, South Dakota, Colorado, Washington, Idaho, or California.
Travel: Approximately 20% travel is expected, typically 1-2 customer visits per month lasting 2-3 days. Travel may vary based on customer and business needs.
Salary Range: $130,000-$160,000 per year, depending on experience
This job description is intended to provide a general representation of the responsibilities and requirements of the position. Responsibilities and requirements may evolve based on the needs of the business.

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB

As a key member of Anduril's recruiting team, you will be a specialized Contract Legal Recruiter embedded at the front lines of our mission to scale the teams that safeguard our technology and clear the path for global deployment. Responsible for attracting and hiring world-class legal, regulatory, compliance, and federal proposal talent, you will play a critical role in our continued rapid growth, bringing a strategic and hands-on approach to building our legal organization. In this role, you will hold the keys to our highest-priority legal and commercial expansions, collaborating directly with Legal and Business Affairs Leadership to deliver on ambitious hiring needs. To achieve this, you will be given the autonomy and tools to execute on our strategy to build and develop Anduril's world-class team. We are looking for someone who can masterfully handle every aspect of the legal recruiting lifecycle and is excited to be part of a small, impactful team where no task is too big or too small.

  • This position is open to 6-month Contract employment.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Conduct in-depth interviews and competency assessments of potential legal counsel, contracts managers, trade compliance leaders, legal operations, and federal proposal/capture analyst candidates, demonstrating the ability to anticipate hiring manager preferences through high interview-to-offer ratios.
  • Target and engage passive legal talent using LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean strings, referrals, SOBO campaigns, and specialized legal networks, professional associations, and industry events.
  • Partner closely with Legal Leadership (General Counsel) to understand specialized team needs, define role requirements, and craft compelling value propositions specifically for legal talent.
  • Drive a diverse talent pipeline into the organization ensuring a positive candidate experience at every touchpoint, from initial outreach to offer acceptance.
  • Represent Anduril's brand and recruiting team internally and externally, articulating our unique business model, scale, and financial impact.
  • Leverage internal resources and market insights to build strategies around selling our value proposition to top-tier legal talent.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5+ years of direct, full-cycle recruiting experience specifically focused on legal and regulatory roles, including corporate counsel, trade compliance (ITAR/EAR), commercial real estate, cybersecurity law, and government/defense contract management roles.
  • Proven experience conducting thorough competency assessments and evaluating legal capabilities (e.g., contract drafting, regulatory risk mitigation, intellectual property, GovCon procurement regulations) against technical and cultural requirements.
  • Experience managing strategic stakeholder relationships, particularly with general counsel, proposal and capture teams, driving strategic recruiting efforts based on business needs, profile calibration, and providing transparent pipeline progress via reporting.
  • Experience acting in a consultative manner, where your guidance on market conditions, talent availability, and candidate expectations has led to improved outcomes and a positive candidate experience within the defense-legal space.
  • Clear and effective communication with legal candidates to understand motivation, drivers, and cultural fit within a fast-paced, high-impact organization.
  • Experience managing various funnels of legal candidates and keeping track of their progress throughout the recruitment process using an ATS (e.g., Greenhouse).
  • Highly autonomous but highly collaborative, thriving in a dynamic, high-growth environment.
  • Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export controlled information or facilities.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience recruiting within the defense technology, aerospace, or federal government contracting (GovCon) sectors, including a familiarity with federal proposal/capture lifecycles or defense contract management.
  • Familiarity with the national security arena, including an understanding of federal security clearance lifecycles (Secret, TS/SCI) and how they impact candidate timelines.
  • Experience recruiting for senior to leadership-level legal roles (e.g., corporate counsel or senior attorneys from top tier law firms, specialized boutique firms, or sophisticated corporate legal departments).
  • A strong network within the defense-contracting (NCMA), legal (ACC/ABA), or federal proposal (APMP) communities.
  • Multiple years of experience working at an agency or fast-paced startup environment, particularly one with a strong product or engineering culture.
US Salary Range
$50—$75 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to .

  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to . Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit .

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

Hunch sits at the intersection of creative, media, insights and AI, and we're increasingly replacing legacy manual workflows used by agencies and in-house growth teams to deliver incremental growth.

Before you read further

We are hiring an Enterprise Account Executive with 5+ years of Mid-Market and Enterprise B2B SaaS sales experience in adtech, martech, creative tech, with a track record of ranking among the top performers on their team. This role is envisioned for someone who's ready to grow beyond individual contributor roles, with vision to help lead and shape our Sales team.

The Enterprise AE role is best suited for someone with solid experience in complex sales processes, already under their belt, and someone who's genuinely excited about the idea of moving into leadership roles over time.

Who you are

  • 5+ years of Enterprise B2B SaaS sales experience, with at least 2+ years selling paid social, adtech, or martech solutions

  • Someone who's ready for more than just another AE seat - you want a path toward owning strategy, mentoring reps, and eventually building/leading a team

As an Enterprise Account Executive, you'll own complex, mid-market to enterprise sales cycles across accounts, selling directly to brands and media agencies.

This is a consultative, value-driven sale - not a transactional one. You'll be expected to:

Sales Execution

Requirements

Experience

  • 5+ years of B2B SaaS sales experience

jobs.excerpt: We are seeking a Data Scientist with deep expertise in probabilistic AI and statistical machine learning to support a client's e-commerce platform, built on a distributed microservices architecture.
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Data Scientist with deep expertise in probabilistic AI and statistical machine learning to support a client's e-commerce platform, built on a distributed microservices architecture. The platform roadmap includes a set of intelligence capabilities that require rigorous statistical modeling rather than standard supervised ML. This role is responsible for designing, validating, and productionizing probabilistic models, and for working closely with backend engineering to translate those models into service-oriented production architecture within the platform's existing microservices ecosystem.

What you will do

  • Bayesian modeling and inference: Design and implement Bayesian statistical models — priors, likelihoods, and posterior inference — to support decisioning under uncertainty across pricing, segmentation, and demand-related use cases.
  • Markov chains and Hidden Markov Models: Build Markov chain and Hidden Markov Model formulations for sequential and behavioral patterns (e.g., customer lifecycle stages, state transitions), producing outputs that downstream services can consume.
  • MCMC and Metropolis-Hastings sampling: Apply Markov Chain Monte Carlo methods, including Metropolis-Hastings sampling, to estimate posterior distributions for models without closed-form solutions, and validate convergence and sampling quality.
  • Mixture modeling: Develop mixture models — Gaussian Mixture Models in particular — to support segmentation use cases, identifying latent customer or product groupings from transactional and behavioral data.
  • Expectation-Maximization: Implement Expectation-Maximization for latent-variable estimation underlying mixture models and related unsupervised learning tasks.
  • Production translation: Work with backend engineering to translate statistical models into production service architecture — defining APIs, data contracts, and integration points within the platform's existing microservices and event-driven pipelines.
  • Model lifecycle management: Define the approach for model training, validation, versioning, monitoring/drift detection, and retraining cadence once models are in production.
  • Roadmap collaboration: Partner with delivery and engineering leads to size, sequence, and estimate probabilistic/statistical modeling initiatives on the product roadmap.
  • Documentation and handoff: Document modeling assumptions, methodology, and validation results, and provide clear hand-off guidance so models remain maintainable by the engineering team after the engagement.
  • +90% English written and oral (at least B2 level) with excellent communication skills
  • Strong, demonstrable background in Bayesian statistics/Bayesian inference, Markov chains, Hidden Markov Models, MCMC methods (including Metropolis-Hastings sampling), mixture models (ideally Gaussian Mixture Models), and Expectation-Maximization.
  • Proven experience building and deploying statistical/ML models into production systems, not just research notebooks or offline analysis.
  • Proficiency in Python (or R) with standard probabilistic/statistical libraries (e.g., PyMC, Stan, scikit-learn, NumPy/SciPy) for model development and validation.
  • Ability to translate statistical/mathematical models into service-oriented production architecture — defining APIs and data contracts and working directly with backend engineers to integrate them.
  • Solid understanding of version control, testing practices, and CI/CD, sufficient to collaborate effectively with an engineering team on production delivery.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain model behavior, assumptions, and uncertainty to non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in e-commerce or retail domains, particularly pricing optimization, customer segmentation, or demand forecasting.
  • Experience integrating ML models with microservices architectures (REST/GraphQL) and event-driven systems (e.g., message queues/pub-sub), and deploying to cloud infrastructure.
  • Familiarity with common backend service ecosystems (e.g., .NET, Java, or Node.js) — even if modeling itself is done in Python — for a smoother handoff to the production engineering team.
  • Experience with MLOps tooling such as model registries, monitoring, and feature stores.
  • Background in pricing science, recommendation systems, or marketing analytics.

Our Benefits

  • Educational resources
  • Flexible schedule and Work From Anywhere
  • Referral Program
  • Supportive and chill atmosphere
  • Trajectory recognition plan

We are accepting applications from LATAM countries

In the role of Associate Director, Cybersecurity Posture, Hygiene and AI, you will join a diverse, global organization that invests in your growth while empowering you to lead teams that secure the technologies improving patients’ lives.

Role summary

This role builds and leads an enterprise security posture and hygiene program with a specific emphasis on configuration drift technologies and services. You are a people manager, accountable for setting direction, developing talent, and delivering sustained program outcomes. You will define the strategy, operating model, metrics, and governance needed to continuously improve control effectiveness across on‑premise and cloud environments and ensure AI-enabled workflows operate within enterprise security, privacy, and data protection expectations by detecting misuse, configuration drift, and control gaps.

About our team

You will join the Business Technology Solutions (BTS) Information Security and Risk Management (ISRM) organization. Our team focuses on reducing systemic risk by strengthening baseline security controls, improving configuration hygiene, and building scalable programs that enable safe adoption of modern and AI-enabled technologies across the enterprise.

In this role, you will be responsible for

  • Building and leading a security posture and hygiene program, including strategy, roadmap, operating cadence, governance, and direct people management.

  • Managing and developing a multidisciplinary team responsible for control assessments, configuration hygiene, remediation planning, and continuous improvement, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and career development.

  • Leveraging AI as an accelerator and enabler to drive speed and efficiency in continuous control monitoring and response

  • Integrating posture and hygiene telemetry from AI-enabled tools, custom tools and workflows to detect misuse, configuration drift, and critical control deviations

  • Identifying patterns of intentional and unintentional misuse of AI-enabled tools and workflows and translating those findings into preventive, systemic control improvements.

  • Developing and maturing a control framework aligned to the Center for Internet Security (CIS) Top 18 Controls and associated safeguards, tailoring implementation guidance to AbbVie environments.

  • Establishing a consistent methodology to assess control maturity, identify systemic gaps, and prioritize remediation based on risk and business impact.

  • Partnering with infrastructure, cloud, identity, network, endpoint, application, and AI engineering teams to embed secure-by-default configurations and resilient architectures.

  • Building metrics, dashboards, and executive-ready reporting that provide actionable insight into posture trends, control effectiveness, and remediation progress.

  • Driving enablement by publishing standards, playbooks, and guidance that helps teams design, deploy, and operate securely.

  • Continuously evolving the program by staying current on emerging risks related to AI, automation, and modern attack techniques.

Tools and skills you will use in this role

  • Security control frameworks and maturity models (e.g., CIS Controls).

  • Hybrid cloud and enterprise security posture concepts.

  • Network and endpoint security posture concepts.

  • AI and ML platform security concepts, including data handling, access boundaries, and security guardrails.

  • Bachelors Degree and 9 years of experience OR Masters Degree and 8 years of experience OR PhD and 4 years of experience
  • Proven leadership in cybersecurity, with extensive experience in managing security posture and hygiene strategies within complex and diverse IT environments
  • Experience implementing an AI security program across an enterprise.
  • Expert knowledge of operating systems, networking protocols, systems administration, X as a service, applications, and security technologies.
  • Expert knowledge and application of cybersecurity terminology, concepts, and the cyber threat landscape and attack vectors.
  • Deep understanding of risk management principles and the ability to integrate these into security practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to innovate and adapt in response to a constantly changing environment.
  • Advanced critical thinking, problem solving, and analytical skills
  • Strong leadership and collaboration skills with business and technical groups.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and listening skills, with the ability to effectively convey technical insights to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to interface effectively with clients, IT management, and staff.
  • A sincere desire to learn, grow, and go beyond personal capabilities, staying abreast of the latest developments in the cybersecurity landscape .
  • Professional cybersecurity certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CIS Controls, etc.) are highly desirable.

jobs.excerpt: Who We AreMockingbird is a DTC-first baby gear brand known for understanding today’s parents, creating thoughtfully designed products, and providing above & beyond customer service.
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Mockingbird is a DTC-first baby gear brand known for understanding today’s parents, creating thoughtfully designed products, and providing above & beyond customer service. In a sea of old school baby brands, we’re proud to stand out, offering families not just better products but also a better overall experience.

Our flagship product is our Single-to-Double Stroller, an everyday stroller that offers unparalleled flexibility, and can be paired with our complimentary stroller accessories. After years of innovative design & engineering and in-depth consumer testing, we launched our second major product, the 2-in-1 High Chair, which rapidly became one of the most popular high chairs on the market. Our vision is for families to be able to rely on Mockingbird through parenting stages and milestones – from newborn to toddler to child, from first strolls to first food and more – a brand parents could never imagine living without.

While humility is in our team’s DNA, we feel extremely proud of how much parents and top baby gear experts alike praise our products. We’ve received over 10,000 5-star customer reviews, we’ve been honored with awards & recommendations from the likes of Wirecutter, Forbes, and Babylist, and we hear from Mockingbird families every day how much our products mean to them (we actually have a whole Slack channel that’s just screenshots like this, this, and this)!

As a team, we’re scrappy, independent, and entrepreneurial, while also being strategic, methodical, and highly collaborative. We’re extremely thoughtful, caring, and supportive of our customers, and perhaps even more so of each other. We’re thrilled with how far Mockingbird has already come, but we’re invigorated by the thought of how much room we still have to grow. And that's where you come in…

What You'd Be Doing

Mockingbird's product portfolio has grown significantly since we launched, and so has the work required to bring new products and line extensions to life thoughtfully and well. This role is an expansion of our Product Management capabilities — ensuring that every product we build reflects the quality and care Mockingbird is known for.

As a Product Manager here, you'll own the full lifecycle of your assigned portfolio from the earliest concept through launch and into sunset. You're the product owner on every active program you carry, the central decision point, and the person who makes sure what gets delivered matches what was agreed. You'll work closely with marketing, supply chain, engineering, and industrial design to bring products to life in a way that serves both the business and the families buying our gear.

Specifically, your responsibilities in this role would include:

  • Own the complete product lifecycle for your portfolio — across both hero products and accessories — leading new products and line extensions through our Product Development Process, from concept and discovery kickoff through launch and into sunsetting.
  • Be the deepest expert on the families who use your products — synthesizing reviews, CX tickets, surveys, in-home research, and social listening into insights that sharpen briefs and decisions throughout development.
  • Contribute to forward-looking NPI roadmap planning for your portfolio — synthesizing market trends, customer insights, and portfolio performance data to inform opportunity sizing feasibility.
  • Write and maintain PRDs for your products, serving as the accountability point for ensuring the delivered product matches what was defined.
  • Work directly with engineers, industrial designers, and suppliers to translate product vision into executable specs, surfacing tradeoffs and making recommendations when what’s ideal and what’s possible aren’t the same thing.
  • Act as the central decision hub on active programs, making sure every meaningful decision flows through you and the right stakeholders are informed along the way.
  • Visit suppliers in market — including international travel to manufacturing partners, typically in Asia, roughly 3–4 times per year — to ensure product quality and fidelity to the vision, and serve as the on-the-ground voice for the product.
  • Partner with product marketing across the full commercial arc — from positioning, value propositions, claims, and product briefs through packaging and collateral execution, translating creative direction into specifications that are feasible given cost and production constraints.
  • Partner with and manage external contractors and freelancers as needed to support product development workstreams, providing clear direction, maintaining accountability to deliverables, and ensuring work aligns with product vision and quality standards.
  • Track how your portfolio is performing in market — sales, reviews, returns, customer feedback, accessory attach rates — and surface what we should evolve, fix, or double down on next.
  • Collaborate with your PM counterpart and Product Development Program Manager partners on portfolio-level prioritization and process improvements that lift the bar for both portfolios.

What We'll Be Looking For

  • 4+ years of experience owning the full lifecycle of a physical consumer product from
    concept through production, including hands-on work with international and/or Asia-based manufacturing partners.
  • A strong point of view on what makes a product great for the consumer, with a track
    record of carrying that perspective through every stage of development.
  • Excellent communicator — adept at translating between engineering, supply chain,
    industrial design, marketing, and executive stakeholders.
  • Strong peer partner — collaborates proactively, shares learnings, and keeps cross-functional relationships healthy even when delivering hard news.
  • Experience managing external contractors or freelancers — setting clear direction, holding accountability to deliverables, and integrating outside work into a broader product vision.
  • Commercial fluency — comfortable thinking through cost, margin, and positioning
    enough to be a sharp product-side partner to marketing.
  • Technical fluency for hardware development — enough understanding of materials, manufacturing processes, and engineering tradeoffs to engage credibly with engineers and suppliers, challenge technical decisions, and contribute to brainstorming. Formal engineering training not required.
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and changing conditions — able to influence without
    authority and drive clarity when others might wait.

We know that not every great candidate will check every single box in a job description. We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every listed qualification. At Mockingbird, we believe the strongest teams are built by bringing together people with different backgrounds, experiences, and ways of thinking.

Why We Think You’ll Like It Here

  • We’re a certified Great Place to Work, a Fortune Best Workplace in New York, and a Fortune Best Small Workplace in the US! Through an anonymous, third-party survey, 100% of our employees said Mockingbird is a great place to work.
  • We’re a fully remote company which means you get to work where you want (within the United States) during the hours that make the most sense for you and your family. We deeply value and encourage work/life balance.
  • Despite working remotely, we prioritize building camaraderie across the company and having fun together. We hold monthly company social events, optional monthly 1:1 coffee chats, and in-person company retreats. We never miss a chance to celebrate birthdays, work-a-versaries, and every other life milestone.
  • You’ll be empowered to truly make an impact on our business and on Mockingbird families. We’ve fostered a culture that promotes healthy debate and prioritization of the best ideas, rather than hierarchy and ego. If solving problems with a group of bright individuals is what gets you out of bed every day, you’ll love it here.
  • We also support our team members with thoughtful benefits and perks including:
    • Comprehensive medical / dental / vision coverage
    • Equity for every full-time employee
    • Flexible Paid Time Off, including a minimum of at least 15 days off per year
    • 16 weeks of 100% paid Parental Leave for all team members who welcome a child into their family (whether through birth, adoption or foster placement), with an additional option for 4 weeks of unpaid leave and a Shadow Return week. Read more about our Parental Leave Policy here!
    • Family planning support through a complimentary Kindbody membership and medical plans that include coverage for fertility treatment and reproductive technology (fertility drugs, artificial insemination, IVF, and others)
    • 401(k) with 401(k) with 100% company match up to 2% of your salary
    • Quarterly wellness stipend and annual work-from-home stipend

jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer
jobs.excerpt: About Armaments Research Company Armaments Research Company (ARC) is a technology company dedicated to bringing real-time situational awareness and battlefield logistics capabilities to the warfighter.
jobs.description:
About Armaments Research Company

Armaments Research Company (ARC) is a technology company dedicated to bringing real-time situational awareness and battlefield logistics capabilities to the warfighter. You will be an integral part of the ARC team managing program execution in support of our innovative and powerful IoT devices to enhance national security.

Our core offering is the ARC AI-Enabled Weapons Sensor (AEWS), which collects and transmits real-time tactical data to the cloud. This information enables battlefield/tactical awareness and aggregated insights into big data sets that do not exist today. ARC technologies were initially developed in partnership with DARPA and the National Science Foundation and leverage internet-of-things (IoT) technology and machine learning to derive actionable insights and transform operational responses. This novel technology will be deployed at scale to enhance safety, decision-making, and sustainment for the warfighter at the tactical edge.

What You'll Do

ARC delivers artificial intelligence to the individual weapon, turning weapon systems into networked sensors that enhance warfighter situational awareness, survivability, and sustainment in contested environments. Our full-stack product spans an embedded IoT sensing device hosted in or on the weapon, intelligent mobile applications, and cloud-based analytics that aggregate device data into insights on weapon performance and mission-critical, situation-dependent data streams for our customers across national defense, law enforcement, and security.
We are looking for a Senior Systems Engineer to work across the engineering organization (firmware, hardware, mobile, backend, and data science) as the connective tissue that keeps a complex, multi-domain product coherent. You will own the systems-engineering discipline: requirements, interfaces, architecture documentation, and the development processes that let a fast-moving startup ship reliable hardware-plus-software systems. This is not a paper-only role. We want an engineer who can dig into the technical substance across the stack, from a firmware timing issue or a sensor-integration constraint to a networking ICD or a cloud data pipeline, and weigh in credibly, then capture the decision so the whole team moves faster.

Role Responsibilities - How You Will Make an Impact

  • Serve as the systems engineer across the engineering team, bridging hardware, firmware, and cloud, and owning end-to-end system architecture and the interfaces where domains meet

  • Capture, decompose, and maintain current and future system requirements spanning the embedded device, mobile applications, and cloud analytics, and trace them from customer need through verification

  • Own the interface control documents (ICDs) and data contracts between firmware, mobile, backend, and data, driving toward machine-readable, version-controlled schemas that keep the BLE, WebSocket, and API contracts aligned as the device firmware and platform evolve

  • Dig into the technical detail as needed, across firmware behavior, sensor and hardware integration, power and timing constraints, networking protocols, and cloud data flow, and provide credible technical judgment to the responsible teams

  • Champion strong development processes (requirements management, design reviews, configuration and change control, and verification/validation) scaled appropriately for a startup

  • Own the creation of clear technical documentation: architecture descriptions, requirements, test plans, and decision records that keep cross-functional teams aligned

  • Drive system-level verification and validation, including component simulators, digital twins, and integration testing for functional verification and regression

  • Collaborate closely with mobile developers, firmware engineers, hardware engineers, and data scientists to design forward-thinking approaches to hard, multi-domain problems

  • This position requires travel less than 10% of the time in support of in-person events including system testing

Relevant Skills and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in systems, electrical, or computer engineering, computer science, or a related field

  • 7+ years of engineering experience, with a track record spanning both hardware/firmware and software systems

  • Demonstrated ability to operate as a systems engineer across disciplines, owning requirements, interfaces, and architecture on products that combine embedded hardware with cloud software

  • Hands-on depth in IoT and embedded systems: sensor integration, firmware/hardware interaction, wireless links such as BLE, constrained-network operation, and device-to-cloud data paths. Familiarity with embedded C, an RTOS such as Zephyr, and low-power wireless SoCs (e.g., Nordic nRF) is a strong plus

  • Strong grasp of networking protocols and interface control documents (ICDs)

  • Familiarity with cloud-agnostic architectures and modern back-end/orchestration technologies

  • Working knowledge of decentralized identity management, including zero-trust frameworks

  • Excellent technical writing and documentation skills, with a bias toward making process lightweight and useful rather than bureaucratic

  • Experience in a start-up environment

This position will require access to restricted information and facilities protected under U.S. laws and regulations, including the National Industrial Security Program Operating Manual (NISPOM). Please note that any offer for employment will be conditioned on any required authorization to receive access to such restricted information and facilities necessary to perform the responsibilities of the position.

Citizenship Verification: This position requires verification of U.S. Citizenship to meet federal government security screening requirements required for this role. The successful candidate must be a U.S. Citizen and otherwise eligible to obtain access to classified information and facilities necessary to perform the responsibilities of the position.

401k plan

Employer paid employee medical, dental and vision

12 paid holidays plus Flexible PTO Policy

Industry: Social Casino / iGaming / Computer Games

About the Role

High 5 Games is seeking a highly driven, data-obsessed B2C Operations CRM & Product Manager to lead and scale our player engagement, retention, and growth strategies.

In this role, you will bridge the gap between high-level growth strategy, campaign execution, and operations. You will own the end-to-end player communication lifecycle, from onboarding and conversion to VIP loyalty and reactivation. You will utilize inhouse marketing automation tools, A/B testing, and deep data analytics. If you thrive in an ad-hoc fast-paced environment and love building scalable CRM strategies that drive real business growth, we want to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities

CRM & Lifecycle Operations

  • Strategy & Execution: Design and coordinate the development and deployment of multi-channel CRM campaigns (In-App Messaging, Push Notifications, Email, SMS) aimed at driving player acquisition, retention, monetization, and reactivation.
  • Customer Journey Mapping: Design and optimize automated player journeys (onboarding, conversion flows, VIP loyalty tracks, and win-back sequences) through data-backed experimentation.
  • Database Hygiene & Segmentation: Lead the entire database workflow—from identifying target player segments and cleaning data to maintaining contact database accuracy and proper segmentation.

Growth & Lifecycle Optimization

  • Growth Initiatives: Partner with Marketing, Product, and Data Science teams to design growth tactics, rewards, incentives, and promotional mechanics tailored for social casino players.
  • A/B Testing & Experimentation: Rigorously test campaign creative, copy, timing, coin/bonus offers, and segmentation to maximize Open Rates, CTRs, and In-App Purchases (IAP).
  • Copywriting & Creative Messaging: Draft compelling, compliant, and high-converting campaign copy that simplifies complex game mechanics/promotions and engages casino players.

Performance, Analytics & Reporting

  • Data-Driven Insights: Analyze player behavioral data, cohort trends, and campaign metrics to uncover actionable insights that improve lifetime value and reduce churn.
  • KPI Tracking: Define, monitor, and present key performance indicators (Open Rates, Conversion Rates, ARPU, Retention Rates, ROI) in weekly, monthly, and quarterly reports for leadership.
  • Operational Alignment: Coordinate cross functionally across data team, design, customer support and product teams to ensure seamless execution of live operational events and promotions.

Requirements

Experience & Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Analytics, or a related field.
  • Experience: 3+ years of experience in digital marketing, with a heavy emphasis on CRM, growth hacking, or lifecycle marketing (preferably in Social Casino, iGaming or Crypto ecosystems).
  • CRM Tools: Hands-on experience with mobile marketing platforms and CRM/automation tools (e.g., Salesforce or similar).
  • Analytical Skills: Strong proficiency in marketing analytics, BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker), and data analysis (Excel/SQL is a plus) to measure campaign ROI and player behavior.

Skills & Competencies

  • Deep understanding of B2C operations, CRM principles, retention loops, and player monetization strategies.
  • Excellent copywriting and communication skills with the ability to turn data into compelling player messaging.
  • Detail-oriented project management skills with the ability to manage multiple complex campaigns simultaneously.
  • Location: Remote / Work from Home

High 5 Games is an equal opportunity employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, religion, sex, age, marital status, national origin, sexual orientation, citizenship status, veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status. We prohibit discrimination in decisions concerning recruitment, hiring, compensation, benefits, training, termination, promotions, or any other condition of employment or career development. jobs.excerpt: Are you experienced in financial institutions and eager to shape the future of AI?
jobs.description:
Are you experienced in financial institutions and eager to shape the future of AI? Large-scale language models are evolving from simple conversational tools into systems capable of analyzing financial frameworks, interpreting regulatory structures, and supporting complex institutional decision-making. With high-quality training data, tomorrow’s AI can help strengthen financial literacy, improve risk analysis, and support professionals across banking and financial services. That training data begins with you—we need your expertise to help power the next generation of AI.

We’re looking for individuals with knowledge of banking systems, financial regulation, capital markets, retail and commercial banking, central banking, compliance, risk management, lending practices, financial products, and institutional governance. You’ll challenge advanced language models on topics such as balance sheet analysis, regulatory compliance frameworks, credit risk assessment, liquidity management, capital adequacy, anti-money laundering controls, financial reporting standards, and macroeconomic policy impacts—documenting failure modes so we can strengthen model reasoning and accuracy.

On a typical day, you will engage the model with financial institution scenarios, regulatory and compliance questions, and analytical exercises; verify factual correctness and institutional logic; assess risk-related reasoning; capture reproducible error traces; and provide structured feedback to improve prompts, evaluation frameworks, and analytical depth. You may also help identify where models oversimplify financial regulations or misinterpret institutional processes.

A background in finance, economics, accounting, business administration, or a related field is preferred but not required. Experience working in banks, credit unions, regulatory bodies, financial consultancies, or related institutions is highly valued. Entry-level candidates with foundational knowledge of financial systems and strong analytical skills are encouraged to apply. Clear, metacognitive communication—explicitly articulating reasoning and decision processes (“showing your work”)—is essential.

Ready to turn your financial institutions expertise into the knowledge foundation for tomorrow’s AI? Apply today and help train systems that support finance professionals and institutions worldwide.

We offer a pay range of $6 to $65 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above. As a contractor you’ll supply a secure computer and high-speed internet; company-sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply.

The Role

Sr. Machine Learning Engineer. A research-minded machine learning engineer who thrives at the intersection of cutting-edge AI, scientific research, and rigorous engineering. This role is for someone excited to build and scale the models, infrastructure, and AI tools that accelerate Dyno’s work at the frontier of AI-driven genetic medicine.

Job Type: Full Time

Location: Watertown, MA; Remote

How You Will Contribute

As a Sr. Machine Learning Engineer, you will build and scale the ML infrastructure, tools, and workflows that power Dyno’s research efforts. You will partner closely with AI scientists, protein engineers, and fellow ML engineers to turn novel research into robust, reusable systems—improving model training and inference, optimizing performance, and advancing agentic AI workflows that accelerate scientific discovery.

At Dyno, every role is mission-driven. Whether in science, engineering, operations, or business, each AAViator contributes to solving some of the most complex challenges in genetic medicine.

Responsibilities:

  • Build modular, generalizable, and portable ML training systems that support the ongoing development of protein design models.
  • Improve the scalability, reliability, and performance of ML training and inference infrastructure to enable rapid research experimentation.
  • Optimize model performance using tools such as GPU profiling, custom kernels, and modern accelerated computing frameworks.
  • Develop and standardize agentic AI workflows that increase research velocity while maintaining appropriate safety and reliability.
  • Partner closely with AI scientists, protein engineers, and other ML engineers to translate research prototypes into robust, reusable tools and systems.
  • Contribute across the ML engineering stack, from modeling and GPU-level optimization to distributed training and multi-node orchestration.
  • Stay current on emerging ML engineering and agentic AI tools and help the team evaluate and adopt approaches that advance Dyno’s research.
  • Support the delivery and communication of Dyno’s work, both internally and externally.
  • Work with urgency and adaptability, balancing innovation with execution.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally, leveraging Dyno’s high-trust, high-impact culture to drive results.

Basic qualifications

  • 5+ years professional experience building software for machine learning
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals (OO design, testing, version control, dependency management, API design)
  • Experience containerizing code for remote environments including hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Experience with large-scale distributed training or inference with Ray or a similar framework
  • Familiarity with ML performance engineering (identifying bottlenecks, analyzing resource usage, profiling, writing custom kernels)
  • Experience designing and owning technically complex systems through requirements-setting, implementation, rollout and maintenance
  • Ability to contribute to technical direction through design reviews, cross-team planning, documentation, etc.
  • Alignment with Dyno’s core values - We seek individuals who step up when things get tough, recalibrate when priorities shift, and thrive in a high-expectation environment.
  • A proactive, problem-solving mindset - you don’t just identify challenges; you find solutions.

Preferred qualifications

  • Professional or academic experience in ML research / scientific computing
  • Experience building internal platforms and/or developer tools
  • Familiarity with common MLOps tools and practices (model monitoring, model versioning, CI/CD, model registries)
  • Experience with GPU programming (CUDA, Triton, etc).
  • Highly proficient in agentic and usage of modern AI tools for software development
  • Exposure to biology, bioinformatics, structural biology, or protein modeling

The Company

At Dyno Therapeutics, we are a high-energy, high-impact team on a mission to build high-performance genetic technologies that transform patient lives. Our team unites world-class molecular biologists, protein engineers, software developers, data scientists, and machine learning experts—all working together at the intersection of AI and genetic medicine.

Our culture is defined by three core values that guide everything we do:

  • One Mission: Everything we do is for the mission. We are a cohesive and motivated team, thinking ahead and supporting one another to overcome challenges.
  • Proactive Responsibility: We take action, inject energy into our work, and hold ourselves accountable for delivering results.
  • Reaching for Excellence: We constantly strive for excellence, fueled by curiosity, adaptability, and the courage to speak hard truths in pursuit of success.

These values are more than words—they drive our actions and decisions. Our greatest strength isn’t technology—it’s our work ethic. More than just technologists, we’re a team of relentlessly resourceful problem-solvers: with an unshakable drive we generate breakthroughs at the intersection of AI and genetic medicine.

🚀 What You’ll Give:

  • Bring an unstoppable work ethic, stepping up when things get tough and adapting as priorities shift.
  • Embrace challenges as opportunities, finding solutions where none exist and driving innovation forward.
  • Operate with urgency, responsibility, and resilience, because this mission demands the best from us.

🎯 What You’ll Get:

  • Competitive compensation & equity—your contributions drive results, and we pay accordingly.
  • Mission-aligned, high-trust environment—we succeed together, supporting each other through challenges.
  • A career-defining experience—work at the forefront of AI-driven genetic medicine, tackling problems that reshape healthcare.

If you’re ready to push boundaries, build the future, and thrive in a fast-moving, high-impact environment—we’d love to hear from you.

Virtual Instructional Coach

Remote | Contract

Who We Are

At EdConnective, we believe the most powerful tool in any classroom is the educator. Our mission is to ensure every student thrives by supporting exceptional teacher and leader growth. When educators grow, students win—and our work accelerates that growth every day.

If that excites you, you’re in the right place. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds, experiences, and education levels.

Why You’ll Love EdConnective

  • Real Impact, Every Day – Your work will directly improve outcomes for educators and students. Our inboxes are full of stories showing just how transformational this support can be.

  • No Gimmicks, Just Great Work – Our customer approach is consultative, thoughtful, and high-integrity. No pressure tactics. No spammy follow-ups.
  • Elite Team, Shared Mission – You’ll collaborate with leaders and mentors who’ve helped to build iconic education organizations (Rosetta Stone, Hobsons, and others) and you’ll work alongside expert coaches with thousands of years of combined experience.
  • Smart Tools, Less Busywork – We use modern tech to automate the tedious and amplify the strategic.
  • Serious About Growth – We invest in you. With a personalized development plan and ongoing learning support, you’ll have room to level up fast.

About the Role

Instructional Coaches partner directly with educators in virtual coaching relationships throughout the school year. Through one-on-one coaching conversations, instructional artifact review, and evidence-based reflection, coaches help teachers identify high-leverage next steps that lead to lasting instructional improvement.

At EdConnective, coaching is not evaluative—it's collaborative. Our coaches serve as thought partners who ask meaningful questions, facilitate reflection, analyze evidence of teaching and learning, and help educators translate professional learning into improved classroom practice.

Coaches receive onboarding and training in the EdConnective Coaching Model, which emphasizes relationship-building, data-informed decision-making, reflective practice, and actionable next steps. Coaches work with educators across a variety of instructional settings, including elementary, secondary, adult education, and other specialized learning environments.

What You'll Do

As an Instructional Coach, you will:

  • Build trusting, collaborative coaching relationships with educators.
  • Facilitate engaging virtual one-on-one coaching meetings throughout the school year.
  • Review instructional artifacts (classroom recordings, lesson plans, etc) and collect objective evidence of teaching and learning.
  • Analyze instructional practices and student learning evidence to identify strengths and opportunities for growth.
  • Partner with teachers to set meaningful professional goals and monitor progress over time.
  • Support educators in implementing research-based instructional practices that improve student outcomes.
  • Ask reflective questions that promote teacher ownership, problem-solving, and continuous improvement.
  • Help educators translate professional learning into sustainable classroom practice.
  • Document coaching conversations and maintain accurate coaching records.
  • Collaborate with EdConnective team members to ensure a consistent, high-quality coaching experience.

Who You Are

The ideal candidate:

jobs.excerpt: Descripción completa del empleoLocation: Remote – LATAM Department: Sales / Business Development Employment Type: Full-Time Work Schedule: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM EST Compensation: Competitive USD Salary About Treatspace / PracticeBeatTreatspace is a Pittsburgh-based healthcare technology company focused on helping medical practices improve how they attract, engage, and connect patients with care.
jobs.description:
Descripción completa del empleo

Location: Remote – LATAM
Department: Sales / Business Development
Employment Type: Full-Time
Work Schedule: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM EST
Compensation: Competitive USD Salary

About Treatspace / PracticeBeat

Treatspace is a Pittsburgh-based healthcare technology company focused on helping medical practices improve how they attract, engage, and connect patients with care.

As we continue to grow, we’re investing in an important new area of the business: strategic and channel partnerships.

We’re looking for someone to help us build that channel.

The Opportunity

We’re hiring a Channel Partnerships Manager – Healthcare SaaS to identify, develop, activate, and grow partnerships that can become a meaningful source of new customers and revenue for Treatspace.

This isn’t a role where you’ll inherit a mature partner program and simply manage existing relationships.

You’ll help build the channel from the ground up.

You’ll identify organizations that serve or influence the same healthcare customers we do, develop relationships with key stakeholders, create mutually beneficial partnerships, and ultimately help turn those relationships into qualified opportunities for our Account Executive team.

We’re looking for someone who can think strategically about partnerships but is also comfortable doing the work required to create them.

That means researching potential partners, reaching out, getting meetings, building relationships, creating value for both organizations, and staying involved until the partnership produces real opportunities.

What You’ll DoBuild the Partner Ecosystem

  • Identify and prioritize potential channel and strategic partners
  • Research potential partners based on strategic fit, customer alignment, reach, and revenue opportunity
  • Prospect into new partner organizations through phone, email, LinkedIn, networking, events, and referrals
  • Build relationships with executives, sales leaders, partnership leaders, and other key stakeholders
  • Develop a clear value proposition for why organizations should partner with Treatspace
  • Help structure and launch referral, co-selling, strategic, and channel relationships

Activate Partners

Signing a partnership is only the beginning.

You’ll work with partners to make sure they understand who we help, where Treatspace can create value, and how to recognize potential opportunities.

You’ll:

  • Build relationships with partner sales teams and account managers
  • Educate partners on Treatspace and PracticeBeat
  • Help partners identify customers who could benefit from our solutions
  • Develop simple messaging and talk tracks partners can use to introduce Treatspace
  • Create repeatable processes for partner referrals and introductions
  • Coordinate joint outreach and account-mapping opportunities
  • Work with Marketing and Sales to create partner-facing materials and campaigns
  • Maintain regular communication with active partners to keep Treatspace top of mind

Turn Partner Relationships Into Pipeline

This is ultimately a revenue-generating role.

You’ll be responsible for helping partnerships produce qualified sales opportunities.

When a partner identifies a potential customer, you’ll help make sure the introduction turns into a meaningful conversation.

That includes:

  • Coordinating introductions between partners, prospects, and Treatspace Account Executives
  • Providing context around the relationship and opportunity before AE meetings
  • Helping prospects understand the value of engaging with Treatspace
  • Participating in partner-sourced sales conversations when appropriate
  • Working alongside AEs to maintain momentum throughout the sales process
  • Keeping partners engaged during active opportunities
  • Helping strengthen the value of the relationship rather than simply passing over a name
  • Following up with partners on outcomes and identifying additional opportunities

The goal isn’t just partner referrals.

The goal is partner-sourced revenue.

Help Us Build the Channel Playbook

Because this is an emerging growth channel for Treatspace, you’ll also help determine how we scale it.

You’ll work with sales leadership to evaluate:

  • Which types of partnerships produce the strongest opportunities
  • What makes partners actively refer business
  • What messaging resonates with different partner organizations
  • How new partners should be onboarded and enabled
  • What a successful co-selling motion should look like
  • Which partners deserve additional investment
  • How partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue should be measured
  • How to improve engagement and production from existing partners

You’ll help turn what works into a repeatable partner acquisition and activation playbook.

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for someone who combines business development ability with strong relationship-building skills.

You may be a great fit if you’re:

  • A Hunter – You’re comfortable creating new relationships from scratch.
  • A Relationship Builder – You understand that strong partnerships are built through trust, consistency, and mutual value.
  • Commercially Minded – You understand that partnerships ultimately need to produce measurable business results.
  • Entrepreneurial – You enjoy building something that doesn’t already have every process documented.
  • Strategic – You can identify where partnerships can create leverage for the business.
  • Persistent – You understand that meaningful partnerships take consistent effort.
  • Collaborative – You can work closely with Account Executives, Marketing, leadership, and external partner teams.
  • Accountable – You’re comfortable being measured on partner activity, pipeline, and revenue.

Experience

We’re open to candidates from backgrounds including:

  • Channel partnerships
  • Strategic partnerships
  • Business development
  • SaaS sales
  • Healthcare technology sales
  • Partner or alliance management

Experience selling into healthcare or working with organizations that serve medical practices is valuable.

Experience helping build a partner program or new business development motion from an early stage is a strong plus.

How Success Will Be Measured

Success in this position will ultimately be measured by the business the channel produces.

Key metrics may include:

  • New qualified partner conversations
  • New partnerships established
  • Number of activated partners
  • Partner-generated introductions
  • Qualified partner-sourced opportunities
  • Partner-sourced pipeline
  • Conversion of partner introductions into sales opportunities
  • Partner-influenced revenue
  • Partner-sourced closed revenue
  • Engagement and production from existing partners

We don’t want to build a large list of partners who never produce opportunities.

We want to build an engaged partner ecosystem that understands our value, introduces us to the right prospects, and becomes a meaningful extension of our go-to-market strategy.

Why Join Treatspace?Build Something

You’ll have the opportunity to help shape Treatspace’s channel strategy instead of stepping into a program that’s already been fully built.

Direct Impact on Growth

You’ll be creating a new source of pipeline and revenue for the company and will have visibility into the impact of the partnerships you develop.

Work Directly With Sales Leadership

You’ll collaborate closely with Treatspace leadership and our Account Executive team to develop the partner strategy and improve the way partner opportunities move through the sales process.

Opportunity to Grow

As the partner channel grows, this role has the opportunity to grow with it — including increased responsibility for channel strategy, larger strategic relationships, and future partnership leadership opportunities.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive salary paid in USD
  • Full-time remote position
  • Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM EST schedule
  • U.S. company holidays
  • Weekends off
  • Opportunity to work with a growing U.S.-based healthcare technology company
  • Professional growth and development opportunities

Ready to Build With Us?

If you enjoy creating relationships, opening doors, building new revenue channels, and turning partnerships into measurable business results, we’d like to meet you.

This isn’t a role where you’ll simply manage an existing book of partners.

You’ll help us build the channel.
