Lead Email Designer

Remote. Full-time. Latin America.

Role is for a performance retention agency for 9-figure DTC brands. Email and SMS are the product. Design is not decoration on top of it. Campaigns have to look like the brand and still convert. The book spans fashion editorial, clean beauty, loud CPG, and luxury accessories. One house style will not work here.

We are hiring the person who owns email design quality across the agency, and we are hiring in Latin America because the work runs on US hours and the talent here is better than the market pays for.

This is a player-coach seat. You set the first designs for every new client yourself. You build the visual system they will live in: type, photography treatment, merchandising, campaign worlds. Then you lead the graphic designers who execute against that system, and you hold the bar on everything that leaves the agency.

If you have only ever executed someone else's art direction, or only designed for one brand in-house, this is not the role.

What you'll own

  • The first emails for every new client. You design them. You do not brief them out and hope.
  • The visual system for each brand: type, photography (crop, cutout, collage), color, merchandising, motion if it earns its place.
  • Design quality across the whole book of business. If a campaign looks like a Klaviyo template, a restyled module, or a social graphic dumped into an email, that is on you.
  • The graphic designers. Brief them, critique the work, raise the floor, and keep them shipping at the standard you set.
  • Campaign-level art direction for weekly sends, promos, and drops. Each drop should feel like a designed world, not a product grid with a new header.
  • Partnership with strategists and copywriters. You take a brief and make it look expensive. You push back when the brief will produce generic work.
  • Taste across categories. A fashion drop and a clean beauty campaign should not share a layout.

Hours

You hold 9am to 5pm EST every working day. The rest of your day is yours to shape. Mexico City is EST minus 1, Bogotá is EST, Buenos Aires and São Paulo are EST plus 2. If you are not willing to protect that window, do not apply.

Requirements

    • You have worked at an agency that services 9-figure ecommerce / DTC brands. Name the agency and the brands. "Worked with" logos you never designed for do not count.
    • An exceptional email book. Campaign art direction, not flow production. Custom display type, photography that is treated, merchandising that still looks designed. If the book is catalog, sale, and default type, do not apply.
    • You still design. This is not a Creative Director seat for someone who only critiques. The first work on a new client is yours.

    • Range. Fashion, beauty, CPG, accessories. One aesthetic is a specialist. We need a lead.

    • Based in Mexico, Colombia, Argentina, Brazil, Chile, or Costa Rica, and able to work 9am to 1pm EST.

Job Description:

About Us

Flui Technologies is a leading software solution provider to the energy and water sector, delivering innovative and scalable software infrastructure and services since 1990. Our solutions - MarketFlow, MeterFlow and DCC adapter - support market competition, smart metering, network flexibility and supplier integration across Energy Retail, Energy Networks and Water Retail, and are used to manage messaging for more than 35 million electricity and gas meter points, with millions of records processed per day.

As the utility sector evolves to meet the challenges of Net Zero, Smart Metering, Energy Code reform, Market-wide Half-Hourly Settlement, Demand-side Response and Embedded Generation, we combine deep industry knowledge with technical innovation to deliver robust, business-focused solutions backed by dedicated people and exceptional support. We are certified to ISO/IEC 27001:2022, reflecting our commitment to protecting data and managing risk.

The Role

The Head of Cloud Platform Engineering owns the operations and component-level architecture of Flui's AWS cloud estate - the infrastructure that underpins software processing critical market and metering data at national scale. This is a hands-on role: you will design, build and run cloud-native platforms combining AWS-native services with open-source components, and carry end-to-end accountability for how that estate performs, costs, and stands up to scrutiny.

Beyond architecture and operations, you will own FinOps and security for the cloud estate, and act as the accountable owner for its overall fitness for purpose - resilience, performance and scalability - as Flui's platforms scale to support a growing and increasingly complex utility market. You will work closely with the engineering leadership to ensure architecture decisions serve both the product roadmap and the operational realities of running critical infrastructure.

The role suits someone who wants to remain genuinely hands-on with design and build, while holding single-point accountability for how well the cloud estate is run, secured and paid for.

Job Responsibilities

The Head of Cloud Platform Engineering will report to the Technology Director and will be responsible for:

  • Owning the component-level architecture of Flui's AWS cloud estate, spanning AWS-native services and open-source/self-managed components (e.g. container orchestration, messaging, data stores, observability tooling).

  • Operating and continuously improving the platforms underpinning MarketFlow, MeterFlow and DCC adapter, with direct accountability for their resilience, performance and scalability at national-scale transaction volumes.

  • Designing and maintaining disaster recovery, high-availability and capacity plans appropriate to platforms supporting critical utility market infrastructure.

  • Owning FinOps for the cloud estate: cost visibility, forecasting, tagging and allocation, and driving measurable, ongoing cost optimisation without compromising reliability.

  • Owning cloud security posture: identity and access management, network security, encryption, vulnerability and patch management, and ensuring the estate operates in line with Flui's ISO/IEC 27001 ISMS and wider compliance obligations.

  • Defining and maintaining the non-functional standards ('fitness for purpose') that platforms must meet - resilience, performance, scalability and observability - and holding engineering teams to them through architecture review and guardrails.

  • Remaining hands-on: designing, building and, where appropriate, personally implementing infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD pipelines and platform tooling alongside the wider engineering team.

  • Owning operational rigor for the estate - incident management, on-call practice, root-cause analysis and continuous improvement of SRE practices.

  • Making and owning build-vs-buy and AWS-native-vs-open-source decisions, balancing cost, control, operability and vendor lock-in.

  • Managing key vendor and technical relationships, including AWS itself and providers of critical open-source or commercial platform tooling.

  • Partnering with the product/engineering leadership to ensure cloud architecture decisions support the product roadmap and time-to-market, and recruiting/developing a small, high-calibre platform engineering team as the estate grows.

  • Championing knowledge sharing and technical education across engineering - documenting architecture decisions and standards, running internal sessions on cloud and platform practice, and mentoring engineers and technical colleagues to raise the wider team's capability.

Essential Competencies and Experience

Business Acumen

  • Demonstrable experience owning cloud platforms supporting a regulated, high-availability or critical-infrastructure business.

  • Ability to balance technical excellence with commercial and operational reality - cost, risk, and delivery pace.

  • Understanding of the utility/energy sector's data and resilience expectations is an advantage.

Cloud Architecture & Platform Engineering

  • Deep, hands-on AWS expertise across compute, storage, networking, data and security services, ideally evidenced by current AWS certification(s).

  • Proven experience designing and operating cloud-native platforms that combine AWS-native services with open-source components (e.g. Kubernetes, Terraform, Kafka or equivalent messaging, Prometheus/Grafana or equivalent observability).

  • Track record of owning a FinOps practice and delivering demonstrable, sustained cloud cost savings.

  • Strong cloud security background - IAM, encryption, vulnerability management - and familiarity with compliance frameworks such as ISO/IEC 27001.

  • Experience defining and meeting non-functional requirements: high availability, disaster recovery, performance/load testing and scalability at production scale.

General

  • Strong infrastructure-as-code skills (Terraform, CloudFormation or CDK) and mature CI/CD practice.

  • Comfortable operating hands-on day to day while also owning strategy, standards and team development.

  • A track record of sharing knowledge and raising technical capability across a team or wider engineering community - through documentation, mentoring, or internal training.

  • Willingness to participate in on-call/incident response as needed for platforms supporting critical services.

Job Qualifications

  • A degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline is a bonus, or equivalent hands-on experience.

  • Current AWS certification(s) - e.g. Solutions Architect Professional, DevOps Engineer Professional or Security Specialty - highly desirable.

Your Personal Characteristics Will Include

  • A pragmatic engineer-leader: hands-on by instinct, comfortable balancing strategic ownership with keyboard time.

  • Security and cost-conscious by default, without losing sight of reliability and delivery speed.

  • Calm and structured under pressure, with a methodical approach to incident response.

  • Curious and current - actively tracks the evolving cloud and open-source ecosystem.

  • Advocates simplicity and resists unnecessary complexity or over-engineering.

  • A clear communicator, able to translate technical trade-offs into business terms for the leadership team.

  • A natural teacher and mentor, who enjoys raising the technical capability of colleagues and peers, not just delivering the work themselves.

Paradigm is seeking a Claims Contract Attorney to support our client, a global leader in the legal services industry. In this role, you will support complex product liability class action and mass tort matters, reviewing and analyzing claims, responding to inquiries from claimants and counsel, and helping ensure matters are handled accurately, professionally, and in accordance with established legal and project requirements. This is an excellent opportunity for an attorney who combines strong analytical and communication skills with careful attention to detail and a client-service mindset. Type: 12-month contract Location: Remote — candidates must reside in one of the approved hiring locations listed below Benefits: Medical, dental, vision, life, 401(k), PTO, and sick days Approved Hiring Locations: Arizona, Washington DC, Florida, Illinois, Kansas, Missouri, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Oregon, Tennessee, Maryland, New Jersey, South Carolina, Virginia, Washington, Alabama, Colorado, Connecticut, Delaware, Georgia, Idaho, Indiana, Kentucky, Louisiana, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Nevada, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, Texas, Utah, Wisconsin Job No: Para_1485 Assignment lengths are estimated based on the expected load or scope of work. There is a possibility that the work may last longer or finish sooner than anticipated. Evaluate claim information for completeness, accuracy, and compliance with established criteria and project requirements. Identify potential issues, discrepancies, or missing information requiring additional review or follow-up. Prepare clear, detailed, and professional written responses to inquiries from claimants and counsel. Respond to telephone inquiries from claimants and attorneys, explaining claim-related information and requirements clearly and professionally. Apply legal judgment, critical thinking, and issue-spotting skills when reviewing claims and resolving questions. Follow established protocols and procedures while incorporating guidance from project team members. Work collaboratively with attorneys, project managers, and other team members to address issues and keep matters moving efficiently. Maintain a high level of accuracy, confidentiality, responsiveness, and professionalism. Provide exceptional service to both internal and external clients. Requirements Our skills and experience wish list includes: JD from an accredited U.S. law school. Active license in good standing in at least one U.S. jurisdiction. Leadership Experience/Potential Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and issue-spotting skills. Mass Tort, Class Action, Product Liability, or Claims Administration experience Legal document review and analysis experience Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to communicate professionally with claimants, attorneys, clients, and internal team members. Attention to detail. Ability to work independently while following established procedures and project requirements. Professional, responsive, and comfortable working in a deadline-driven environment. Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.

Position Title:ProjectAdministratorI (MEP)– Design Department

Position Location:Remote–workvirtually fromanywhere in the United States

Job Summary

TheProjectAdministratorI (MEP) will have the opportunity tointerface withthe Design Department and is part of the Design Team. The successful candidate willdemonstrateproblem-solving skills, effective teamwork, and respect for deadlines while providing project administrative support across both design and construction phases.

The ProjectAdministrator I (MEP) will rely on instructions and pre-established guidelines to perform the functions of the job and will work under immediate supervision. The ProjectAdministrator Iwill communicate andoperatein line with organizational goals and values, as well as departmentalobjectives.

Essential Functions

Document Organization and Management (35%)

  • Work with project managers and coordinators to capture and organize project conditions, key decisions, deadlines, and direction in meeting notes, action-item trackers, and decision logs.
  • Log, file, andmaintainincoming and outgoing project documents, including drawings, specifications, RFIs, submittals, and meeting records, using approvednamingand filing standards.
  • Ensure proper version control of all documents,maintainingthe latest versions for review and clearly archiving superseded versions.
  • Update and maintain document and correspondence logs so that project teams can seecurrent statusat a glance.
  • Archive andmaintainhistorical documentation to support future project needs, audits, andcloseout.
  • Maintain and update project-specific SharePoint or similar document repositories, including folder structures, permissions (as directed), and links used by the team.

Communication,Coordination, and Construction-Phase Tracking(30%)

  • Collaborate with project managers, coordinators, engineers, and other team members to ensure that project direction, decisions, and deadlines are clearly documented and circulated.
  • Maintain project deadline calendars and assist in tracking key milestones and deliverable dates, including internal and external submission targets.
  • Download RFIs, submittals, and other construction-phase documents from client or contractor portals, enter key information into tracking tools, and route items to theappropriate teammembers according to standard procedures.
  • Return reviewed and approved documents via client- or contractor-specific portals, ensuring files are correctly named and posted to the right locations.
  • Coordinate and schedule internal and external project meetings, including sending calendar invitations and sharing relevant materials.
  • Take and distribute meeting notes for meetings attended, capturing decisions, action items, and due dates and updating trackers as directed.
  • Send routine, process-focused communications such as document transmittals, upload confirmations, and schedule reminders using approved templates and guidelines.

Quality Controland Revit / Drawing Support(20%)

  • Check documents for completeness, correct file naming, and basic formatting before submission or filing, and flag discrepancies for project leads.
  • Assistin preparing documentation for project closeout, including compiling final drawing sets, specifications, and key correspondence.
  • Perform periodic spot-checks of document organization and logs to support consistency, accuracy, and audit readiness.
  • Provide limited, non-technical Revit-based support, primarily related to printing or exporting drawings and assembling drawing sets; advanced modeling knowledge is notrequired.

Administrative and Project Support (15%)

  • Provide general administrative support to project teams, including scheduling meetings, preparing correspondence, and handling other clerical tasks as needed.
  • Support project teams inmaintainingand updating high-level project schedules or trackers as directed, including recording progress against key deliverables.
  • Handle routine project correspondence, including responding to and managing document requests within defined guidelines.
  • Use Microsoft Office applications and project platforms to prepare, format, and organize project information and reports.
  • Use AI-based tools and automation methods to improve the efficiency of routine administrative tasks such as document formatting, basic data extraction, and drafting standard communications.
  • Complete assigned tasks and deliverables on time and on budget.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

Completion of Assigned Tasks and Deliverables on Timeand onBudget.

Position Requirements (BEGINNERlevel for all the following unless otherwise noted)

  • Proficiencyin AI-based tools and methodologies to increase efficiency in administrative and documentation tasks.
  • Proficiencyin Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) for managing documents, tracking data, and effective communication.
  • Familiarity with project and construction platforms used for document control, tracking, and collaboration (training will be provided).
  • Skill in organizing andmaintainingdocuments with attention to detail and accuracy in categorizing, filing, and version control of project documentation.
  • Strong communicationand interpersonal skills to support collaboration across teams and communicate effectively with project stakeholders.
  • Ability tomaintainconfidentiality and handle sensitive information.
  • Ability to work successfully in a remote environment through effective communication and organizational skills, self-motivation, proactiveness, and resourcefulness in a distraction-free workspace.
  • Ability tomaintainneat, orderly, complete documents and project files.
  • Ability to work successfully as a member of a team and independently with supervision.
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet close deadlines.
  • Organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously and adapt to changing business requirements as necessary

Physical Demands

The following physical demands must be met by the employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonableaccommodationmay be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is:

Travel Requirements

  • Travel is defined as physically leaving home on behalf of business activities including but not limited to client sites, meetings with other employees,meetingfor business development purposes, running errands on behalf of the business, attending industry conferences, etc.

Education / Experience

  • Minimum of two years of experience in a professional office or consulting services environment, with exposure to project or construction administration support.
  • High school diploma or equivalent; an associate degree in construction management, architecture, engineering technology, or a related field can substitute for one year of experience.

Benefits

DLB Associates offers a very competitive benefits package; highlights include

  • Choice of comprehensive medical plans (including two PPO-style plans and a HDHP w/ HSA option)
  • Flex spending accounts (FSA)

CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC residents only: In accordance with CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC law, the range provided is DLB's reasonable estimate of the base compensation for this role. The actual amount may differ based on non-discriminatory factors such as experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and location.

The ideal candidate genuinely enjoys creating order, managing operational details, following through thoroughly on tasks, and supporting a busy team.

As a Program Assistant, you will be responsible for completing various operational support tasks and playing a key role in the company's daily workflow. The ideal candidate will possess strong digital organizational skills, keen attention to detail, and the ability to effectively collaborate with team members across a remote setup.

The role will report to the Founder / Operations Manager. This is WFH (US Shift)

If you have the right skill set, this may be your opportunity to enter this fast-growing organization.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, Communications, Education, or any related field.

  • 3+ years of experience in administrative, operations, virtual assistance, or executive support roles.

  • Prior experience working in education, non-profit, creative agency, or remote youth program environments is highly advantageous.

  • High proficiency in Google Workspace (Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides, Calendar) and robust digital organizational skills.

  • Proven experience working with project management platforms like Asana and CRM databases.

  • Familiarity with tools such as Airtable, Jotform, Gusto (HR/Payroll), and ActivityHero is a major plus.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a highly professional, thoughtful tone.

  • Strong time management and exceptional follow-through, with a proven ability to manage multiple priorities independently in a remote setup.

jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.excerpt: About Andesa Andesa is the leading provider of policy and plan administration solutions in the Advanced Markets space, including policy transaction management and NQDC recordkeeping.
jobs.description:
About Andesa

Andesa is the leading provider of policy and plan administration solutions in the Advanced Markets space, including policy transaction management and NQDC recordkeeping. These solutions simplify the ongoing administration of both complex life insurance and annuity products in BOLI, COLI, ICOLI, and Private Placement and a wide range of NQDC plan types. Using market and product expertise, configurable capabilities for complex products, and security and reliability at scale, Andesa improves speed to market and empowers carriers and brokers to serve high-value markets with confidence.

In late March 2026, Terminus Capital Partners, an Atlanta based private equity firm focused on enterprise software companies, acquired a majority stake investment in Andesa to accelerate growth and increase investment in technology modernization, platform capabilities, and long-term innovation, while preserving the company's client-centric culture and operational continuity.

The hiring of an Account Executive builds on this momentum and reflects Andesa's commitment to invest in the people, processes, and platforms behind its policy lifecycle and plan administration solutions.

The Opportunity

This is a high‑impact opportunity to join a growing go-to-market team and drive new revenue and expand Andesa’s presence in the broker ecosystem.

As our Account Executive focused on the broker segment, you will be responsible for identifying, engaging, and converting new business opportunities, as well as building relationships with brokers, consultants, and distribution partners who influence Advanced Markets and NQDC plan administration decisions.

You will ultimately inherit a few brokers as a book of business to farm and expand, but this is a primarily hunter sales role. You will be developing territory plans, building your own pipeline, and opening doors with brokers and strategic partners who may be unfamiliar with Andesa’s NQDC plan administration capabilities.

This role is ideal for a sales professional who thrives on prospecting, relationship‑building, and creating momentum in underdeveloped markets.

What You'll Own

You will be the primary driver of new business within the broker segment — responsible for pipeline creation, deal execution, and market expansion.

Broker & Prospect Development

  • Execute a broker‑focused go‑to‑market strategy and sales process targeting Advanced Markets and NQDC distribution partners
  • Develop account plans for high‑value brokers, consultants, and strategic prospects
  • Conduct proactive, outbound outreach — including cold calls, email sequences, and event‑based networking — to generate new opportunities
  • Research broker firms, market trends, and client needs to identify whitespace and position Andesa’s solutions effectively
  • Establish strong relationships with key decision‑makers and influencers across target firms

Sales Execution & Deal Management

  • Lead prospects through the full sales cycle: discovery, solution alignment, demos, proposals, contracting, and handoff to implementation
  • Build and manage a pipeline of broker relationships, driving new business and expanding existing partnerships.
  • Educate brokers and their plan sponsor clients on our administration capabilities for nonqualified deferred compensation (NQDC) plans, executive benefits, COLI/BOLI-funded arrangements, and related solutions.
  • Tackle technical validation or software demonstrations of Andesa’s platforms and articulating how they modernize operations in Advanced Markets and unlock value for brokers
  • Partner with internal teams to scope solutions, tailor demos, develop pricing strategies, and deliver compelling proposals
  • Own RFP/RFI responses, coordinating cross‑functional contributors to deliver complete and timely submissions
  • Ability to communicate Andesa’s value proposition clearly and persuasively

Market Expansion & Strategic Insight

  • Identify opportunities to expand Andesa’s presence within broker networks and adjacent markets
  • Provide market intelligence to Product and leadership teams to inform roadmap priorities and platform enhancements
  • Represent Andesa at industry events, conferences, and broker‑focused forums
  • Collaborate with Marketing and Customer Success to ensure alignment across the broker channel

Administration & Performance

  • Meet or exceed established sales quotas and activity targets
  • Develop and refine pricing strategies across markets and product types
  • Maintain accurate pipeline data, forecasting, and activity tracking within the CRM

What We’re Looking For

This role requires an experienced, proactive, and consultative sales professional who thrives in a hunting environment. The right candidate is comfortable building pipeline, navigating complex sales cycles, executing mutual action plans, and engaging sophisticated broker audiences.

Must have

  • 7+ years in enterprise sales or account management, with a strong track record of new business generation
  • Strong consultative selling skills and the ability to translate complex plan design and tax concepts into clear business value.
  • Excellent presentation, negotiation, and written communication skills.
  • Proven ability to build long‑term, B2B relationships and partnerships
  • Strong business acumen in sales planning, forecasting, and execution
  • Willingness to travel approximately 25–40% of time for broker visits, client meetings, and industry events.
  • Bachelor’s degree required

Nice to have

  • Demonstrated success in one or more of the following: executive benefits, NQDC plans, retirement plan administration, life insurance–funded executive benefit strategies, or high-net-worth financial planning.
  • Knowledge of Advanced Markets non‑qualified plan administration
  • Experience selling Enterprise SaaS or technology‑enabled services into broker or consultant channels
  • Existing relationships within the Advanced Markets or NQDC broker ecosystem
  • Working knowledge of ERISA, IRC Section 409A, and the tax and regulatory frameworks governing deferred compensation.
  • Direct experience selling to—or selling through—insurance brokers, benefits consultants, RIAs, or wirehouse advisors.
  • Background in complex, multi-threaded B2B sales cycles with multiple stakeholders
  • Familiarity with plan administration, policy administration, or related operational workflows

What Success Looks Like

  • First 30 days: Develop a strong understanding of Andesa’s products, broker ecosystem, and competitive landscape. Territory and named account plan drafted.
  • First 90 days: Active outbound motion underway. Early broker meetings secured. Pipeline beginning to form across target prospects and accounts.
  • First 6 months: Consistent pipeline generation. First deals progressing through late‑stage cycles. Strong broker relationships established within target accounts.

What We Offer

  • Starting base salary range of $120,000-$170,000 with performance‑driven variable compensation
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees
  • 401(k) retirement plan with competitive employer matching contributions
  • Generous PTO program with annual allocations based on years of service
  • The opportunity to shape Andesa’s broker channel and grow into a leadership role as we scale

How to Apply

Send your resume and a cover letter about why this role interests you by clicking the "Apply now" application link. If you have examples of sales achievements, broker relationships, or go‑to‑market strategies you’ve executed, we’d love to see them.

Andesa Services is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to building an inclusive team.

Work Environment

Work Schedule: This is a full-time (40 Hours/Week) exempt position. Hours are flexible within core business hours. This position is fully remote reporting out of our office in Allentown, PA.

Location: Remote

Reports to: President & Chief Transformation Officer

Type: Full-time

jobs.title: Senior Developer - Detection Platform
jobs.excerpt: At Arctic Wolf, you won’t just watch the cybersecurity industry evolve – you'll help lead the change.
jobs.description:
At Arctic Wolf, you won’t just watch the cybersecurity industry evolve – you'll help lead the change. Our global Pack is made up of people who thrive on solving hard problems, moving fast, and building technology that protects organizations around the world. We’re proud to be recognized by Forbes, CNBC, Fortune, CRN, Bartner Peer Insights and IDC MarketScape – but what matters most is the work behind it: delivering real outcomes for customers through award winning innovation like our Aurora Platform.

If you’re looking for meaningful work, smart teammates and the chance to make a real impact in a high-growth company that’s redefining security operations, Arctic Wolf is the right place for you!

 

Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk. We’re looking for a Senior Developer to be part of making that happen.  

About the Role

We are an innovation team within R&D, building internal products that power our Threat Intelligence and Detection authoring teams to secure our customers.

Working at petabyte scale, we build systems that enhance existing detections and unlock entirely new detection capabilities. We are mission-driven to secure the customer. We don't just follow industry standards, we help define them, building detection systems that set the bar for what's possible in cyber defence.

The team is responsible for the ingestion, correlation, and operationalization of threat intelligence for both detection and research purposes. We are committed to teaching, supporting, and growing one another while owning outcomes end to end, from greenfield ideation through to deploying industry-first detection capabilities.

This role is for a highly skilled developer responsible for delivering major product features independently, mentoring team members, and driving technical excellence across software development practices. The role plays a key part in architecture, design, and strategic initiatives.

The ideal candidate has comprehensive knowledge of software development practices, mastery over writing and debugging code, and provides feedback to others on the team. They perform complex programming tasks and implement software systems, often including other team members as part of the effort. They assume responsibility for the quality and delivery of their code, participate in architecture reviews and technical design sessions, and complete major product features with little or no guidance while resolving dependencies across teams.

Our team is collaborative and cross-functional, working closely with data scientists, security researchers, and SOC analysts. We maintain a high-quality bar, with a culture of consistent iteration, monitoring, and improvement, and regularly meet with internal customers to understand their needs and design solutions that address them.

Responsibilities

  • Consistent and active participation in team development activities, including daily scrums, retrospectives, Test Fest, and related ceremonies. Consistently embodies team values and upholds others to.

  • Joins daily standup and takes on tasks by priority, such as proactively selecting the next story.

  • Supports the on-call rotation.

  • Supports other developers by unblocking them and providing training as needed.

  • Sets standards for maintainable code practices and continuously improves them.

  • Embodies quality from requirements, use cases, design, and code.

  • Completes complex programming tasks.

  • Participates in and often owns architecture and high-level design meetings.

  • Reviews peers’ code and provides detailed feedback.

  • Takes an active role in retrospectives, Test Fest, and similar activities.

  • Takes ownership of cross-functional dependencies and aligns with other teams.

  • Coaches through pairing, code examples, and knowledge share sessions.

  • Reviews and provides input to high-level designs.

  • Maintains awareness of business objectives, identifies how work applies to those objectives, and identifies new opportunities for work to support business objectives.

  • Understands design patterns and design anti-patterns.

  • Helps grow and develop others on the team.

  • Mentors junior team members.

  • Identifies and addresses technical debt and system bottlenecks, raising and resolving risks.

  • Aligns deliverables with broader business objectives and OKRs.

  • Designs and delivers Proofs of Concept (POCs) for high-impact projects.

  • Leads brainstorming sessions for architectural and strategic initiatives.

  • Works on Proofs of Concept (POCs) to clarify approaches.

  • Identifies patterns and anti-patterns to drive best practices.

  • Innovates solutions that address strategic goals.

  • Leads high-impact, cross-functional initiatives.

  • Removes complex technical debt in the system.

  • Provides strategy and direction.

  • Identifies “better together” solutions.

  • Provides strategic direction on complex technical challenges.

  • Actively mentors’ engineers on a regular weekly cadence.

  • Works across multiple repositories and teams.

  • Conducts knowledge sharing sessions.

  • Leads technical workshops.

  • Works with multiple stakeholders, including PMs and PgMs.

  • Drives post-mortems and retrospectives.

About You

  • Enthusiastic, collaborative, team player, ready to accept the challenge to end cyber risk

  • Takes full ownership of outcomes — a true product engineer at heart, you drive work from ideation through delivery and beyond, treating every product as your own and holding yourself accountable for its real-world impact

  • Experienced working directly with internal customers - identifying pain points and turning them into innovative, implemented solutions

  • Hands-on building and maintaining large-scale data pipelines on cloud-based platforms

  • Proficient with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and its native data and compute services

  • Familiar with streaming frameworks like Kafka, Spark Structured Streaming, or Flink

  • Experience designing and shipping production-grade RESTful or gRPC APIs, with a strong grasp of scaling and throughput management

  • Skilled at scaling stateless and stateful services under production load, including low-latency, multi-regional backend systems

  • Grounded in security best practices and standards

  • Comfortable deploying and operating services in containerized environments such as Kubernetes

  • Comfortable and pragmatic about AI - you adopt it where it delivers real value and hold a high bar for quality and ROI

Success in this Role

  • Takes full ownership of major product features and ensures successful delivery

  • Drives alignment between engineering deliverables and organizational strategy

  • Establishes best practices and introduces innovative solutions to systemic challenges

  • Introduces innovative solutions to organizational problems

  • Drives systemic improvements and sets best practices

  • Drives innovation and alignment across the organization

  • Resolves systemic technical challenges while advancing strategic initiatives

  • Improves team processes and decision-making

  • Aligns outcomes with organizational goals

On-Camera Policy
To support a fair, transparent, and engaging interview experience, candidates interviewing remotely are expected to be on camera during all video interviews. Being on camera fosters authentic connection, improves communication, and allows for full engagement from both candidates and interviewers. We understand that technical, bandwidth, or location-related challenges may occasionally prevent video use. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations.

About Arctic Wolf

At Arctic Wolf, we foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment that thrives on diversity of thought, background, and culture. This is reflected in our multiple awards, including Top Workplace USA (2021-2024), Best Places to Work – USA (2021-2024), Great Place to Work – Canada (2021-2024), Great Place to Work – UK (2024), and Kununu Top Company – Germany (2024). Our commitment to bold growth and shaping the future of security operations is matched by our dedication to customer satisfaction, with over 7,000 customers worldwide and more than 2,000 channel partners globally. As we continue to expand globally and enhance our technology, Arctic Wolf remains the most trusted name in the industry.

Our Values 

Arctic Wolf recognizes that success comes from delighting our customers, so we work together to ensure that happens every day. We believe in diversity and inclusion and truly value the unique qualities and unique perspectives all employees bring to the organization. And we appreciate that—by protecting people’s and organizations’ sensitive data and seeking to end cyber risk— we get to work in an industry that is fundamental to the greater good. 

We celebrate unique perspectives by creating a platform for all voices to be heard through our Pack Unity program. We encourage all employees to join or create a new alliance. See more about our Pack Unity here.  

We also believe and practice corporate responsibility, and have recently joined the Pledge 1% Movement, ensuring that we continue to give back to our community. We know that through our mission to End Cyber Risk we will continue to engage and give back to our communities. 

All wolves receive compelling compensation and benefits packages, including: 

  • Equity for all employees

  • Flexible time off and paid volunteer days

  • RRSP and 401k match

  • Training and career development programs

  • Comprehensive private benefits plan including medical, mental health, dental, disability, life and AD&D, and value-added services

  • Robust Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with mental health services

  • Fertility support and paid parental leave

jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

SAP HAZMAT Functional Resource

Position Overview

The SAP HAZMAT Functional Resource will support the JTMS SAP S/4HANA program by providing functional expertise for the management, configuration, integration, and sustainment of hazardous material (HAZMAT) processes within the SAP environment. This resource will work closely with functional teams, technical teams, business stakeholders, and customer representatives to ensure hazardous material requirements are accurately represented within SAP and integrated across applicable logistics and supply chain processes.

The ideal candidate will have experience supporting SAP solutions involving hazardous material or dangerous goods management, material master data, logistics execution, transportation, warehousing, and/or environmental health and safety processes within a complex enterprise environment. Experience supporting Department of Defense (DoD), federal, or similarly regulated environments is highly desirable.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as a functional subject matter expert for SAP HAZMAT and Dangerous Goods-related business processes within the SAP S/4HANA environment.
  • Analyze customer and program requirements related to hazardous material identification, classification, storage, handling, movement, transportation, and reporting.
  • Support configuration and functional design of SAP capabilities used to manage hazardous and regulated materials.
  • Maintain and validate HAZMAT-related master data, classifications, attributes, and regulatory information associated with materials.
  • Support integration of HAZMAT requirements across SAP functional areas, including Materials Management (MM), Transportation Management (TM), Extended Warehouse Management (EWM), Sales and Distribution (SD), and other applicable logistics processes.
  • Support Dangerous Goods Management processes associated with the transportation and shipment of regulated materials.
  • Ensure HAZMAT requirements are appropriately incorporated into material movement, shipping, receiving, warehousing, and transportation workflows.
  • Collaborate with business process owners and functional SMEs to translate operational and regulatory requirements into SAP functional requirements and system solutions.
  • Develop functional specifications, process flows, configuration documentation, business requirements, and system design documentation.
  • Identify functional gaps and recommend SAP-standard solutions, configuration changes, enhancements, or process improvements.
  • Support data migration, cleansing, validation, and reconciliation activities associated with hazardous material data.
  • Participate in system integration testing (SIT), user acceptance testing (UAT), regression testing, and defect resolution.
  • Develop test scenarios and validate end-to-end HAZMAT processes across integrated SAP modules.
  • Troubleshoot functional issues and coordinate with technical development, integration, security, and infrastructure teams to resolve system defects.
  • Support compliance with applicable federal, DoD, transportation, environmental, and hazardous material regulations and policies.
  • Assist with development of standard operating procedures, training materials, job aids, and end-user documentation.
  • Participate in workshops, design sessions, demonstrations, and customer working groups to support implementation and continuous improvement activities.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience supporting SAP functional implementations, sustainment, or modernization efforts.
  • Functional knowledge of hazardous materials, Dangerous Goods, regulated materials, or environmental health and safety processes within SAP.
  • Experience with SAP S/4HANA and/or related SAP logistics capabilities.
  • Understanding of material master data and its relationship to logistics, warehousing, transportation, and supply chain processes.
  • Experience gathering business requirements and translating requirements into SAP functional designs and system configurations.
  • Experience supporting functional testing, defect management, and system implementation activities.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex cross-functional SAP processes.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with functional, technical, business, and customer stakeholders.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to develop clear functional and technical documentation.
  • 10% Travel every 12 weeks to Scott Air Force Base.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with SAP S/4HANA Dangerous Goods Management and/or SAP Environment, Health, and Safety (EHS) capabilities.
  • Experience integrating HAZMAT processes with SAP TM, MM, EWM, SD, or other logistics modules.
  • Knowledge of hazardous material classification, labeling, packaging, storage, shipping, and transportation requirements.
  • Familiarity with regulatory frameworks governing hazardous materials and Dangerous Goods transportation.
  • Experience supporting SAP data migration or master data management activities involving regulated materials.
  • Previous experience supporting DoD, USTRANSCOM, federal logistics, or other large-scale government SAP programs.
  • Experience working within Agile/Scrum or scaled Agile delivery environments.
  • SAP certification in a relevant functional area is preferred but not required.

Desired Technical/Functional Knowledge

The successful candidate should have working knowledge of several of the following areas:

  • SAP S/4HANA
  • SAP Dangerous Goods Management
  • SAP EHS / Product Compliance
  • SAP Materials Management (MM)
  • SAP Transportation Management (TM)
  • SAP Extended Warehouse Management (EWM)
  • SAP Sales and Distribution (SD)
  • Material Master and HAZMAT master data
  • Dangerous Goods classification and determination
  • Transportation and shipment documentation
  • HAZMAT labeling and regulatory information
  • Data migration and validation
  • SAP functional configuration
  • Functional and integration testing
  • Requirements analysis and process documentation

jobs.title: Director of Employee Health and Safety
jobs.excerpt: The START Center for Cancer Research (“START”) is the world’s largest early phase site network, fully dedicated to oncology clinical research.
jobs.description:
The START Center for Cancer Research (“START”) is the world’s largest early phase site network, fully dedicated to oncology clinical research. To date, over 45 therapies conducted at START locations have obtained FDA/EMA approval.

The START Center for Cancer Research is seeking aDirector of Employee Health and Safety (Remote)who will provide strategic and operational leadership for START's Occupational Health and Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) program across START's clinical operations. This role is accountable for the design, documentation, standardization, implementation, and day-to-day execution of programs that ensure a safe environment for employees, patients, and research activities while maintaining up-to-date compliance with applicable federal, state, and local regulations.

The Director ensures adherence to OSHA, USP <797/800>, NIOSH, drug handling guidance, EPA requirements, and research standards. Given START's focus on oncology clinical research, this role also encompasses compliance touchpoints relevant to investigational product handling, hazardous drug exposure, and Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and ICH guidelines as they intersect with site safety obligations.

This role establishes and maintains enterprise-wide EHS standards, policies, and procedures governing areas such as drug storage and handling, PPE, fit testing, hazardous material and chemical management, and workplace incident response.

Partnering cross-functionally with Operations/Clinical Leadership, HR, and Compliance, this role translates regulatory and compliance requirements into practical, scalable processes that integrate seamlessly into site operations. The Director will also support select compliance program initiatives under the direction of the Vice President, Compliance and General Counsel, serving as an additional resource for enterprise-wide compliance priorities. The role is responsible for proactive risk identification, incident response, and continuous improvement of safety performance. Success is measured by reduced risk exposure, strong compliance outcomes, and seamless support of business objectives.

This is a remote role. The salary range for this role is $135,000 - $155,000.However, base pay may vary depending on multiple individualized factors including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

Work Schedule:

Monday-Friday 8:00am-5:00pm

Essential Responsibilities

Health & Safety (EHS) Compliance

  • Develop, own, and lead a national EHS strategy aligned with organizational growth and operational complexity.
  • Design, implement, and maintain EHS program aligned with OSHA and applicable federal, state, and local regulations.
  • Build and operationalize standardized EHS program across all U.S. sites, ensuring consistency while accommodating state-specific requirements.
  • Ensure compliance across START's clinical, including clinical hazard protocols specific to oncology research settings such as needlestick/bloodborne pathogen exposure response, chemotherapy and hazardous drug spill response, aerosolizing agent exposure, and post-exposure pathways.
  • Lead site assessments, audits, and inspections; implement corrective actions proactively.
  • Maintain all required regulatory reporting and documentation, including OSHA logs and incident records.
  • Provide executive-level reporting on risk, compliance, and safety performance.

Occupational Health

  • Build and manage occupational health programs including injury prevention, case management, return-to-work processes, fitness for duty, and medical surveillance programs.
  • Partner with HR and third-party vendors on workplace accommodations, fitness-for-duty assessments, and employee health-related compliance matters.
  • Coordinate with occupational health providers, workers' compensation carriers, and third-party vendors.
  • Support leaders in responding to workplace injuries or health concerns with clear, compliant processes.

Risk Management & Incident Response

  • Lead investigations into workplace incidents, near misses, and safety concerns.
  • Identify trends and implement preventive strategies to reduce risk exposure.
  • Conduct root cause analysis and implement corrective and preventive actions, tracking findings through to verified closure — supporting movement toward a high-reliability operating environment.
  • Maintain a robust near-miss and incident reporting culture; ensure follow-up actions are documented, assigned, and resolved, not merely logged.
  • Oversee emergency preparedness and response planning across U.S. locations.

Training & Safety Culture

  • Design, implement, and deliver role-based safety and occupational health training for all employees and supervisors, including new hire EHS onboarding, annual safety competency assessments, and training plans tailored to clinical hazard exposure levels.
  • Embed a culture of accountability and proactive risk identification aligned with START values.
  • Ensure onboarding includes essential safety and health training components; establish and maintain role-specific training matrices.

Operational Partnership

  • Partner with Operations, Clinical Leadership, HR, and Compliance to integrate EHS into workflows and service delivery.
  • Support new site openings, program expansions, and operational changes with safety and environmental assessments.
  • Provide practical, field-ready guidance to managers to ensure compliance without creating operational burden.
  • Support compliance program projects and initiatives as directed by the Vice President, Compliance and General Counsel, contributing subject matter expertise and implementation capacity.

Reporting & Continuous Improvement

  • Establish and track key safety and occupational health metrics (e.g., incident rates, lost time, near-miss frequency, compliance completion, CAPA closure rates).
  • Provide regular updates and executive summaries to leadership.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance safety while supporting efficient operations.

Required Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Environmental Health, Occupational Health, Safety, or related field.
  • 5+ years of progressive experience in EHS, occupational health, or workplace safety.
  • Demonstrated experience building and operationalizing EHS programs in a multi-site environment; healthcare, clinical research, or life sciences setting strongly preferred.
  • Experience managing clinical safety hazards, including hazardous drug handling, bloodborne pathogen programs, and post-exposure response protocols.

Preferred Education and Experience:

  • Certified Safety Professional (CSP), Occupational Health Nurse (OHN), or similar credential.
  • OSHA 30-hour training or equivalent certifications.
  • Familiarity with GCP/ICH guidelines and the intersection of clinical trial operations and site safety obligations.

Physical & Travel Requirements:

  • Travel: Required to travel up to 50% of the time across START's U.S. site network.
  • Sitting: Must be able to sit for extended periods of time.
  • Standing: Must be able to stand for extended periods of time.
  • Bending: Must be able to reach overhead, at shoulder level, or bend to perform tasks.
  • Lifting: Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds.
  • Frequent use of computer, keyboard, and mouse.

Best-in-Class Benefits and Perks

We value our employees’ time and efforts. Our commitment to your success is enhanced by a competitive compensation, depending on experience, and an extensive benefits package including:

  • Comprehensive health coverage: Medical, dental, and vision insurance provided
  • Robust retirement planning: 401(k) plan available with employer matching
  • Financial security: Life and disability insurance for added protection
  • Flexible financial options: Health savings and flexible spending accounts offered
  • Well-being and work-life balance: Paid time off, flexible schedule, and remote work choices provided
  • Plus, we work to maintain the best environment for our employees, where people can learn and grow with the company. We strive to provide a collaborative, creative environment where everyone feels encouraged to contribute to our processes, decisions, planning, and culture.

More about The START Center for Cancer Research

Deeply rooted in community oncology centers globally, The START Center for Cancer Research provides access to specialized preclinical and early-phase clinical trials of novel anti-cancer agents. START clinical trial sites have conducted more than a thousand early-phase clinical trials, including for 43 therapies that were approved by the FDA. START represents the world’s largest roster of Principal Investigators (PIs) across its eight clinical trial sites. Committed to accelerating passage from trials to treatments, START delivers hope to patients, families, and physicians around the world.

Learn more at .

Ready to be part of a team changing the future of cancer treatment?

Join us in our mission to conquer cancer, one clinical trial at a time. Your expertise and dedication can help us bring hope and healing to patients worldwide. Please submit your application online.

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.

Bien que nous ayons parcouru un long chemin depuis nos débuts, nos ambitions sont plus grandes que jamais. Une opportunité unique d’améliorer la santé à l’échelle mondiale s’offre à nous.

L’équipe

Chez Dexcom, nous transformons la prise en charge du diabète grâce à notre technologie de mesure continue du glucose (MCG).

En Belgique, notre priorité est de préserver et développer notre solide présence hospitalière en renforçant les relations avec nos clients, en accélérant l’adoption et le leadership du système Dexcom G7, et en assurant une exécution irréprochable dans un environnement de soins de santé de plus en plus complexe, marqué par les appels d’offres, les attentes en matière d’intégration aux dossiers médicaux électroniques (DME) ainsi que par les exigences liées à la contractualisation et à la facturation électronique.

Vous rejoindrez une équipe Benelux à taille humaine, où l’accent est mis sur la concentration, la responsabilité et l’excellence opérationnelle.

En tant que Regional Sales Manager Belgium, vous occuperez un rôle de manager de proximité, combinant leadership et implication terrain. Vous dirigerez une équipe composée de 4 représentants commerciaux et d’un éducateur clinique, tout en collaborant étroitement avec les équipes Market Access, Marketing, Médicales et Opérations afin de soutenir la croissance et l’excellence opérationnelle en Belgique. Le Luxembourg fait également partie du périmètre, dans la mesure où l’un des membres de l’équipe en assure la couverture.

Une responsabilité essentielle du poste consiste à piloter la préparation et l’exécution des appels d’offres en Belgique, en veillant à ce que Dexcom soit systématiquement prêt pour les opportunités à venir et que les soumissions ainsi que leur mise en œuvre après attribution soient réalisées avec rapidité, qualité et coordination transversale.

Vos missions

  • Diriger, accompagner et développer une équipe basée en Belgique composée de 4 représentants commerciaux et d’un éducateur clinique afin d’atteindre les objectifs commerciaux, avec un fort accent sur la performance des comptes hospitaliers et la qualité d’exécution.

  • Représenter la Belgique au sein de l’équipe de direction Benelux (BLX LT) et assurer un alignement étroit entre l’exécution terrain en Belgique et au Luxembourg et les priorités stratégiques du Benelux.

  • Assurer la fidélisation et la croissance de la base installée grâce à une gestion proactive et structurée des comptes, une priorisation rigoureuse et une excellente cadence de management terrain (entretiens individuels, accompagnements sur le terrain, réunions d’équipe).

  • Piloter la planification commerciale en Belgique : segmentation et ciblage du marché, traduction des priorités en plans d’action territoriaux et comptes-clés, suivi de la performance via le CRM et les outils analytiques.

  • Assurer la préparation et l’exécution des appels d’offres : coordination du processus de réponse, clarification des rôles et responsabilités (RACI), mobilisation des contributions nécessaires (proposition de valeur, données cliniques, documentation et éléments tarifaires), et suivi de la mise en œuvre après attribution.

  • Maintenir un suivi clair et visible du pipeline d’appels d’offres en Belgique et animer une gouvernance interne régulière afin d’aligner les parties prenantes sur le statut, les risques, les échéances et les prochaines étapes.

  • Collaborer avec les parties prenantes internes pour répondre aux exigences opérationnelles liées aux appels d’offres, notamment les attentes en matière de facturation électronique susceptibles d’influencer l’éligibilité ou l’exécution des contrats.

  • Promouvoir et mettre en œuvre les initiatives commerciales stratégiques telles que la migration vers Dexcom G7, la préparation aux systèmes AID (Automated Insulin Delivery), l’engagement des professionnels de santé, les activités de conversion et le développement de la notoriété de la marque, en partenariat avec les équipes Marketing et Médicales.

  • Garantir le respect de l’ensemble des politiques HCC, juridiques et d’entreprise, y compris les cadres contractuels et tarifaires ainsi que la qualité du reporting et de l’administration

Votre profil

  • Vous êtes un manager reconnu, capable d’accompagner la performance de vos équipes grâce à des objectifs clairs, une structure managériale solide, une présence terrain et des retours de développement concrets.

  • Vous disposez d’une expérience confirmée dans la vente dans le secteur de la santé ou des technologies médicales (MedTech) et êtes à l’aise dans les environnements hospitaliers ainsi que dans la gestion de comptes à cycle long.

  • Vous avez une expérience démontrée de la gestion complète d’appels d’offres : analyse des exigences, coordination des parties prenantes, planification et soumission de dossiers de haute qualité dans des délais contraints.

  • Vous possédez un solide jugement commercial et savez trouver le bon équilibre entre proposition de valeur, qualité et stratégie tarifaire dans un contexte concurrentiel.

  • Vous êtes à l’aise avec l’analyse de données et l’utilisation des CRM pour piloter la performance commerciale, établir des prévisions fiables et identifier les opportunités de croissance.

  • Vous excellez dans la gestion des parties prenantes et l’influence transverse, en mobilisant efficacement les équipes Market Access, Marketing, Médicales, Opérations, Finance ou IT lorsque nécessaire.

  • Vous maîtrisez le français, le néerlandais et l’anglais, afin d’interagir efficacement avec les clients et collaborateurs à travers la Belgique.

Ce que nous offrons

  • L’opportunité d’être au premier rang d’une technologie de mesure continue du glucose qui change la vie des patients.

  • Un programme complet d’avantages sociaux.

  • Des opportunités de développement et d’évolution à l’échelle internationale.

  • L’accès à des formations internes et à des dispositifs de soutien au développement professionnel.

  • Un environnement de travail innovant et stimulant au sein d’une entreprise leader de son secteur, engagée envers ses collaborateurs, ses clients et les communautés qu’elle sert.

Déplacements professionnels

  • Entre 50 % et 75 % du temps.

Formation et expérience requises

  • Diplôme de niveau Bachelor (ou équivalent) généralement requis.

  • Entre 8 et 12 ans d’expérience professionnelle dans le secteur concerné.

  • Entre 2 et 5 ans d’expérience managériale ou de coordination d’équipe.

Travail à distance : votre lieu de travail principal sera votre domicile. Vous devez résider à Bruxelles ou à proximité immédiate.

jobs.title: Growth Marketing Manager
jobs.excerpt: Growth Marketing ManagerLocation: Remote.  At this time, we are hiring in the Philadelphia, Denver, Portland, or Seattle areas.
jobs.description:
Growth Marketing Manager

Location: Remote. At this time, we are hiring in the Philadelphia, Denver, Portland, or Seattle areas.

Travel: Up to 10% travel, may fall outside of normal business hours.

Type: Full-Time

Compensation: $85,000–$95,000 annually, depending on experience
Experience Level: 3+ years in digital or growth marketing

Who We Are

Mile6 creates digital products and marketing experiences that drive breakout growth for clients on the cusp of big things. We are growth-centered, people-focused drivers of change.

You’ll join a team of strategists, marketers, designers, developers, and product professionals who bring different disciplines together to solve meaningful business problems. We trust and empower our teammates to do big and great things in and outside the day-to-day business of Mile6.

Sharing and learning are the responsibility of every member of the team. All teammates work with their manager to establish monthly, quarterly, and annual professional development goals.

What You’ll Do

As Mile6’s Growth Marketing Manager, you’ll lead performance-focused marketing programs that turn attention into qualified leads, retained audiences, and measurable growth.

Paid search will be your strongest discipline. You’ll own campaign strategy, execution, optimization, and reporting across platforms such as Google Ads and Social Media Advertising. You’ll also bring strong SEO and content marketing capabilities, helping Mile6 and our clients build sustainable organic visibility alongside paid acquisition.

This is a hands-on role for a curious generalist who enjoys connecting campaigns, search intent, content, landing pages, analytics, and user behavior. You’ll continually test new ways to improve results, from ad copy and keyword strategies to landing-page headlines, calls to action, and conversion paths.

Responsibilities

  • Develop, execute, and optimize paid search strategies that generate qualified leads and support measurable business growth.
  • Own paid search campaigns from planning through reporting, including account structure, keyword research, audience targeting, ad creation, bidding, budgeting, testing, and ongoing optimization.
  • Manage advertising budgets responsibly, monitor pacing, and make data-informed decisions to improve return on ad spend and cost per qualified lead.
  • Build clear performance reports that connect campaign activity to leads, pipeline, revenue, and client goals.
  • Diagnose campaign performance issues and identify opportunities across targeting, messaging, landing pages, offers, and conversion paths.
  • Develop and execute SEO strategies that improve organic visibility, qualified traffic, and conversions.
  • Conduct keyword, competitor, technical, and content-gap research to guide SEO priorities.
  • Partner with writers, designers, developers, and subject matter experts to plan and produce useful, search-informed content.
  • Write, edit, and optimize marketing content, including landing pages, articles, campaign messaging, headlines, calls to action, and lead-generation assets.
  • Create and manage an editorial calendar aligned with audience needs, search opportunities, campaigns, and business priorities.
  • Develop a growing conversion-rate optimization practice across Mile6 and client engagements.
  • Plan and run A/B tests for landing-page copy, headlines, calls to action, forms, offers, page structures, and other conversion elements.
  • Form clear testing hypotheses, define success metrics, document results, and turn findings into actionable improvements.
  • Collaborate with design and development teams to create and improve high-performing landing pages and digital conversion experiences.
  • Ensure analytics, advertising pixels, conversion events, and campaign tracking are implemented accurately.
  • Use quantitative and qualitative data to understand visitor behavior and identify friction throughout the lead journey.
  • Work directly with clients to understand their businesses, audiences, sales processes, goals, and definitions of a qualified lead.
  • Communicate proactively with clients about performance, insights, recommendations, risks, and next steps.
  • Collaborate with Mile6’s Growth, Strategy, Product, Design, and Development teams to connect marketing execution with broader business and digital product goals.
  • Support new-business opportunities by contributing to marketing audits, proposals, estimates, presentations, and strategic recommendations.
  • Improve Mile6’s internal marketing processes, templates, documentation, reporting, and quality standards.
  • Stay current on changes to search platforms, SEO practices, analytics, privacy expectations, AI-assisted marketing, and conversion optimization.
  • Use AI tools thoughtfully to accelerate research, analysis, content development, experimentation, and campaign operations while maintaining accuracy, originality, and human judgment.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in digital marketing, growth marketing, performance marketing, or a related role.
  • Advanced, hands-on expertise managing paid search campaigns, particularly through Google Ads and Social Media.
  • Demonstrated success improving qualified lead volume, cost per acquisition, conversion rates, and return on advertising investment.
  • Strong understanding of keyword strategy, campaign architecture, bidding, budgets, audiences, ad testing, attribution, and conversion tracking.
  • Strong working knowledge of SEO, including content strategy, on-page optimization, keyword research, search intent, internal linking, and foundational technical SEO.
  • Experience developing and optimizing content that supports both search visibility and business goals.
  • Excellent copywriting and editing skills, with particular strength in concise, persuasive headlines, advertisements, landing pages, and calls to action.
  • Experience with landing-page optimization, conversion-rate optimization, or structured marketing experimentation.
  • Ability to turn data and user behavior into clear hypotheses, recommendations, and priorities.
  • Familiarity with analytics, tag management, search reporting, heat-mapping, session-recording, or A/B testing platforms.
  • Ability to explain marketing performance clearly to clients and teammates with different levels of technical knowledge.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple campaigns, clients, and priorities.
  • A collaborative, low-ego approach to working with strategists, designers, developers, sales professionals, and client stakeholders.
  • Curiosity, initiative, and a willingness to question assumptions and continually improve how work gets done.
  • Agency experience is strongly preferred.

Bonus Points

  • Experience marketing B2B services, SaaS products, digital products, or complex buying journeys.
  • Experience with Microsoft Advertising, LinkedIn Ads, paid social, or other performance channels.
  • Familiarity with Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console, Data Studio, and call-tracking platforms.
  • Experience with marketing automation, CRM systems, lead scoring, or revenue attribution.
  • Working knowledge of HTML, content management systems, and landing-page builders.
  • Experience using platforms such as VWO, Optimizely, Convert, Hotjar, or Lucky Orange.
  • Relevant Google Ads, Google Analytics, SEO, or conversion optimization certifications.

How Success Will Be Measured

  • Growth in qualified lead volume and marketing-sourced opportunities.
  • Sustainable improvement in cost per qualified lead and return on advertising investment.
  • Accurate budget pacing, tracking, attribution, and reporting.
  • Growth in qualified organic traffic and search visibility.
  • Consistent delivery of useful, high-quality content tied to business goals.
  • A regular cadence of well-designed landing-page and messaging experiments.
  • Measurable improvement in landing-page conversion rates.
  • Clear, proactive client communication and strong long-term client relationships.
  • Useful collaboration with Mile6’s Growth, Product, Design, and Development teams.

Our Benefits

  • Remote-friendly work culture.
  • Unlimited paid time off and flexible schedules.
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance.
  • Disability and life insurance.
  • 401(k).
  • Paid holidays.
  • Professional development support.
  • Regular company-paid functions.
  • A collaborative environment that fosters learning, experimentation, and professional growth.

Our Commitment

We know that we have a responsibility to create and grow a diverse, equitable, and inclusive agency within our industry. As we continue to grow, we are committed to making our agency representative of the beautiful world of which we are a part.

If you’re a performance marketer who knows paid search deeply, understands how SEO and content create lasting growth, and gets excited about testing the words and experiences that turn visitors into leads, we’d love to meet you.

In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire.

Salary: $85,000-$95,000

jobs.description:
Consultor de Calidad de Datos Proficient

Habilidades Requeridas:
  • Experiencia práctica con herramientas empresariales de Calidad de Datos como: Informatica Data Quality (IDQ), Talend Data Quality, SAP Information Steward, IBM QualityStage, Oracle Data Quality o herramientas equivalentes.
  • Conocimiento sólido de las dimensiones de Calidad de Datos basadas en DAMA-DMBOK: Exactitud, Integridad, Consistencia, Validez, Unicidad, Oportunidad
  • Experiencia en perfilado, evaluación y análisis de calidad de datos.
  • Diseño e implementación de reglas de validación, limpieza, normalización y estandarización de datos.
  • Dominio avanzado de SQL para análisis, validación y monitoreo de información.
  • Experiencia integrando controles de calidad en procesos ETL/ELT y pipelines de datos.
  • Conocimiento en gestión de metadatos, linaje de datos y controles de auditoría.
  • Comprensión de principios de seguridad, privacidad y cumplimiento relacionados con la gestión de datos.
  • Experiencia en análisis de causa raíz y resolución de incidencias de calidad de datos.
  • Capacidad para documentar métricas, reglas, estándares y resultados de calidad.
Habilidades Deseables:
  • Experiencia con arquitecturas modernas de datos: Data Lake, Lakehouse, Data Mesh, Data Fabric.
  • Conocimientos de DataOps aplicados a procesos de calidad de datos.
  • Experiencia en automatización de monitoreo y controles de calidad.
  • Conocimiento de plataformas Cloud: Microsoft Azure, AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
  • Experiencia trabajando con múltiples dominios de datos: Cliente, Producto, Proveedor, Finanzas, Operaciones
  • Conocimientos de Master Data Management (MDM).
  • Portugués intermedio o avanzado.
  • Experiencia en herramientas de visualización y monitoreo de métricas de calidad.

Responsabilidades

  • Ejecutar procesos de perfilado y evaluación de calidad de datos en los dominios asignados.
  • Implementar, configurar y mantener reglas de calidad de datos alineadas con los estándares organizacionales.
  • Identificar, analizar y documentar problemas de calidad, excepciones y tendencias.
  • Apoyar iniciativas de limpieza, normalización y estandarización de datos.
  • Validar resultados y participar en análisis de causa raíz para la resolución de incidencias.
  • Mantener actualizada la documentación de reglas, métricas, controles y hallazgos de calidad.
  • Colaborar estrechamente con Data Stewards, equipos de integración, QA y responsables de negocio.
  • Dar soporte a procesos ETL/ELT e iniciativas de integración desde la perspectiva de calidad de datos.
  • Monitorear indicadores y generar reportes sobre calidad, confiabilidad y uso de la información.
  • Participar en iniciativas de mejora continua orientadas al fortalecimiento de la calidad de los datos.
  • Garantizar el cumplimiento de políticas de seguridad, privacidad y gobierno de datos.
  • Contribuir a la adopción de mejores prácticas y estándares de gestión de datos dentro de la organización.

Idiomas Requeridos

Inglés Intermedio bajo

Ubicación

México o Colombia - Remoto
