jobs.description:
Job Title: Engagement CoordinatorJob Category: CommunicationsTime Type: Full timeMinimum Clearance Required to Start: SecretEmployee Type: RegularPercentage of Travel Required: Up to 10%Type of Travel: Continental US* * *

The Opportunity:

CACI is seeking an Engagement Coordinator to support our team with developing and implementing communications and change management content for our U.S. Navy customers. You will work directly with external customers and internal staff to develop compelling messaging and products to illustrate customer successes, communicate complex ideas in concise and organized formats, and coordinate communication strategies that develop the customer’s brand identity. Key components of the Engagement Coordinator’s approach include:

  • Strategic Analysis: Ensure communication tactics are grounded in thorough strategic analysis.
  • Stakeholder Identification: Identify key stakeholders and understand their impact on the achievement of organizational goals.
  • Message Alignment: Ensure products and stakeholder communications convey consistent messaging, both internally and externally.
  • Priority Alignment: Link day-to-day activities with NAVSEA and Naval Shipyard priorities.
  • Strategic Impact: Maximize strategic effects through associated communication processes.

Work site is primarily at the employee’s home site. Occasionally the employee may need to work at the customer site or a CACI office.For the most effective support of our customers, the ability to work an Eastern Standard Time work schedule is strongly preferred.

Note:This position is contingent and will only be filled upon funding approval.

Responsibilities:

  • Interact daily with individuals, groups, and teams of mid- to senior-level NAVSEA and Shipyard leaders.
  • Meet with senior stakeholders to assess needs, establish goals, and create/implement communication strategies. Refine high-level leadership discussions, complex technical information, ideas, and meeting minutes into themes and storylines that personnel at all levels can easily understand.
  • Craft clear, consistent, and easily understandable content (language, formatting, and design) that helps shape the customer’s brand identity and message.
  • Participate in team meetings to develop organizational strategies, communication processes and pipelines, and content development.
  • Create products and distribute internal and external communication materials, e.g., articles, SharePoint posts, emails, graphics, and internal newsletters that highlight the successes of process improvement and innovation initiatives.
  • Maintain communication databases. Ensure contact lists, media lists, and other communication databases are up to date.
  • Update SharePoint content and manage analytics as needed.
  • Work with stakeholders to establish, track, and report metrics related to the customer’s goals and objectives.
  • Provide oral and written reports, talking points, and executive-level summaries of complex technical ideas, processes, and projects.
  • Interact with the customer via the telephone, video conferencing, email, chat, and in person as necessary.
  • Support the execution of contract requirements, which may include submission of supporting data and metrics and timely completion of written reports to stakeholders, customers, and CACI leadership.
  • Other duties may be assigned in support of contract taskings and mission success.

Qualifications:

Required:

  • Must be a United States Citizen. Must have hold and active DOD Secret security clearance.
  • Bachelor’s degree. In lieu of the degree requirement, candidates with minimum 6 years of directly applicable work experience may be considered for this position.
  • Minimum 4 years of work experience in strategic communication, project management, facilitation, organizational development, change management, or process and performance improvement.
  • Adept at creating compelling visual imagery and editing text to produce high-quality multimedia content using various tools and techniques to enhance the aesthetic and communicative value of digital content.
  • Willingness and ability to experiment and invent new approaches to provide the highest caliber service to our customers.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and customer service orientation; ability to respectfully communicate with customers at all levels of the organization in a professional, effective manner that achieves successful outcomes.
  • Ability to perform successfully independently and as a team member in a demanding work environment.
  • Proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign), Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, and SharePoint).
  • Outstanding organizational skills to efficiently manage competing priorities, multiple concurrent taskings, and firm deadlines.

Desired:

  • Certification and/or experience in some or all of the following:

- Process and/or performance improvement.

- Change management.

- Facilitation and/or training of leaders.

  • Work experience with the Naval Maintenance Community, United States Navy, or the Department of Defense.
This position is contingent on funding and may not be filled immediately. However, this position is representative of positions within CACI that are consistently available. Individuals who apply may also be considered for other positions at CACI.

What You Can Expect:

A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

An environment of trust.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.

A focus on continuous growth.

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

Pay Range:

There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.

Since this position can be worked in more than one location, the range shown is the national average for the position.

The proposed salary range for this position is:

$51,800-$106,200

CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.

jobs.excerpt: About NOCD NOCD is the #1 telehealth provider for the treatment of obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD).
jobs.description:
About NOCD

NOCD is the #1 telehealth provider for the treatment of obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD). OCD is one of the most severe, prevalent, and misunderstood mental health conditions. NOCD creates access to online therapy for people with OCD through our telehealth platform. In the NOCD app, Members can quickly access and schedule live, face-to-face video therapy sessions with our national network of licensed Therapists that specialize in Exposure and Response Prevention Therapy (ERP) - considered the "gold standard" in OCD treatment.

At NOCD, we help people reclaim their lives with clinically proven OCD treatment, by removing barriers to OCD care, and reducing the stigma associated with OCD. We’re changing the world and need other like-minded individuals to accelerate and expand our efforts.

About the Role

As the specialist virtual behavioral health provider, at NOCD, we want our Therapists to focus on what's most important - treating and caring for our members.

NOCD is looking for Independently Licensed Therapists (LP, LPCC, LMFT, LCSW) in Kentucky to join our team.

As a NOCD Therapist, you will see our team is committed to achieving clinical excellence, an exquisite Therapist experience and providing proven & visible clinical outcomes. We have dedicated teams to handle your marketing, billing, credentialing, and scheduling. Therapists will use valuable previous clinical experience, good judgment, and our clinical guidelines to discern when to refer members to external resources.

You'll enjoy growth and support through: ongoing consultation with other team members; specialized clinical training with experienced OCD providers; information on the latest research advancements in the field; technical support and clinical protocols; 1:1 mentorship to discuss complex cases; and an open, receptive environment to provide feedback.

What You'll Do

  • Help people with OCD get better and stay better by providing top-notch care through diagnoses, assessments, and evidence-based psychotherapy via the NOCD video platform
  • Manage your caseload and schedule
  • Maintain complete and timely clinical documentation using the NOCD EHR system
  • Participate in NOCD clinical consultation, training, and advance your knowledge and practice of evidence-supported treatments for OCD
  • Collaborate with our network of providers to help develop and reinforce treatment decisions

Requirements:

  • See credentialing information here.
  • Full Time Providers:
    • 40 hour work week
    • Complete 25 hours of direct clinical work per week
    • Attend a world-class training program developed by industry leaders.
    • Attend 2 hours of weekly group clinical consultation
    • Have 10 hours of weeknight/weekend availability after 5pm local time for Member Sessions
    • Will participate in and complete cross-license application process during Onboarding
    • Open and willing to treat children and adolescents after attending NOCD Child and Adolescent training
  • Practical experience independently diagnosing is required for this role (this practical experience can be during your pre-licensed experience).
    • If you do not have this direct practical experience, proof of completion (with certificate) of the following training will be accepted in its place: Tolin & Diamond Training Video.
    • Please note: submission of proof of completion does not guarantee hire, NOCD will not reimburse the cost of this course.

Who You Are

  • Full and unrestricted license in good standing to practice in your state.
    • Masters Degree Required
    • Kentucky: Licensed Psychologist, Licensed Professional Clinical Counselor, Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist, Licensed Clinical Social Worker
  • At least 6 months of relevant experience with evidence-based therapies (e.g., ERP, CBT, ACT)
  • Knowledge and experience with treating OCD with ERP is preferable but not required
  • Organized, quick and enthusiastic learner, excellent communicator, good with time management
  • Have a confidential, private location to work remotely from with reliable internet access
  • Comfortable and efficient with using technology to communicate
  • Ambitious and ready to keep up with a goal-driven, start-up environment

What We Offer

  • A commitment to clinical excellence, an exquisite Therapist experience and proven & visible clinical outcomes.
  • Gain world-class training from experienced OCD providers to become a specialized Therapist in treating OCD and related disorders through evidence-based care.
  • A full suite of support through continued mentorship & feedback

jobs.excerpt: NVIDIA is building a new wave of accelerated computing systems, where platform manageability, secure firmware, and high-performance networking must work as one coherent architecture.
jobs.description:
NVIDIA is building a new wave of accelerated computing systems, where platform manageability, secure firmware, and high-performance networking must work as one coherent architecture. We are looking for an engineer to help define and implement OpenBMC-based management for systems that include host CPUs, BMCs, and coordinated top-of-rack Ethernet switching functionality.

This role focuses on extending the BMC from a traditional server management controller into a secure management authority for both system management and Ethernet switch management, while preserving clear separation between the BMC management plane and the switch data plane.

Are you ready to help develop the next generation of OpenBMC networking architecture? Join us at the forefront of platform firmware, system management, and enterprise network infrastructure.

What you'll be doing:

  • Architect and implement OpenBMC support for platforms where the BMC handles host system functions and a coordinated ToR Ethernet switch subsystem.

  • Define the end-to-end switch-management architecture across OpenBMC D-Bus services, bmcweb/Redfish APIs, persistent configuration, eventing, telemetry, security, and backend switch control interfaces.

  • Develop OpenBMC object models and services for switch inventory, switch ASICs, front-panel ports, internal ports, PHYs, optics, retimers, VLANs, LAGs, FDB entries, counters, sensors, and health state.

  • Implement L2 networking capabilities including port admin control, speed and FEC configuration, auto-negotiation, breakout, VLAN creation and membership, access/trunk mode, MAC learning, FDB management, flooding controls, link aggregation, and loop-prevention features.

  • Build backend abstraction layers that can integrate with Linux switchdev/netlink, SAI/SONiC/SWSS-style components, DENT-style Linux networking components, or vendor switch ASIC SDKs.

  • Work closely with hardware, ASIC, security, firmware, QA, manufacturing, and cloud infrastructure networking teams to influence board architecture, schematics, manageability interfaces, and production test strategy.

  • Write and review design specifications, API documentation, code, unit tests, hardware-in-loop tests, integration tests, and QA plans required to productize the architecture.

What we need to see:

  • Bachelor's degree or higher, or equivalent experience, in Computer Science, Electrical and Electronics Engineering, or a related field with 12+ years of relevant experience.

  • Strong OpenBMC firmware development experience on x86 or ARM-based server environments, such as Yocto, systemd, D-Bus, phosphor services, bmcweb, Redfish, firmware update, device monitoring, and platform security.

  • Hands-on experience with Ethernet switch architecture and L2 features such as VLANs, trunks, access ports, LAG/LACP, STP/RSTP, LLDP, FDB/MAC learning, storm control, ACLs, QoS, PHY management, and transceiver diagnostics.

  • System management software experience with rack or blade server platforms, including IPMI, KCS, Redfish, PLDM, MCTP, SPDM, secure firmware update, attestation, and BMC-host communication.

  • Strong programming and debugging skills in C/C++ and Python, with familiarity in Bash, Go, or Rust; ability to develop reliable Linux user-space services and review low-level system code.

jobs.description:
We are seeking senior engineers to pioneer new methodologies for accurately assessing the performance and capabilities of ground-breaking deep learning models, including LLMs, RAG, agents, and vision models. You will collaborate across the organization to bring the latest ﬂagship models from our community and partners to life. This role offers an outstanding opportunity to craft the future of AI at a fast-growing company at the forefront of the AI revolution. Join our team of world-class software engineers and partners to deliver the most advanced models with lightning-fast inference. You'll work on the most powerful, enterprise-grade GPU clusters capable of hundreds of PetaFLOPS and gain early access to unreleased hardware, making a direct impact on NVIDIA's roadmap and the broader AI landscape!

What you’ll be doing:

  • Design and build decision-grade evaluation environments for NVIDIA's frontier models spanning reasoning, multimodal, long-context, and agentic systems, producing auditable accuracy signals that gate every major model release.

  • Research and develop novel evaluation methodologies for emerging model families and capability domains (low-precision numerics, multi-turn agentic tasks, code generation) where established benchmarks don't yet exist or don't generalize.

  • Build and operate the evaluation infrastructure and pipelines including benchmark environments, regression CI systems, and statistical analysis tooling, used by model, product, and applied research teams across NVIDIA.

  • Partner with model research, training, and customer teams to translate evaluation signals into concrete decisions: release go/no-go, training iteration direction, and competitive positioning against external frontier models.

What we need to see:

  • BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a related field

  • 6+ years of hands-on experience with LLMs, designing and running evaluations for large language models or multimodal AI systems, including experience with agentic, multi-turn, or reasoning-heavy settings.

  • Strong statistical foundations: experimental design, significance testing, regression analysis, and the ability to distinguish signal from noise in benchmark results at scale.

  • Proven experience building evaluation infrastructure (pipelines, benchmark harnesses, reproducible CI systems) not just consuming existing benchmarks.

  • Clear, precise communicator who can translate quantitative evaluation results into decisions for researchers, product teams, and senior leadership.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Deep familiarity with open-source evaluation frameworks

  • Experience designing evaluations for agentic systems: tool use, multi-turn reasoning, environment-based benchmarks (SWE-bench, GAIA, WebArena-style), or interactive evaluation settings.

  • Track record of publishing or contributing to evaluation research, new benchmark design, methodology papers, or reproducibility analyses that shaped how the field measures model capability.

  • Experience measuring model accuracy under low-precision inference (FP8, INT4, quantization-aware settings) and understanding how calibration and sparsity interact with benchmark results.

  • Comfort running large-scale workloads on HPC/Slurm clusters, including reproducible experiment management (MLflow, W&B) and compute cost optimization across hundreds of benchmark runs.

jobs.description:
DIRECTOR, FHIR TECHNICAL ECOSYSTEM

HL7 International is a global, member-driven non-profit dedicated to advancing healthcare data interoperability. The organization is accredited by the American National Standards Institute (ANSI) as an international Standards Development Organization (SDO). Our widely adopted standards and frameworks are the foundation of health information exchange worldwide, enabling data to be shared, accessed, and applied to improve health outcomes and system performance.

We are entering an exciting new chapter of growth and transformation. Our strategic vision emphasizes brand recognition, revenue diversification and growth, and the ability to innovate in response to emerging healthcare challenges.

Position Summary

FHIR's technical foundations, the build, validation, and publication tooling, the publication infrastructure, the implementation-guide framework, and the body of knowledge and practice that keeps all of it working, need sustained and resilient ownership. The Director, FHIR Technical Ecosystem provides that ownership.

Working under the direction of the FHIR Product Director, the Director keeps the technical machinery of FHIR dependable and keeps the knowledge behind it distributed and documented. A defining purpose of the role is continuity: reducing the ecosystem's dependence on any one person by building documented practices, distributed technical ownership, and succession into every critical technical function.

The Director is a member of the Standards Development division and reports to the CSDO, while coordinating closely with the FHIR Product Director on functional and technical priorities, and the Deputy FHIR Product Director on process and terminology. The Director also works closely with senior leadership on business development initiatives, supports the Standards Implementation division as a technical subject-matter expert, and coordinates with the Contributor Engagement Lead on community.

This is a remote position. Travel to HL7 meetings and selected national and international industry events is required.

Key Responsibilities

Tooling, publication, and build infrastructure

  • Set direction, resourcing, and resilience strategy for FHIR build, validation, and publication tooling and infrastructure, against the requirements defined by the Product Director, so these remain dependable foundations for the community.
  • Ensure the tooling and infrastructure are actively maintained through engineers, contractors, or HL7 technical services, with no critical component dependent on a single person.
  • Ensure the resourcing and resilience of terminology services infrastructure, coordinating with the Deputy FHIR Product Director, who leads FHIR terminology ecosystem architecture.

Standards-development infrastructure and the community's workflow

  • Provide direction for the integrated set of infrastructure the community relies on to develop standards, and keep the connections between its parts coherent: the FHIR publication infrastructure, the GitHub repositories that hold the specifications and their source, the build infrastructure that turns that source into published output, the JIRA infrastructure that Work Groups use for balloting comments and issue resolution, and the documentation platforms such as Confluence that hold process and guidance.
  • Ensure these systems work together as a dependable pipeline from proposal to comment to resolution to build to publication, so that a Work Group's development activity moves through the toolchain without friction or gaps.
  • Treat this toolchain as the connective tissue between the community's standards-development work and the published specification, owning its health, integration, and evolution, and coordinating with the Deputy FHIR Product Director on the process that runs on top of it and with the Contributor Engagement Lead on the contributor experience of using it.
  • Anticipate how a change in one system, for example repository structure, issue-tracker workflow, or build process, affects the others and the Work Groups that depend on them, and manage that change so the community is supported.

Implementation-guide framework and quality

  • Own the implementation-guide authoring framework, quality expectations, and consistency standards across guides, producing specific implementation guides for adoption programs, and supporting the implementers who use them.

Technical continuity and capability

  • Establish documented practices, distributed technical ownership, and succession across critical FHIR technical functions, reducing dependence on any single individual.
  • Capture and maintain the operating knowledge behind FHIR's tooling and publication so it remains accessible to current and future contributors.
  • Contribute FHIR subject-matter expertise to HL7 education and certification.

Support to Standards Implementation

  • Serve as a senior FHIR technical subject-matter expert to the Standards Implementation division's funded work, grants, and consulting.

Business Development

  • Co-lead business development initiatives with other members of HL7’s leadership and management.

People, program, and operational leadership

  • Supervise and develop the technical and program staff responsible for FHIR tooling and publication, setting priorities, managing performance, and building a collaborative, high-trust team.
  • Manage budgets, timelines, risks, and dependencies for FHIR technical operations.

Coordination

  • Coordinate with the FHIR Product Director on requirements and priorities, the Deputy FHIR Product Director on process and terminology, the Contributor Engagement Lead on community, and the Standards Implementation division on adoption.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Substantial experience in health IT, interoperability, and standards, including technical program and people leadership.
  • Strong understanding of FHIR tooling, publication, and the specification lifecycle.
  • A track record of building resilient technical operations and reducing key-person risk through documentation, distributed ownership, and succession.
  • Experience directing software and tooling maintenance, whether through employees, contractors, or shared technical services.
  • Excellent written communication and the ability to make technical operations understandable to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Demonstrated commitment to open, community-driven development.
  • Track record of successful business development initiatives.

Leadership Attributes

  • Stewardship: motivated by the long-term health and resilience of FHIR's technical foundations.
  • Team and organizational leadership: skilled communicator, motivated to provide team leadership, clear direction and guidance to attain results.
  • Systems thinking and acting: able to see the whole tooling and publication chain and where it is fragile, and intervene accordingly.
  • Collaboration: leads through influence and coordination across roles and divisions.
  • Innovation and process improvement: Encourages and enables the development and adoption of novel technologies, and promotes continuous process improvement.

If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

As a member of the AI model team, you will drive innovation in training and optimizing vision-language models with a focus on real-world deployment. Your work will span the full model development lifecycle - from data curation and training pipeline design to model evaluation and optimization - with the goal of building models that are both highly capable and practical to deploy at scale.

You will work across a wide spectrum of multimodal architectures integrating text and vision, applying state-of-the-art research to improve model quality, efficiency, and domain-specific performance. We expect you to bring a research-driven mindset combined with strong engineering discipline - someone who can identify the right technique for a given problem, implement it rigorously, and measure its impact clearly.

You will work closely with a small, high-caliber team where your contributions will have direct and meaningful impact. If you are passionate about pushing the boundaries of what multimodal AI can achieve in production environments, this is your opportunity.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct end-to-end research and engineering on vision-language models, covering training, evaluation, and optimization across the full model development lifecycle.

  • Design and implement post-training pipelines including supervised fine-tuning, knowledge distillation, and reinforcement learning from human feedback.

  • Develop and maintain high-quality multimodal datasets, including data curation, filtering, and balancing for domain-specific tasks.

  • Drive model efficiency and deployability, adapting models for resource-constrained environments using compression and optimization techniques.

  • Design and implement evaluation frameworks and benchmarks to measure model performance, robustness, and real-world task success.

  • Build and scale training workflows across distributed GPU infrastructure.

  • Identify and resolve bottlenecks in training pipelines to achieve state-of-the-art model quality on target benchmarks.

  • Contribute to and leverage open-source ecosystems including models, datasets, and tooling to accelerate development.

  • Stay current with the latest research in multimodal learning and vision-language systems, translating relevant findings into practical improvements.

  • Publish research findings in top-tier AI conferences and journals where applicable.

Requirements

  • Degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field; MS/PhD preferred.

  • Strong experience with multimodal post-training workflows including supervised fine-tuning, knowledge distillation, and reinforcement learning from feedback.

  • Hands-on experience with parameter-efficient fine-tuning and distributed training frameworks.

  • Demonstrated ability to build and improve vision-language models with measurable results on standard benchmarks or real-world tasks.

  • Experience adapting models for resource-constrained environments.

  • Proven open-source contributions in multimodal AI on GitHub or HuggingFace.

  • Publications at top AI conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR, ECCV etc.)

Important information for candidates

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Arc XP is the content platform and operating system built to power growth for ambitious media companies. Developed by The Washington Post, Arc XP is used by leading media organizations worldwide, including The Irish Times, Libération, L’Express, RND, Graham Media Group, and Sky News. Arc XP’s platform helps media companies innovate rapidly, own audience relationships, and grow independent revenue. Arc XP supports more than 3,000 sites globally and delivers billions of pageviews each month. Learn more at .

Arc XP is hiring a Enterprise Field Marketing Manager to own our global event portfolio and build the community that supports our Media & Publishing buyers. This is an individual-contributor role reporting to the Global VP of Marketing: you’ll run programs directly rather than manage a team, partnering closely with sales, customer success, product marketing, creative, and demand generation to turn in-person experiences into pipeline.

You’ll be the single owner of every event on the calendar globally, from large trade shows and regional summits to executive dinners, roundtables, and third-party sponsorships, and the person sales counts on to turn attendance into revenue.

What Motivates You

  • A pipeline mindset. You measure success in opportunities and revenue influenced, not just attendance or leads.
  • You take pride in delivering on the finest of details, the kind that make the difference between a good event and a great event.

How You'll Support the Mission

  • Own end-to-end planning and execution of the global field event portfolio, including trade shows, regional summits, owned events, executive dinners, roundtables, workshops, third-party sponsorships, and co-sponsored partner activations, managing vendors, budgets, and timelines for each.
  • Build a cohesive pre-event, at-event, and post-event motion for every program, with a guest-first approach that brings our brand and product to life for customers and prospects.
  • Treat every event as a pipeline-generating engine: set clear goals, maximize registration-to-attendance conversion, build targeted invite lists with sales, and own the follow-up motion that converts engagement into meetings and opportunities.
  • Partner closely with regional sales leaders, SDRs, and partner managers to align programs to territory priorities, target account lists, and pipeline goals; run or closely support ABM programs tied to event activity.
  • Coordinate with channel and alliance partners on co-marketing programs and joint events.
  • Develop promotional materials and messaging for each event in partnership with product marketing, creative, and demand generation, ensuring awareness and sales execution.
  • Manage the global field marketing budget and report on program performance (pipeline sourced and influenced, cost per opportunity, event ROI), using the data to double down on what works.

The Skills and Experience You Bring

  • 5+ years of field or event marketing experience in B2B SaaS, with a track record of running programs that generate real pipeline, from large trade shows to intimate executive dinners.
  • Strong cross-functional collaborator, comfortable working with sales leadership, SDRs, customer success, partnerships, creative, content, product marketing, and executive stakeholders.
  • Experience running or closely supporting ABM programs in coordination with sales on target accounts.
  • Strong project management skills; able to run multiple events and campaigns at once, keep every detail on track, and hit deadlines without dropping quality.
  • Comfort with the marketing stack: CRM (Salesforce) and marketing automation (HubSpot or similar), plus the ability to pull and interpret your own performance data.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder skills; able to align sales, partners, and corporate marketing around a shared plan.
  • Able to travel to relevant tradeshows and conferences globally, roughly 30–50% during peak season.
  • Experience managing a field events portfolio across multiple regions.
  • Background in B2B startup marketing.
  • Experience delivering both intimate field events and larger-scale user conferences.
  • Familiarity with the SaaS landscape (strongly desired) and the Media & Publishing industry (nice to have).

Compensation and Benefits

Wherever you are in your life or career, The Washington Post offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits for every step of your journey:

  • Competitive medical, dental and vision coverage

  • Company-paid pension and 401(k) match

  • Three weeks of vacation and up to three weeks of paid sick leave

  • Nine paid holidays and two personal days

  • 20 weeks paid parental leave for any new parent

  • Robust mental health resources

  • Backup care and caregiver concierge services

  • Gender affirming services

  • Pet insurance

  • Free Post digital subscription

  • Leadership and career development program

Benefits may vary based on the job, full-time or part-time schedule, location, and collectively bargained status

The salary range for this position is:

$121,400 - $202,400 Annual

The actual salary within this range will depend on individual skills, experience, and qualifications as they relate to specific job requirements. This position may be eligible for a bonus or incentive program, and a member of the Talent Acquisition team will discuss bonus payment terms and conditions during the interview process.

The Post strives to provide its readers with high-quality, trustworthy news and information while constantly innovating. That mission is best served by a diverse, multi-generational workforce with varied life experiences and perspectives. All cultures and backgrounds are welcomed.

jobs.excerpt: At Forbes Advisor, our mission is to help readers turn their aspirations into reality.
jobs.description:
At Forbes Advisor, our mission is to help readers turn their aspirations into reality. We arm people with trusted advice and guidance so they can make informed decisions they feel confident in and get back to doing the things they care about most.

We are an experienced team of industry experts dedicated to helping readers make smart decisions and choose the right products with ease. Forbes Advisor boasts decades of experience across dozens of geographies and teams, including Content, SEO, Business Intelligence, Finance, HR, Marketing, Production, Technology and Sales. The team brings rich industry knowledge to Forbes Advisor's global coverage of consumer credit, debt, health, home improvement, banking, investing, credit cards, small business, education, insurance, loans, real estate and travel.

Forbes Advisor is investing in the products and platform capabilities that power everything we build, and we're looking for a best-in-class Product Manager for our technology platforms team. This hands-on role will own products across our CMS platform, including reusable capabilities, partner propositions and platform features that enable our products across the business.

Great products are built on great platforms - so getting the foundations right is everything, whether that's for the teams using our products every day, the partners we build for, or the customers who ultimately benefit from them. You'll take products from discovery through delivery and continuous iteration, making sure what we build today can evolve with the business tomorrow.

Working closely with Publishing, Engineering, Design, Commercial and the wider Product team, you'll turn business needs into a clear, prioritised roadmap. You'll balance user needs, technical feasibility and commercial goals, keeping the people who use your products at the centre of every decision.

The person we're looking for is a genuine all-rounder who's equally comfortable working with engineers, internal teams and business stakeholders. You're naturally curious, enjoy solving complex operational problems, and are comfortable making smart trade-offs to deliver practical solutions. You're a self-starter and an exemplary communicator who keeps stakeholders aligned and reliably delivers what matters most.

Responsibilities:

Strategy & roadmap

  • Develop and maintain product roadmaps for CMS capabilities, partner propositions and platform features, balancing user needs, technical feasibility and business priorities.
  • Work with stakeholders across the business to identify opportunities, prioritise initiatives and continuously evolve the platform.

Product delivery

  • Lead product delivery from discovery through launch and ongoing iteration, ensuring products deliver measurable value.
  • Translate business needs into clear product requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria that Engineering teams can confidently deliver.
  • Own a prioritised backlog and work hand-in-hand with Engineering, Design and QA to deliver high-quality products at pace.

CMS, platform & product capabilities

  • Deliver scalable CMS capabilities, reusable components and platform features that enable teams across the business.
  • Work closely with Engineering to design solutions that are reusable, maintainable and scalable as the platform evolves.
  • Collaborate with internal teams and third-party partners to deliver new partner propositions and enhance the platform capabilities that support them.

AI & continuous improvement

  • Use user feedback, operational insight and business priorities to identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Use AI, automation and reusable platform capabilities to improve internal workflows, reduce duplication and accelerate delivery.
  • Measure the impact of new capabilities and use those learnings to inform future product decisions.

Stakeholder communication

  • Build strong relationships across Publishing, Engineering, Commercial and the wider Product team, acting as the central point of communication for your product area.
  • Keep stakeholders aligned on priorities, delivery progress and product decisions.

What you'll bring:

  • 3+ years in product management, with a track record of delivering high-impact platform products, internal tools or business capabilities.
  • Comfortable working across the full product lifecycle, from discovery and requirements through delivery and iteration.
  • Experience with CMS, publishing tools, content platforms or partner-facing products is a plus.
  • Experience delivering cross-functional product initiatives, collaborating across Engineering, Design and business teams to achieve shared outcomes.
  • Comfortable working closely with Engineering and translating business needs into clear product requirements.
  • Experience using AI to improve product development, accelerate delivery and solve complex problems.
  • Data-informed, with strong product judgement and the ability to make pragmatic trade-offs that deliver the greatest value.
  • Exemplary communication and stakeholder skills, with a proven ability to build alignment across technical and non-technical teams.
  • Curious, pragmatic and proactive, with a practical approach to solving problems and delivering value.

jobs.description:
At Forbes Advisor, our mission is to help readers turn their aspirations into reality. We arm people with trusted advice and guidance so they can make informed decisions they feel confident in and get back to doing the things they care about most.

We are an experienced team of industry experts dedicated to helping readers make smart decisions and choose the right products with ease. Forbes Advisor boasts decades of experience across dozens of geographies and teams, including Content, SEO, Business Intelligence, Finance, HR, Marketing, Production, Technology and Sales. The team brings rich industry knowledge to Forbes Advisor's global coverage of consumer credit, debt, health, home improvement, banking, investing, credit cards, small business, education, insurance, loans, real estate and travel.

Forbes Advisor is investing in the products and platform capabilities that power everything we build, and we're looking for a best-in-class Product Manager for our technology platforms team. This hands-on role will own products across our CMS platform, including reusable capabilities, partner propositions and platform features that enable our products across the business.

Great products are built on great platforms - so getting the foundations right is everything, whether that's for the teams using our products every day, the partners we build for, or the customers who ultimately benefit from them. You'll take products from discovery through delivery and continuous iteration, making sure what we build today can evolve with the business tomorrow.

Working closely with Publishing, Engineering, Design, Commercial and the wider Product team, you'll turn business needs into a clear, prioritised roadmap. You'll balance user needs, technical feasibility and commercial goals, keeping the people who use your products at the centre of every decision.

The person we're looking for is a genuine all-rounder who's equally comfortable working with engineers, internal teams and business stakeholders. You're naturally curious, enjoy solving complex operational problems, and are comfortable making smart trade-offs to deliver practical solutions. You're a self-starter and an exemplary communicator who keeps stakeholders aligned and reliably delivers what matters most.

Responsibilities:

Strategy & roadmap

  • Develop and maintain product roadmaps for CMS capabilities, partner propositions and platform features, balancing user needs, technical feasibility and business priorities.
  • Work with stakeholders across the business to identify opportunities, prioritise initiatives and continuously evolve the platform.

Product delivery

  • Lead product delivery from discovery through launch and ongoing iteration, ensuring products deliver measurable value.
  • Translate business needs into clear product requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria that Engineering teams can confidently deliver.
  • Own a prioritised backlog and work hand-in-hand with Engineering, Design and QA to deliver high-quality products at pace.

CMS, platform & product capabilities

  • Deliver scalable CMS capabilities, reusable components and platform features that enable teams across the business.
  • Work closely with Engineering to design solutions that are reusable, maintainable and scalable as the platform evolves.
  • Collaborate with internal teams and third-party partners to deliver new partner propositions and enhance the platform capabilities that support them.

AI & continuous improvement

  • Use user feedback, operational insight and business priorities to identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Use AI, automation and reusable platform capabilities to improve internal workflows, reduce duplication and accelerate delivery.
  • Measure the impact of new capabilities and use those learnings to inform future product decisions.

Stakeholder communication

  • Build strong relationships across Publishing, Engineering, Commercial and the wider Product team, acting as the central point of communication for your product area.
  • Keep stakeholders aligned on priorities, delivery progress and product decisions.

What you'll bring:

  • 3+ years in product management, with a track record of delivering high-impact platform products, internal tools or business capabilities.
  • Comfortable working across the full product lifecycle, from discovery and requirements through delivery and iteration.
  • Experience with CMS, publishing tools, content platforms or partner-facing products is a plus.
  • Experience delivering cross-functional product initiatives, collaborating across Engineering, Design and business teams to achieve shared outcomes.
  • Comfortable working closely with Engineering and translating business needs into clear product requirements.
  • Experience using AI to improve product development, accelerate delivery and solve complex problems.
  • Data-informed, with strong product judgement and the ability to make pragmatic trade-offs that deliver the greatest value.
  • Exemplary communication and stakeholder skills, with a proven ability to build alignment across technical and non-technical teams.
  • Curious, pragmatic and proactive, with a practical approach to solving problems and delivering value.

Forbes Advisor provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

• Experience with reviewing functional requirements

• Experience with Product Sourcing

• Experience with OData Services

• Experience with SAP workflows; flexible workflow a plus
• Experience with S/4 integration/implementations

• Willingness to operate in an interactive virtual team environment, establishing strong team relationships and delivering exceptional customer service

jobs.excerpt: Standard Job Description You will be the ASIC & FPGA Design Engineer for the ASIC/FPGA department at Lockheed Martin Missiles and Fire Control.
jobs.description:
Standard Job Description

You will be the ASIC & FPGA Design Engineer for the ASIC/FPGA department at Lockheed  Martin  Missiles  and  Fire  Control. Our team delivers full custom analog and mixed signal ICs that power advanced defense systems, ranging from 130 nm down to 12 nm and including high voltage BCD processes.

What You Will Be Doing
As the ASIC & FPGA Design Engineer you will own the entire layout flow—from floorplan through tape out—working hand in hand with circuit designers to turn schematic intent into high performance, parasitic aware physical designs. You will operate in a dual tool environment (Synopsys Custom Compiler and Cadence Virtuoso) and drive physical verification closure across multiple foundries, directly supporting mission critical programs. Your responsibilities will include:

• Create floorplans, place and route analog blocks, optimizing area, matching, signal integrity and power delivery.
• Drive DRC, LVS and ERC verification to achieve full closure for each target process.
• Perform or support EMIR analysis to detect and remediate IR drop and electromigration concerns.
• Develop and maintain layout methodology, automation scripts and best practice guidelines for the department.
• Collaborate with circuit designers, verification engineers and system architects to ensure the layout reflects functional intent and performance targets.
• Manage tape out sign off packages, including documentation, design rule decks and release notes.
• Mentor junior layout engineers and promote a knowledge sharing culture.

Why Join Us
Do you want to be part of a company culture that empowers employees to think big, lead with a growth mindset, and make the impossible a reality? We provide the resources and give you the flexibility to enable inspiration and focus. If you have the passion and courage to dream big, work hard, and have fun doing what you love then we want to build a better tomorrow with you.

We offer flexible work schedules to comprehensive benefits investing in your future and security, Learn more about Lockheed Martin’s comprehensive benefits package here.

Further Information About This Opportunity:

This position is remote.

MUST BE A U.S. CITIZEN - This position is located at a facility that requires special access. The selected candidate must be able to obtain a secret clearance.

Basic Qualifications

• Associate degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Technology, Microelectronics, or a related technical discipline
• 8 or more years of experience in full-custom analog or mixed-signal IC layout design
• Layout experience across process nodes ranging from 130nm to 12nm, including BCD technologies
• Proficiency with Synopsys Custom Compiler (or Custom Designer)
• Proficiency with Cadence Virtuoso layout environment
• Experience with physical verification closure (DRC, LVS, ERC, ANT) across multiple foundry processes
• Ability to obtain a U.S. security clearance

Desired Skills

• Bachelor degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, or a related field
• EMIR analysis experience, including IR drop and electromigration mitigation
• Scripting or layout automation skills (SKILL, Tcl, Python, or Perl)
• Layout experience with precision analog blocks such as PLLs, ADC/DACs, LDOs, bandgap references, or amplifiers

Character

Standard Job Description

This Lockheed Martin (LM) Enterprise Business and Digital Transformation (EBDT) Software Engineer position is for a Java / COTS developer for the EBDT Engineering Enablement team supporting the Rotary & Mission Systems (RMS) EPDM system based on PTC Windchill.

A developer with a strong technical background is needed to join an existing high performing team supporting business critical applications for the RMS Engineering & Technology organization. Successful candidates will be expected to quickly come up to speed on new technologies and internal processes. This assignment works with a large and complex COTS product where not all aspects are completely documented. To be successful a candidate must be willing to show initiative and develop creative solutions utilizing the limited set of available resources. To facilitate necessary skill growth both on the job and formal training opportunities will be provided.

This position is expected to join an experienced software development team which provides support for the RMS EPDM PLM system based on PTC Windchill and key 1LMX initiatives such as MPMLink Capital project and 1LMX integrations (Enterprise Part Registry, S/4 HANA and Common MES systems). The applicant will be expected to integrate into an existing agile software development process utilizing daily scrums and sprints while adjusting quickly to a fast paced working environment.

Basic Qualifications

  • Strong Java and Object Oriented development skills with at least 5 years documented work experience.
  • Demonstrated understanding of HTML, CSS, Java Server Pages (JSP), JavaScript, REST APIs, and related concepts.
  • Strong SQL skills and understanding of relational databases.
  • Proven ability to execute the full software development lifecycle including interfacing directly with non-technical stakeholders to develop requirements.
  • Demonstrated willingness to take initiative and develop innovative solutions to complex problems.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • ** US Citizenship is required for this role **

Desired Skills

  • General knowledge of Product Lifecycle Management (PLM)
  • Experience with PTC Windchill, ProjectLink, PDMLink or other PTC COTS products.
  • Experience with CAD tools such as Creo, AutoCAD, SolidWorks, and Catia.
  • Experience with Jasper reporting.
  • Experience with DevOps software tools such as Git, GitLab, Sonar Cube, Jenkins, and Ant.
  • Experience with middleware technologies such as SAP IDOCS, XML and SOAP web services, SOA Suite, OpenShift and Camel
  • Experience with eQube
  • Previous experience or training with Agile software development concepts, techniques, and tools.
  • Demonstrated effectiveness working with teammates in a virtual environment.

Pay Information

    • Includes metropolitan areas such as Denver, CO; King of Prussia, PA; Stratford, CT; Moorestown, NJ; etc.
  • Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 3): :$98100.00 - $182100.00
    • Includes metropolitan areas such as Dallas–Fort Worth, TX; Orlando, FL; Grand Prairie, TX; Marietta, GA; etc.
  • Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 4): :$88300.00 - $163900.00
    • Includes metropolitan areas such as Camden, AR; Lexington, KY; Ocala, FL; Lufkin, TX; etc.

Follow us on

LinkedIn | Youtube | Instagram

About the role

Job Title: Senior Build & Release Engineer
Experience: 5+ years
Job Type: Full-Time

The firmware department at Sibros focuses on in-vehicle software stack, developing highly reliable software that can be easily deployed on a wide range of hardware, operating systems, and vehicle architectures. As a senior member of the team you will be responsible for leading cross-functional projects in order to accelerate and optimize the development process (develop, build and release) for the firmware team. What you'll do

The firmware build & release engineering team manages a wide range of responsibilities including build systems (Bazel), CI/CD pipelines (GitLab), cloud infrastructure (AWS), and diverse automation tooling (Python, Bash). As a senior member, you will:

  • Architect and Optimize: Design, maintain, and optimize robust CI/CD pipelines.
  • Process Improvement: Identify and address pain points in the development, test, and release cycles.
  • Complex Debugging: Debug intricate problems existing between application layers and low-level infrastructure.
  • Code Excellence: Identify and execute fundamental code, design, and process improvements to ensure best-in-class code following industry practices.
  • Collaborative Delivery: Work with cross-functional teams to create plans, identify risks, resolve issues, and deliver on schedule.
  • Mentorship: Provide technical guidance and mentorship to team members through documentation, code reviews, and knowledge sharing.

What you should know:

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in a similar or related engineering role.
  • Build Tools: Demonstrated experience with build tools such as Bazel, Buck, Pants, Please, CMake, Make, Ninja, or SCons for large-scale software.
  • CI/CD Systems: Experience with GitLab CI, Jenkins, Buildkite, Spinnaker, or other enterprise CI/CD tools.
  • Scripting: Ability to design complex tools using Python and Bash.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Starlark: Experience in writing Starlark for build system customization.
  • C/C++ Expertise: Strong experience with C/C++ tooling, as well as compilation and linking processes.
  • Containerization: Familiarity with the container ecosystem, including Docker and Kubernetes.

What we offer

  • Competitive Compensation: A package inclusive of performance incentives.
  • Growth Environment: A dynamic work environment with a flat hierarchy and rapid career advancement.
  • Learning & Development: Access to continuous learning and professional development opportunities.
  • Work-Life Balance: Flexible working hours and a culture that promotes balance.
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Health insurance and wellness programs.
  • Modern Policy: Flexible vacation and paid time off,you decide when you need a break.
  • Team Culture: Regular team events, off-sites, and a budget for online courses, books, and conferences.

jobs.description:
Overview and Introduction to Communitas International

Communitas is a church planting organization with 50 years experience working in Western Europe, Central and Eastern Europe, Latin America and North America. Our leading edge ministry is looking for the right person to help lead us into greater Kingdom ministry. Our current mission family of over 200 includes full-time, bi-vocational employees, as well as affiliates, with many of that number being non-Americans. Communitas operates in over 20 different countries as we start new initiatives and nurture churches and church-planting projects toward reproducible maturity.

Communitas is rooted in missional theology. Our three core values center on being Kingdom seeking, Grace oriented and People focused. Our church planting methodology is not tied to a specific formula, but rather the spirit of serving others and the embracing of a progression of actions that lead to a healthy, maturing church, making our approach very adaptable to unique contexts (see for details). We are pioneers and risk takers. We value honesty and encouragement. We collaborate well, within our global regions, as well as with partner organizations.

The Need and Opportunity

Across post-Christian secular culture people have largely given up on church, but spirituality remains important to them. Communitas International is at the forefront of sparking that spirituality with mission and helping people ‘taste and see that the Lord is good’. Our church planting organization offers the following:

  • A firm commitment to expressing the passionate love of God for the world in word and deed.
  • Substantial experience in reaching people in post-Christian culture.
  • Strategic coaching for planters and churches by experienced cross-cultural practitioners.
  • Robust training for team leaders and members via online cohorts, on-site events and regional/global seminars and conferences.
  • Rigorous assessment experiences and tools that can form the basis for strategic coaching and healthy team building.
  • Partnership in innovation with those looking for new ways to declare the timeless message of the Gospel.

Videographer

Reports to:

Chief Multiplication Officer

Works closely with:

Mobilization, Human Resources, Global field leaders, Field staff

Direct reports:

None

Location:

Remote work engagement

Structure:

Full-time, part-time, bi-vocational (support-raised); volunteer

Position Scope:

The Videographer will use video production and visual storytelling to strengthen Communitas’ brand, expand audience engagement, and share the stories of what God is doing through our ministry partners and communities around the world.

jobs.excerpt: Job Description:Title: Senior Recruiter Team: Human Resources Location: Remote (Canada, New York Metro Area / 2 hour commute to NYC or Raleigh, North Carolina) Why This Role ExistsAt Phreesia, the Senior Recruiter plays a pivotal role in identifying, attracting, and hiring the talent that helps us deliver on our mission of making care easier every day.
jobs.description:
Job Description:

Title: Senior Recruiter
Team: Human Resources
Location: Remote (Canada, New York Metro Area / 2 hour commute to NYC or Raleigh, North Carolina)

Why This Role Exists

At Phreesia, the Senior Recruiter plays a pivotal role in identifying, attracting, and hiring the talent that helps us deliver on our mission of making care easier every day.

Operating within our Business Partner Model, you’ll act as a strategic talent acquisition advisor to HR Business Partners, hiring managers, and senior and executive leaders — leading searches across multiple departments, position levels, and geographic locations. You’ll bring deep full-cycle recruiting expertise and sound judgment to every stage of the process and be trusted to operate with a high degree of independence.

You’ll care deeply about delivering a best-in-class experience for every candidate and hiring manager, bring grit to our most challenging and highest-stakes searches, try new approaches that improve how we hire, and consistently make excellent things happen for the business and the teams you support.

What You’ll Spend Your Time Doing

  • Own full-cycle recruiting.
    Lead the end-to-end North America recruiting process for a variety of roles, including sourcing, screening, interviewing, and closing candidates at all levels.
  • Shape the search strategy.
    Lead search strategy and kickoff meetings with hiring managers and HR partners to align on job requirements, qualifications, and the ideal candidate profile, while bringing a point of view on market conditions and hiring approach.
  • Partner with senior leaders.
    Work directly with senior leaders on searches, presenting market insights, candidate slates, and hiring recommendations with credibility and polish.
  • Raise the bar across the recruiting team.
    Mentor and coach other recruiters, sharing best practices in sourcing, interviewing, and candidate management.
  • Be a strategic talent advisor.
    Guide business leaders on compensation, market trends, and interview approaches while exercising sound judgment in ambiguous or high-stakes hiring situations.
  • Drive continuous improvement.
    Stay current on recruiting trends and AI-enabled tools, and lead projects that sharpen team processes and strategy.
  • Deliver an exceptional candidate experience.
    Serve as a Phreesia brand ambassador by creating a high-touch, authentic, and inclusive experience for every candidate and modeling that standard for the broader recruiting team.
  • Keep stakeholders connected.
    Communicate proactively and consistently to create a transparent and engaging journey that reflects our culture and values for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Use data to improve outcomes.
    Leverage recruiting data and metrics to track performance, inform hiring decisions, and improve results.
  • Create consistency and compliance.
    Support hiring consistency through scorecards, process standards, and timely feedback in Workday.
  • Adapt to what each search needs.
    Thrive in ambiguity, adjusting your recruiting approach and process to fit the unique demands of each search rather than applying a one-size-fits-all playbook.

What Makes You a Great Fit

You don’t need to check every box — but this role will feel energizing if you:

  • Have a proven track record of success in results-driven, full-cycle recruiting, including hard-to-fill or confidential searches
  • Bring demonstrated executive presence and communicate with senior leaders in a confident, credible, and concise way
  • Are comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment and balancing multiple complex searches while maintaining quality and responsiveness
  • Have experience mentoring or informally leading other recruiters
  • Bring strong business acumen and can understand organizational needs and align talent strategies accordingly
  • Are adaptable and growth-oriented, with an interest in learning and evolving alongside changing business needs
  • Have extensive experience recruiting across multiple levels and functions, including senior-level searches across North America
  • Have experience managing complex internal and external stakeholder relationships, including relationships with senior leaders
  • Are comfortable operating with a high level of independence
  • Are committed to professional development and staying current in the recruiting industry
  • Have global recruiting experience, which is strongly preferred
  • Have experience with Workday, which is preferred

We Do Have A Few Requirements To Check

  • Bachelor’s degree required
  • 10+ years of relevant full-cycle recruiting experience, including experience recruiting for senior or specialized roles

Where You’ll Work

This is a remote role for candidates located in Canada, New York Metro Area / 2 hour commute to NYC or Raleigh, North Carolina. Minimal travel may arise based on business needs.

Compensation & Rewards

  • Base Salary: $100,000 - $120,000 USD / $95,000 - 110,000 CAD
  • A comprehensive Total Rewards package designed to support your whole life — not just your work

Who We Are:

At Phreesia, we’re looking for smart and passionate people to help drive our mission of creating a better, more engaging healthcare experience. We’re committed to helping healthcare organizations succeed in an ever-evolving landscape by transforming the way healthcare is delivered. Our SaaS platform digitizes appointment check-in and offers tools to engage patients, improve efficiency, optimize staffing, and enhance clinical care.

Phreesia cares about our employees by providing a diverse and dynamic work environment. We’re a five-time winner of Modern Healthcare Magazine’s Best Places to Work in Healthcare award and we’ve been recognized on the Bloomberg Gender Equality Index. We are dedicated to continuously improving our employee experience by launching new programs and initiatives. If you thrive in a culture of recognition, value inclusivity, professional development, and growth opportunities, Phreesia could be a great fit!

Top-rated Employee Benefits:

  • 100% Remote work + home office expense reimbursements

  • Competitive compensation

  • Flexible PTO + 8 company holidays

  • Monthly reimbursement for cell phone + internet + wellness

  • 100% Paid 12-week parental leave to our U.S. employees, as well as a generous parental benefit to our employees in Canada

  • Variety of insurance coverage for people (and pets!)

  • Continuing education and professional certification reimbursement

  • Opportunity to join an Employee Resource Group. Learn more here:

We strive to provide a diverse and inclusive environment and are an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.excerpt: über die rolle Als B2B Operations Manager entwickelst du die Prozesse, Datenflüsse und Arbeitsweisen unseres B2B-Bereichs.
jobs.description:
über die rolle

Als B2B Operations Manager entwickelst du die Prozesse, Datenflüsse und Arbeitsweisen unseres B2B-Bereichs. Du nutzt Daten, Automatisierung und KI, um manuelle Arbeit zu reduzieren und Abläufe skalierbar zu machen. So kann sich das Team stärker auf Kunden, Partnerschaften und Wachstum konzentrieren.

Unser CRM befindet sich im finalen Aufbau. Du übernimmst die fachliche Verantwortung dafür, wie B2B-Prozesse im CRM abgebildet werden: Du erkennst Engpässe in der Datenpflege und den Workflows, formulierst Anforderungen an Struktur und Automatisierung und setzt neue Abläufe gemeinsam mit den beteiligten Teams um - von der Abbildung von Lead-Qualifizierung und Onboarding über Pricing- und Konditionslogik bis zu Partnerkommunikation und Shop-Prozessen.

deine aufgaben

B2B-Prozesse & Operations (ca. 60%)

  • Du übernimmst 0-to-1-Ownership für unsere B2B-Prozesse, von der Lead-Qualifizierung über das Onboarding bis zur laufenden Partnerbetreuung. Wo heute kein sauberer Ablauf existiert, baust du einen.
  • Du bist die Schnittstelle zu CRM und Automation: Du verstehst die Datenflüsse, erkennst Engpässe und formulierst klare Anforderungen, die Data & AI und IT technisch umsetzen. CRM-Hygiene ist für dich die Grundlage jeder verlässlichen Auswertung.
  • Du verbindest Sales, Supply Chain, Finance und Product zu reibungslosen Abläufen mit klaren Verantwortlichkeiten und treibst bereichsübergreifende Projekte voran.
  • Du definierst und trackst zentrale KPIs (Conversion Rate, Pipeline-Geschwindigkeit, Lead-Qualität, Customer Value) und baust Reporting, das dem Team echte Steuerungsintelligenz gibt, keine Zahlenfriedhöfe.
  • Du hältst fest, was funktioniert: Du machst Best Practices zu Playbooks und SOPs und sorgst dafür, dass sie im Team wirklich genutzt werden.
Operatives Enabling (ca. 40%)
  • Du verantwortest B2B-Newsletter und Partner-Kommunikation: Du bringst die richtigen Aktionen zu den richtigen Partnergruppen und wertest ihre Wirkung aus (Open Rate, CTR, Conversion).
  • Du entwickelst unsere Pricing- und Konditionenlogik mit und pflegst sie sauber in Shop und CRM: kommerziell durchdacht, konsistent, nachvollziehbar.
  • Du betreust unseren B2B-Shop und den Education-Shop: Produktzugänge, Kollektionen, Bundles, kleinere Anpassungen, und du begleitest die Shop-Migration.
  • Du sicherst die Qualität unserer Produktdaten: vollständig, korrekt, verlässlich.

dein profil

  • Du hast 3-4+ Jahre Erfahrung in einer Sales-Organisation, Commercial/Sales Operations, Strategieberatung oder einem Scale-up gesammelt. Ein Hintergrund in einer Strategieberatung oder Business Development ist ein Pluspunkt.
  • Du hast idealerweise Erfahrung mit HubSpot und bewegst dich sicher in CRM-Systemen und digitalen Workflows.
  • Du bist ein hands-on Generalist: Du denkst in Prozessen und Systemen, setzt selbst um statt zu delegieren, und dir ist keine Aufgabe zu klein.
  • Du hast bereits komplexe, bereichsübergreifende Projekte eigenständig geführt - von Scoping und Business Case über die Umsetzung bis zur Verankerung im Team (SOPs, Playbooks, Trainings).
  • Du denkst unternehmerisch: Du erkennst Chancen, priorisierst nach Wirkung und Skalierbarkeit und triffst eigenständig fundierte Entscheidungen.
  • Du arbeitest stark analytisch: Du bewegst dich sicher in großen Datenmengen und Spreadsheets und ziehst daraus klare, umsetzbare Schlüsse.
  • Du hast eine hohe KI- und Datenaffinität: Du hast KI-Tools bereits praktisch in deiner Arbeit eingesetzt und möchtest sie zu einem festen Bestandteil deiner Arbeitsweise machen. Du prüfst Ergebnisse kritisch, experimentierst mit neuen Ansätzen und lernst schnell.
  • Du strukturierst fachliche Bedarfe und übersetzt sie in umsetzbare Anforderungen an Prozesse, Daten und Systeme. Dabei kommunizierst du klar und zielgruppengerecht innerhalb des Unternehmens.
  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und kommunizierst sicher auf Englisch.

was uns wichtig ist

  • Stapelstein ist für dich kein Job - sondern eine Mission, hinter der du wirklich stehst.
  • Für dich ist ein respektvoller, empathischer Umgang keine Checkbox - sondern die Basis, auf der gute Zusammenarbeit entsteht.
  • Herausforderungen bremsen dich nicht - sie machen dich neugierig.
  • Du denkst kreativ und unternehmerisch - du findest Wege, wo andere Hindernisse sehen, und machst dich in deinen Rollen wirklich wirkungsvoll.
  • Du übernimmst echte Verantwortung und triffst Entscheidungen mit Überzeugung - ohne dass jemand fragen muss.
  • Du brauchst keine Struktur von außen - du schaffst sie dir selbst.
  • Du nutzt KI nicht, weil es alle tun - sondern weil du verstanden hast, dass es die Art, wie wir arbeiten, grundlegend verändert.

was wir bieten

  • Der Start ist jederzeit möglich.
  • Ein marktübliches, faires Gehaltspaket.
  • Remote-first - in Deutschland und zeitweise auch aus dem Ausland.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit einer gemeinsamen Kernzeit von 9-12 Uhr.
  • Überstunden werden vollständig durch Freizeitausgleich ausgeglichen.
  • Vollzeit bedeutet bei uns 36 Stunden pro Woche - für mehr Fokus und mehr Lebenszeit. Ergänzt wird das durch 30 Urlaubstage pro Jahr.
  • Monatliche Team-Meet-ups in Stuttgart oder Berlin. Zeit, um gemeinsam im selben Raum zu arbeiten, Projekte voranzubringen und sich persönlich auszutauschen.
  • Zwei inspirierende Offsites pro Jahr, weil echtes Teamgefühl trotz Remote-first seinen Raum braucht.
  • Flexible Benefits wie Einkaufsbudget, Mobilitätszuschuss oder Urban Sports - nach bestandener Probezeit.

The Chief Sustainability Officer (CSO) is responsible for leading the organization's environmental, social, and governance (ESG) strategy and sustainability initiatives. The CSO drives the integration of sustainable business practices into corporate strategy, operations, risk management, and stakeholder engagement. This role ensures the organization meets regulatory requirements, sustainability goals, and long-term ESG commitments while enhancing corporate reputation and business resilience.

Key Responsibilities

ESG & Sustainability Strategy

  • Develop and execute the organization's ESG and sustainability strategy aligned with corporate objectives.
  • Establish sustainability goals, targets, and long-term roadmaps.
  • Integrate ESG principles into business operations, investments, and decision-making processes.

Environmental Sustainability Initiatives

  • Lead initiatives focused on carbon reduction, energy efficiency, waste management, and climate resilience.
  • Develop strategies to reduce environmental impact and support net-zero objectives.
  • Monitor environmental performance metrics and sustainability benchmarks.

Social Impact & Corporate Responsibility

  • Drive diversity, equity, inclusion (DEI), employee well-being, and community engagement initiatives.

Governance & Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with ESG-related regulations, reporting standards, and frameworks.

ESG Reporting & Analytics

  • Oversee ESG disclosures, sustainability reporting, and impact measurement.
  • Ensure alignment with recognized frameworks such as GRI, SASB, TCFD, and ISSB where applicable.
  • Develop dashboards and KPIs to measure ESG performance and progress.

Stakeholder & Investor Engagement

  • Engage with investors, regulators, clients, and external stakeholders on sustainability matters.
  • Communicate ESG initiatives, progress, and impact transparently.
  • Represent the organization in sustainability forums and industry discussions.

Sustainable Business Transformation

  • Collaborate with business units to embed sustainability into operations, products, and services.
  • Support sustainable finance, green initiatives, and responsible investment strategies.
  • Identify opportunities for innovation and sustainable growth.

Risk Management & Resilience

  • Assess environmental and social risks impacting business operations and investments.
  • Develop climate risk and sustainability risk management frameworks.
  • Support enterprise resilience and long-term sustainability planning.

Leadership & Culture Development

  • Promote a sustainability-focused culture across the organization.
  • Lead and mentor ESG, sustainability, and CSR teams.
  • Drive employee awareness and engagement in sustainability initiatives.

Qualifications

Performance Metrics
